#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Per-platform detail adapters. No paid-entry platforms.

A candidate URL in, a normalized program record out: scope assets, reward tiers,
PoC clauses, exclusions, submission channel, template. Tiers are tried in order
and the first usable record wins:

  1. api       documented or inferable JSON/text endpoint for the platform
  2. embedded  __NEXT_DATA__ / __NUXT__ / Apollo state inside the served HTML
  3. html      visible text with headings and tables preserved
  4. reader    proxy render, markdown mode
  5. manual    text a human pasted

No field is ever invented. A record with no scope, no tier and no PoC clause is
reported thin, with reasons, so the caller can park the target and show them.
"""

import json
import re
import urllib.parse

TIERS = ("api", "embedded", "html", "reader", "manual")

SCOPE_KEYS = re.compile(
    r"(^|\.)(assets?|scopes?|targets?|contracts?|addresses?|in_?scope|inScope|code|"
    r"repositor(y|ies)|files?)$", re.I)
REWARD_KEYS = re.compile(r"(bount|reward|tier|severity|payout|table|maxAmount|max)", re.I)
POC_KEYS = re.compile(r"(poc|proof|requirement|template|submission|how_?to|report|"
                      r"guideline|instruction)", re.I)
EXCL_KEYS = re.compile(r"(out_?of_?scope|outOfScope|exclu|not_?in_?scope|prohibit|"
                       r"known_?issues?|knownIssues)", re.I)
CHAIN_HOSTS = [
    ("etherscan.io", "eth"), ("arbiscan.io", "arbitrum"), ("basescan.org", "base"),
    ("optimistic.etherscan.io", "optimism"), ("polygonscan.com", "polygon"),
    ("bscscan.com", "bsc"), ("snowtrace.io", "avalanche"), ("snowscan.xyz", "avalanche"),
    ("explorer.monad.xyz", "monad"),
]
EXPLORER_RE = re.compile(r"https?://(?:[\w-]+\.)?(%s)/address/(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40})"
                         % "|".join(re.escape(h) for h, _ in CHAIN_HOSTS))
ADDR_RE = re.compile(r"\b0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}\b")
MONEY_RE = re.compile(r"\$?\s*([\d][\d,]{2,})(?:\s*(k|m))?", re.I)
TIER_RE = re.compile(r"\b(critical|high|medium|low|informational)\b", re.I)
SELF_HOSTS = {"hackenproof.com", "code4rena.com", "sherlock.xyz", "audits.sherlock.xyz",
              "cantina.xyz", "bugcrowd.com", "hackerone.com", "app.intigriti.com",
              "intigriti.com", "yeswehack.com", "hats.finance", "github.com",
              "raw.githubusercontent.com", "mor.org"}


class Result:
    __slots__ = ("adapter", "tier", "markdown", "rec", "problems", "url", "fields", "note")

    def __init__(self, adapter="", tier="", markdown="", rec=None, problems=None,
                 url="", fields=None, note=""):
        self.adapter = adapter
        self.tier = tier
        self.markdown = markdown or ""
        self.rec = rec or blank()
        self.problems = list(problems or [])
        self.url = url
        self.fields = dict(fields or {})
        self.note = note

    @property
    def ok(self):
        return bool(self.markdown.strip()) and not self.thin

    @property
    def thin(self):
        r = self.rec
        return not (r["assets"] or r["rewards"] or r["poc_any"] or r["template"])

    def summary(self):
        r = self.rec
        return ("adapter=%s tier=%s assets=%d tiers=%d poc=%s submit=%s problems=%s"
                % (self.adapter or "-", self.tier or "-", len(r["assets"]),
                   len(r["rewards"]), r["poc_any"], r["submit"]["address"] or "-",
                   ",".join(self.problems) or "-"))


def blank():
    return {"name": "", "url": "", "assets": [], "rewards": [], "poc": {},
            "poc_any": False, "exclusions": {"surfaces": [], "non_vulns": [],
                                             "non_submissions": []},
            "template": [], "submit": {"channel": "", "address": "", "subject": ""},
            "constraints": {}, "caps": [], "policy": "", "raw": ""}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ discovery

URL_RULES = {
    "hackenproof.com": r"^https://hackenproof\.com/programs/[a-z0-9][\w.-]{2,}$",
    "code4rena.com": r"^https://code4rena\.com/audits/[a-z0-9][\w-]{2,}$",
    "sherlock.xyz": r"^https://audits\.sherlock\.xyz/contests/[\w-]{3,}$",
    "cantina.xyz": r"^https://cantina\.xyz/competitions/[\w-]{3,}$",
    "bugcrowd.com": r"^https://bugcrowd\.com/engagements/[\w-]{3,}$",
    "hackerone.com": r"^https://hackerone\.com/[\w-]{3,}$",
    "intigriti.com": r"^https://app\.intigriti\.com/programs/[\w-]{3,}(/detail)?$",
    "yeswehack.com": r"^https://yeswehack\.com/programs/[\w-]{3,}$",
    "hats.finance": r"^https://hats\.finance/(?:competitions|audits)/[\w-]{3,}$",
    "github.com": r"^https://github\.com/[\w.-]{1,39}/[\w.-]{1,80}$",
    "mor.org": r"^https://mor\.org/bug-bounty/?$",
}
RESERVED = {"bounty", "bug-bounty", "bugbounty", "programs", "program", "audits", "audit",
            "engagements", "competitions", "contests", "opportunities", "information",
            "assets", "rewards", "explore", "all", "search", "index", "dashboard",
            "detail", "overview", "policy", "scope", "resources", "blog", "docs"}
PROGRAM_PATH = re.compile(
    r"/(?:bug-?bounty|bounties|security|audits?|programs?|contests?|competitions?|"
    r"engagements?|opportunities)(?:/|$)", re.I)


def host_of(url):
    return urllib.parse.urlparse(url).netloc.lower().replace("www.", "")


def program_url_ok(url):
    """(ok, reason). Rejects nav, category, tag and asset URLs before queueing."""
    h = host_of(url)
    if not h:
        return False, "no host"
    rule = None
    for host, rx in URL_RULES.items():
        if h == host or h.endswith("." + host):
            rule = rx
            break
    if rule:
        if not re.match(rule, url):
            return False, "path does not match the program shape for %s" % h
    else:
        if not PROGRAM_PATH.search(urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path):
            return False, "host %s has no rule and the path is not program-shaped" % h
    seg = [s for s in urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path.split("/") if s]
    if not seg:
        return False, "no path"
    last = seg[-1].lower().replace(".json", "")
    if last in RESERVED:
        return False, "reserved segment %s" % last
    if len(last) < 3:
        return False, "slug too short"
    if re.search(r"\.(?:js|css|map|svg|png|jpe?g|ico|woff2?)$", last):
        return False, "asset file"
    if h == "github.com" and len(seg) != 2:
        return False, "github path is not owner/repo"
    return True, "ok"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ field digs

def dig(obj, rx, path="", out=None, depth=0):
    if out is None:
        out = []
    if depth > 8 or len(out) > 4000:
        return out
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            p = "%s.%s" % (path, k) if path else str(k)
            if rx.search(str(k)) and not isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                if str(v).strip():
                    out.append((p, v))
            dig(v, rx, p, out, depth + 1)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj[:300]:
            dig(v, rx, path, out, depth + 1)
    return out


def walk_objects(obj, depth=0):
    if depth > 8:
        return
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        yield obj
        for v in obj.values():
            yield from walk_objects(v, depth + 1)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj[:400]:
            yield from walk_objects(v, depth + 1)


def money(raw):
    if isinstance(raw, (int, float)):
        return int(raw)
    m = MONEY_RE.search(str(raw))
    if not m:
        return 0
    v = int(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))
    mul = (m.group(2) or "").lower()
    if mul == "k":
        v *= 1000
    elif mul == "m":
        v *= 1000000
    return v


def chain_for(url, hint=""):
    low = (url + " " + hint).lower()
    for host, chain in CHAIN_HOSTS:
        if host in low:
            return chain
    for w, chain in (("arbitrum", "arbitrum"), ("base", "base"), ("optimism", "optimism"),
                     ("polygon", "polygon"), ("bsc", "bsc"), ("avalanche", "avalanche"),
                     ("monad", "monad"), ("solana", "solana"), ("ethereum", "eth")):
        if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % w, low):
            return chain
    return "eth"


def asset_from(obj):
    """One asset object into {desc,url,type,chain,addr} or None."""
    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
        return None
    url = ""
    for k in ("url", "link", "href", "address", "source"):
        v = obj.get(k)
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
            url = v.strip()
            break
    desc = ""
    for k in ("description", "name", "label", "title", "contract", "identifier"):
        v = obj.get(k)
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
            desc = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", v)[:180]
            break
    typ = str(obj.get("type") or obj.get("assetType") or obj.get("kind") or "").lower()
    if not url and not desc:
        return None
    addr = ""
    m = ADDR_RE.search(url) or ADDR_RE.search(desc)
    if m:
        addr = m.group(0)
    return {"desc": desc or "asset", "url": url, "type": typ,
            "chain": chain_for(url, typ + " " + desc), "addr": addr}


def collect(rec, raw_json):
    """Fill rec from any JSON shape by key semantics, not by fixed paths."""
    for obj in walk_objects(raw_json):
        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
            continue
        sev = ""
        for k in ("severity", "tier", "level", "risk"):
            if isinstance(obj.get(k), str) and TIER_RE.search(obj[k]):
                sev = TIER_RE.search(obj[k]).group(1).lower()
                break
        if sev:
            band = 0
            for k in ("max", "maxAmount", "amount", "reward", "payout", "value", "usd"):
                if k in obj:
                    band = max(band, money(obj[k]))
            if band:
                rec["rewards"].append({"tier": sev, "max": band,
                                       "definition": re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(
                                           obj.get("description") or obj.get("impact") or ""))[:280]})
            continue
        a = asset_from(obj)
        if a and (a["addr"] or a["url"] or a["type"] in ("smart_contract", "website", "api")):
            rec["assets"].append(a)
    for path, val in dig(raw_json, SCOPE_KEYS):
        s = str(val)
        if ADDR_RE.search(s) or re.match(r"https?://\S+$", s):
            a = asset_from({"url": s, "description": path.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]})
            if a:
                rec["assets"].append(a)
        elif re.search(r"https?://github\.com/[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+", s):
            rec["assets"].append({"desc": path.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], "url": s,
                                  "type": "repository", "chain": "", "addr": ""})
    for path, val in dig(raw_json, POC_KEYS):
        s = str(val)
        if len(s) < 12:
            continue
        low = s.lower()
        if re.search(r"poc|proof of concept|foundry|hardhat|fork", low):
            rec["poc_any"] = True
        if re.search(r"foundry|forge test", low):
            rec["poc"]["framework"] = "foundry"
        if re.search(r"mainnet fork|fork(?:ed)? (?:mainnet|at)", low):
            rec["poc"]["fork"] = True
        if re.search(r"pinned block|fork-block|specific block", low):
            rec["poc"]["block_pin"] = True
        if re.search(r"assert[^.]{0,60}(loss|balance|invariant)", low):
            rec["poc"]["must_assert"] = True
        if re.search(r"no poc|poc (?:is )?(?:required|mandatory)|must (?:contain|include)[^.]{0,40}poc",
                     low):
            rec["poc"]["required"] = True
        if re.search(r"^[A-Z][A-Z _/]{2,28}$", s.strip()) and s.strip() not in rec["template"]:
            rec["template"].append(s.strip())
    for path, val in dig(raw_json, EXCL_KEYS):
        s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(val))[:300]
        if len(s) < 8:
            continue
        low = s.lower()
        if re.search(r"frontend|website|api|subgraph|indexer|testnet|staging|third-party", low):
            rec["exclusions"]["surfaces"].append(s)
        elif re.search(r"poc|template|one page", low):
            rec["exclusions"]["non_submissions"].append(s)
        else:
            rec["exclusions"]["non_vulns"].append(s)
    for path, val in dig(raw_json, re.compile(r"(submit|contact|email|channel|subject)", re.I)):
        s = str(val).strip()
        if "@" in s and " " not in s:
            rec["submit"]["address"] = rec["submit"]["address"] or s
            rec["submit"]["channel"] = rec["submit"]["channel"] or "email"
        elif s.startswith("http") and any(h in s for h in SELF_HOSTS):
            rec["submit"]["channel"] = rec["submit"]["channel"] or "platform"
            rec["submit"]["address"] = rec["submit"]["address"] or s
        elif "BOUNTY" in s.upper() and len(s) < 120:
            rec["submit"]["subject"] = rec["submit"]["subject"] or s
    for k in ("project", "name", "title", "projectName"):
        if isinstance(raw_json, dict) and isinstance(raw_json.get(k), str):
            rec["name"] = rec["name"] or raw_json[k][:120]
            break
    rec["assets"] = _dedupe(rec["assets"], lambda a: (a["addr"] or a["url"] or a["desc"]).lower())
    rec["rewards"] = _dedupe(rec["rewards"], lambda r: (r["tier"], r["max"]))
    for k in rec["exclusions"]:
        rec["exclusions"][k] = list(dict.fromkeys(rec["exclusions"][k]))[:14]
    rec["template"] = list(dict.fromkeys(rec["template"]))[:12]


def _dedupe(items, key):
    seen, out = set(), []
    for it in items:
        k = key(it)
        if not k or k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        out.append(it)
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- render

def render(rec, url=""):
    """Normalized markdown in the shape the contract parser already reads."""
    out = ["# %s" % (rec["name"] or "program"), ""]
    if url:
        out += [url, ""]
    out += ["## Assets in scope", ""]
    if rec["assets"]:
        out += ["| Contract | Address | Chain |", "|---|---|---|"]
        for a in rec["assets"][:120]:
            out.append("| %s | %s | %s |" % (a["desc"][:120], a["addr"] or a["url"] or "-",
                                             a["chain"] or "-"))
    else:
        out.append("- none resolved")
    out += ["", "## Rewards", "", "| Tier | Definition | Band |", "|---|---|---|"]
    for r in rec["rewards"][:20]:
        out.append("| %s | %s | $%s |" % (r["tier"].title(), r["definition"][:200], r["max"]))
    if not rec["rewards"]:
        out.append("| - | none resolved | - |")
    out += ["", "## Proof of concept", ""]
    if rec["poc"]:
        for k, v in rec["poc"].items():
            if v:
                out.append("- %s: %s" % (k.replace("_", " "), v))
    else:
        out.append("- no explicit PoC clause")
    if rec["template"]:
        out += ["", "## Report template", "", "```"] + \
               ["%s:" % h for h in rec["template"]] + ["```"]
    out += ["", "## Out of scope", ""]
    for k, label in (("surfaces", "surfaces"), ("non_vulns", "not a vulnerability"),
                     ("non_submissions", "not a submission")):
        if rec["exclusions"][k]:
            out.append("### %s" % label)
            out += ["- %s" % s for s in rec["exclusions"][k]]
            out.append("")
    out += ["", "## Submission", ""]
    if rec["submit"]["address"]:
        out.append("- channel: %s" % (rec["submit"]["channel"] or "?"))
        out.append("- to: %s" % rec["submit"]["address"])
    if rec["submit"]["subject"]:
        out.append("- subject: %s" % rec["submit"]["subject"])
    if rec["policy"]:
        out += ["", "## Policy", "", rec["policy"][:20000]]
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- adapters

class Adapter:
    name = "generic"
    detail = ()
    listing = ()

    def json_urls(self, url):
        return [t % self._slug(url) for t in self.detail]

    def _slug(self, url):
        p = urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path.strip("/")
        return [s for s in p.split("/") if s][-1] if p else ""

    def extract(self, raw):
        rec = blank()
        collect(rec, raw)
        return rec


class Hackenproof(Adapter):
    name = "hackenproof"
    detail = ("https://hackenproof.com/api/programs/%s/detail",
              "https://hackenproof.com/api/programs/%s")
    listing = ("https://hackenproof.com/programs",)

class Github(Adapter):
    name = "github"
    detail = ()

    def json_urls(self, url):
        m = re.search(r"github\.com/([\w.-]+/[\w.-]+)", url)
        if not m:
            return []
        repo = m.group(1)
        return ["https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/HEAD/README.md" % repo,
                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/HEAD/SECURITY.md" % repo,
                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/HEAD/.github/SECURITY.md" % repo]


class Generic(Adapter):
    name = "generic"


ADAPTERS = [Hackenproof(), Code4rena(), Sherlock(), Cantina(), Bugcrowd(), HackerOne(),
            Intigriti(), YesWeHack(), Hats(), Mor(), Github()]
GENERIC = Generic()


def adapter_for(url):
    h = host_of(url)
    for a in ADAPTERS:
        for host in getattr(a, "listing", ()) + ("https://%s/" % h,):
            if host_of(host) == h:
                return a
    return GENERIC


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- tiers

NEXT = re.compile(r'id=["\']__NEXT_DATA__["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</script>', re.S)
NUXT = re.compile(r"window\.__NUXT__\s*=\s*(\{.*?\});?\s*</script>", re.S)
STATE = re.compile(r"window\.__(?:INITIAL_STATE|APOLLO_STATE|PRELOADED_STATE|DATA)__\s*=\s*"
                   r"(\{.*?\});?\s*</script>", re.S)
LDJSON = re.compile(r'<script[^>]*type=["\']application/(?:ld\+)?json["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</script>',
                    re.S | re.I)


def embedded_objects(html):
    out = []
    for rx in (NEXT, NUXT, STATE, LDJSON):
        for m in rx.finditer(html):
            raw = m.group(1).strip()
            if len(raw) < 60:
                continue
            try:
                out.append(json.loads(raw))
            except Exception:
                continue
    return out


def html_text(html):
    t = re.sub(r"(?is)<(script|style|svg|noscript)[^>]*>.*?</\1>", " ", html)
    t = re.sub(r"(?i)</(h[1-6]|p|tr|li|div|table|section)>", "\n", t)
    t = re.sub(r"(?i)<h([1-6])[^>]*>", lambda m: "\n%s " % ("#" * int(m.group(1))), t)
    t = re.sub(r"(?is)<td[^>]*>", " | ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"(?is)<th[^>]*>", " | ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"(?s)<[^>]+>", " ", t)
    t = (t.replace("&amp;", "&").replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">")
         .replace("&quot;", '"').replace("&#39;", "'").replace("&nbsp;", " "))
    t = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", t)
    return re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", t).strip()


def _usable(res):
    return res.markdown.strip() and not res.thin


def resolve(pid, url, cookie="", reader="", fetch=None, log=None):
    """Try every tier. Returns a Result, never None."""
    log = log or (lambda m: None)
    a = adapter_for(url)
    best = Result(adapter=a.name, url=url)
    ok, why = program_url_ok(url)
    if not ok:
        best.problems.append("url shape: " + why)
    fetch = fetch or (lambda u, c="": ("", ""))

    for ju in a.json_urls(url):
        try:
            body, _ = fetch(ju, cookie)
        except Exception as ex:
            log("detail: api %s -> %s" % (ju.split("//")[-1][:60], str(ex)[:60]))
            continue
        if not body or not body.strip():
            log("detail: api empty %s" % ju.split("//")[-1][:60])
            continue
        raw = None
        s = body.lstrip()
        if s[:1] in "{[ ":
            try:
                raw = json.loads(s)
            except Exception:
                raw = None
        if raw is None:
            md = html_text(body)
            if len(md) > 200:
                res = Result(adapter=a.name, tier="api-text", markdown=md, url=url)
                _scan_text(res.rec, md)
                res.markdown = render(res.rec, url) if not res.thin else md
                log("detail: api text %s (%d bytes)" % (ju.split("//")[-1][:50], len(md)))
                if _usable(res):
                    return _finish(res, log)
                if not best.markdown:
                    best = res
            continue
        rec = a.extract(raw)
        if not rec["assets"] and not rec["rewards"]:
            log("detail: api parsed but empty %s" % ju.split("//")[-1][:50])
            continue
        res = Result(adapter=a.name, tier="api", rec=rec, url=url)
        res.markdown = render(rec, url)
        log("detail: api %s -> %d asset(s), %d tier(s)"
            % (ju.split("//")[-1][:50], len(rec["assets"]), len(rec["rewards"])))
        return _finish(res, log)

    try:
        html, _ = fetch(url, cookie)
    except Exception as ex:
        html = ""
        log("detail: page -> %s" % str(ex)[:70])
    if html and html.strip():
        objs = embedded_objects(html)
        if objs:
            rec = blank()
            for o in objs:
                collect(rec, o)
            if rec["assets"] or rec["rewards"] or rec["poc_any"]:
                res = Result(adapter=a.name, tier="embedded", rec=rec, url=url)
                res.markdown = render(rec, url)
                log("detail: embedded json -> %d asset(s), %d tier(s)"
                    % (len(rec["assets"]), len(rec["rewards"])))
                return _finish(res, log)
            log("detail: %d embedded blob(s), nothing usable" % len(objs))
        md = html_text(html)
        if len(md) > 400:
            res = Result(adapter=a.name, tier="html", markdown=md, url=url)
            _scan_text(res.rec, md)
            log("detail: html text %d bytes, %d asset(s) by regex"
                % (len(md), len(res.rec["assets"])))
            if res.rec["assets"] or res.rec["rewards"]:
                res.markdown = render(res.rec, url) + "\n\n## Page text\n\n" + md[:40000]
                return _finish(res, log)
            best = res
    if reader:
        try:
            body = fetch(reader + url, "x-return-format: markdown")[0]
        except Exception:
            body = ""
        if body and len(body) > 400:
            res = Result(adapter=a.name, tier="reader", markdown=body, url=url)
            _scan_text(res.rec, body)
            log("detail: reader %d bytes, %d asset(s) by regex"
                % (len(body), len(res.rec["assets"])))
            if res.rec["assets"] or res.rec["rewards"]:
                res.markdown = render(res.rec, url) + "\n\n## Page text\n\n" + body[:40000]
                return _finish(res, log)
            if not best.markdown:
                best = res
    if not best.markdown:
        best.problems.append("no tier produced a body")
    return _finish(best, log)


def _scan_text(rec, text):
    """Regex-only salvage from visible text. Never claims what it cannot see."""
    for m in EXPLORER_RE.finditer(text):
        rec["assets"].append({"desc": "contract", "url": m.group(0), "type": "smart_contract",
                              "chain": chain_for(m.group(1), ""), "addr": m.group(2)})
    for m in ADDR_RE.finditer(text):
        if not any(a["addr"].lower() == m.group(0).lower() for a in rec["assets"]):
            rec["assets"].append({"desc": "address", "url": "", "type": "smart_contract",
                                  "chain": "eth", "addr": m.group(0)})
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://github\.com/[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+", text):
        rec["assets"].append({"desc": "repository", "url": m.group(0), "type": "repository",
                              "chain": "", "addr": ""})
    for m in re.finditer(r"\|[^\n|]{0,40}\b(Critical|High|Medium|Low)\b[^\n|]{0,40}\|"
                         r"[^\n|]{0,300}\|", text, re.I):
        seg = m.group(0)
        band = 0
        for n in re.findall(r"\$\s?([\d,]{3,})", seg):
            band = max(band, money(n))
        rec["rewards"].append({"tier": m.group(1).lower(), "max": band,
                               "definition": re.sub(r"\s+", " ", seg)[:200]})
    low = text.lower()
    if re.search(r"proof of concept|poc\b", low):
        rec["poc_any"] = True
        if re.search(r"no poc|poc (?:is )?(?:required|mandatory)", low):
            rec["poc"]["required"] = True
    if re.search(r"foundry|forge test", low):
        rec["poc"]["framework"] = "foundry"
    for m in re.finditer(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.]+", text):
        if re.search(r"security|bounty|dev|sec", m.group(0), re.I):
            rec["submit"]["channel"] = rec["submit"]["channel"] or "email"
            rec["submit"]["address"] = rec["submit"]["address"] or m.group(0)
            break
    rec["assets"] = _dedupe(rec["assets"], lambda a: (a["addr"] or a["url"] or "").lower())
    rec["rewards"] = _dedupe(rec["rewards"], lambda r: (r["tier"], r["max"]))


def _finish(res, log):
    rec = res.rec
    if not rec["assets"]:
        res.problems.append("no scope asset")
    if not rec["rewards"]:
        res.problems.append("no reward tier")
    if not (rec["poc_any"] or rec["poc"]):
        res.problems.append("no poc clause")
    if not rec["submit"]["address"]:
        res.problems.append("no submission channel")
    if res.thin:
        log("detail: THIN (%s)" % ", ".join(res.problems))
    return res


def manual(pid, text, url=""):
    """Tier 5: a human pasted the program text."""
    rec = blank()
    _scan_text(rec, text)
    collect(rec, {"pasted": text})
    res = Result(adapter="manual", tier="manual", rec=rec, url=url)
    res.markdown = render(rec, url) + "\n\n## Page text\n\n" + text[:200000]
    return _finish(res, lambda m: None)


def probe(pid, url):
    """Which adapter matches and which fields each tier would resolve."""
    a = adapter_for(url)
    ok, why = program_url_ok(url)
    return {"adapter": a.name, "url_ok": ok, "url_reason": why,
            "api_candidates": a.json_urls(url), "tiers": list(TIERS),
            "reserved": [s for s in urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path.split("/")
                         if s in RESERVED]}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""BountyHunter 10 - local bounty engine, fund-theft weighted, no paid-entry platforms.

Two-phase recon. Phase one touches only the network: detail resolution, contract,
scope, onchain source, value census, surface confirmation. Phase two - clone,
stage, type, deps, build - runs only when phase one produced real details.
Nothing is downloaded on a guess.

Money classes outrank cosmetics. Every finding is scored by how close it sits to
a balance, and the ladder refuses to land a cycle under THRESHOLD.

Details come from the best available tier per host: platform JSON, embedded
__NEXT_DATA__, visible text, reader proxy, or a manual paste. A record with no
scope, no tier and no PoC clause parks the target instead of pretending.

Web-only programs are detected after scope, skip the repo hunt, and probe the
project's own app domain instead of the listing host or a CDN asset.

Every outbound request goes through one global slot, one at a time, with a gap
that widens on 429/403 and decays when the host is calm. Repos are confirmed
over plain HTTPS, so neither a rate limit nor a credential prompt can block
recon.

Ladder: L0 recon, L1 static, L2 symbolic, L3 dynamic, L4 adversarial, L5 hammer.
"""

def load_env():
    if not ENVF.exists():
        return
    for raw in ENVF.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"').strip("'"))

def _clean_url(u):
    """Tolerant of a doubled scheme: 'https:https://host' -> 'https://host'."""
    u = (u or "").strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    u = re.sub(r"^https?://", "", u)
    u = re.sub(r"^https?:(?:/{2})?", "", u)
    u = re.sub(r"^/+", "", u)
    return ("https://" + u) if u else ""


def _env_url(*names):
    for n in names:
        v = _clean_url(os.environ.get(n, ""))
        if v:
            return v
    return ""

    return "https://%s.g.alchemy.com/v2/%s" % (net, ALCHEMY_KEY)

# ============================ NETWORK: ONE AT A TIME =========================

NET_LOCK = threading.Lock()
NET_LAST = [0.0]
NET_PENALTY = [0.0]
NET_GAP = float(os.environ.get("BH_NET_GAP", "1.2"))
HOST_GAP = {"api.github.com": 1.6, "github.com": 0.6, "raw.githubusercontent.com": 1.0,
            "hackerone.com": 1.0, "bugcrowd.com": 1.0, "hackenproof.com": 1.0,
            "code4rena.com": 1.0, "mor.org": 2.0}
HOST_LAST = {}


def _net_wait(host):
    gap = max(NET_GAP + NET_PENALTY[0], HOST_GAP.get(host, 0.0))
    wait = gap - (time.time() - max(NET_LAST[0], HOST_LAST.get(host, 0.0)))
    if wait > 0:
        time.sleep(wait)


def fetch(url, headers=None, timeout=45, data=None, want_headers=False, limit=4000000):
    h = dict(UA)
    if headers:
        h.update(headers)
    host = urllib.parse.urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
    with NET_LOCK:
        _net_wait(host)
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h, data=data)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                body = r.read(limit).decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
                hd = "\n".join("%s: %s" % (k, v) for k, v in r.headers.items()) \
                    if want_headers else None
            NET_PENALTY[0] = max(0.0, NET_PENALTY[0] - 0.6)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
            if ex.code in (429, 403):
                NET_PENALTY[0] = min(25.0, NET_PENALTY[0] + 4)
            raise
        finally:
            NET_LAST[0] = time.time()
            HOST_LAST[host] = NET_LAST[0]
    return (body, hd) if want_headers else body


class _NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, *a, **kw):
        return None


def fetch_noredirect(url, headers=None, timeout=15):
    """Status and headers only, 3xx returned instead of followed."""
    h = dict(UA)
    if headers:
        h.update(headers)
    host = urllib.parse.urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
    op = urllib.request.build_opener(_NoRedirect)
    with NET_LOCK:
        _net_wait(host)
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h)
            try:
                with op.open(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                    return r.status, dict(r.headers), r.read(4000).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
                return ex.code, dict(ex.headers), ""
        finally:
            NET_LAST[0] = time.time()
            HOST_LAST[host] = NET_LAST[0]


def fetch_host(url, cookie="", want_headers=False):
    h = {}
    if cookie:
        if ":" in cookie and cookie.split(":", 1)[0].strip().lower().startswith("x-"):
            k, v = cookie.split(":", 1)
            h[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        else:
            h["Cookie"] = cookie
    if GH_TOKEN and "api.github.com" in url:
        h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + GH_TOKEN
    return fetch(url, headers=h, want_headers=want_headers)


def _detail_fetch(url, cookie=""):
    """Tuple-returning fetch for the resolver."""
    return fetch_host(url, cookie, want_headers=True)


def fetch_json(url, headers=None, tries=3):
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            body = fetch(url, headers=headers)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
            if ex.code in (403, 429):
                time.sleep(4 * (i + 1))
                continue
            raise
        except Exception:
            if i == tries - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(2 * (i + 1))
            continue
        s = body.lstrip()
        if not s or s[0] not in "{[[ ":
            if i == tries - 1:
                raise ValueError("non-JSON body (%d bytes)" % len(body))
            time.sleep(2 * (i + 1))
            continue
        try:
            return json.loads(s)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            if i == tries - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(2 * (i + 1))
    raise ValueError("fetch_json exhausted")


def read_via(url):
    """Reader proxy - turns a WAF-blocked SPA into plain markdown."""
    if not READER:
        return ""
    try:
        return fetch(READER + url, headers={"x-return-format": "markdown"}, timeout=90)
    except Exception:
        return ""


def rpc(chain, method, params):
    url = CHAINS.get(chain, {}).get("rpc")
    if not url:
        return None
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method,
                       "params": params}).encode()
    try:
        js = json.loads(fetch(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                              data=body, timeout=25))
    except Exception:
        return None
    return js.get("result")


def eth_call(chain, to, data):
    return rpc(chain, "eth_call", [{"to": to, "data": data}, "latest"])


def fork_block(chain):
    env = os.environ.get("BH_FORK_BLOCK_%s" % (chain or "").upper(), "").strip()
    for v in (env, FORK_BLOCK):
        if v.isdigit() and int(v) > 0:
            return int(v)
    return FORK_BLOCKS.get(chain or "", 0)


def safe_fork_block(chain):
    """Configured pin, clamped under the live head so forge never forks the future."""
    want = fork_block(chain)
    head = 0
    try:
        h = rpc(chain, "eth_blockNumber", [])
        if h:
            head = int(h, 16)
    except Exception:
        head = 0
    if not head:
        return want
    if want and want < head:
        return want
    return max(1, head - FORK_OFFSET)


@contextmanager
def db():
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=60, isolation_level=None)
    c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    c.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    c.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
    c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=60000")
    try:
        yield c
    finally:
        c.close()


def init():
    WORK.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with db() as c:
        c.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE, url TEXT,
          toolchain TEXT, max INTEGER, bar TEXT, poc TEXT, contact TEXT, baseline TEXT, dupe TEXT,
          rank INTEGER, status TEXT DEFAULT 'idle', stage TEXT DEFAULT '', attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
          escalation INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cycle INTEGER DEFAULT 0, notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
          added REAL, updated REAL, last_run REAL DEFAULT 0, address_mode INTEGER DEFAULT 0);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS log(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pid INTEGER, ts REAL, line TEXT);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pid INTEGER, sev TEXT, title TEXT,
          cls TEXT, file TEXT, line INTEGER DEFAULT 1, root TEXT, impact TEXT, poc TEXT,
          evidence TEXT, gate TEXT, state TEXT DEFAULT 'draft', created REAL);
        """)
        c.execute("DELETE FROM log WHERE ts < ?", (time.time() - 7 * 86400,))
        pcols = [r[1] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(projects)")]
        for col, decl in (("slug", "TEXT"), ("brief_ok", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                          ("auto", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"), ("type_hint", "TEXT"),
                          ("type_locked", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("type_evidence", "TEXT"),
                          ("type_conf", "TEXT DEFAULT 'none'"), ("type_all", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
                          ("cond_ok", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("readiness", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                          ("details_ok", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("targets_n", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                          ("repairs", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("tvl", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                          ("fund_hits", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0")):
            if col not in pcols:
                c.execute("ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN %s %s" % (col, decl))
        fcols = [r[1] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(findings)")]
        for col, decl in (("eligible", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"), ("line", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
                          ("score", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("blockers", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
                          ("reward", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("poc_path", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
                          ("judged", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("stale", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                          ("fund", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0")):
            if col not in fcols:
                c.execute("ALTER TABLE findings ADD COLUMN %s %s" % (col, decl))
        c.execute("UPDATE findings SET judged=0 WHERE judged IS NULL")
        c.execute("UPDATE findings SET blockers='[]' WHERE blockers IS NULL")
        for p in CATALOG:
            if not c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE name=?", (p["name"],)).fetchone():
                c.execute(INS_PROJECT,
                          (p["name"], p["url"], "unknown", p["max"], p["bar"], p["poc"],
                           p["contact"], p["baseline"], p["dupe"], p["rank"], time.time(),
                           time.time(), slugify(p["name"])))
                c.execute("UPDATE projects SET type_hint=? WHERE name=?",
                          (p["toolchain"], p["name"]))
        for r in c.execute("SELECT id,name FROM projects WHERE slug IS NULL OR slug=''"):
            c.execute("UPDATE projects SET slug=? WHERE id=?", (slugify(r["name"]), r["id"]))
        c.execute("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_proj_slug ON projects(slug)")


def setp(pid, **kw):
    if not kw:
        return
    cols = ", ".join("%s=?" % k for k in kw)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET %s, updated=? WHERE id=?" % cols,
                  list(kw.values()) + [time.time(), pid])


def getp(pid):
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None


def slugify(name, pid=0):
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", (name or "").lower()).strip("-")[:48] or "target"
    base, n = s, 2
    with db() as c:
        while c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE slug=? AND id!=?", (s, pid)).fetchone():
            s, n = "%s-%d" % (base, n), n + 1
    return s


def log(pid, line):
    line = str(line)[:4000]
    with LOCK:
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO log(pid,ts,line) VALUES(?,?,?)", (pid, time.time(), line))
            r = c.execute("SELECT slug FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
            slug = (r["slug"] if r else "") or ""
    try:
        d = WORK / (slug or str(pid))
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with (d / "log.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write("%s %s\n" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), line))
    except Exception:
        pass
    print("[%s] %s" % (pid, line))


def purge(pid, keep_page=False):
    """Drop every derived artefact for one target, keep the target row."""
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return False
    stop_attack(pid)
    d = WORK / (p.get("slug") or str(pid))
    page = ""
    if keep_page and (d / "scope.txt").exists():
        page = (d / "scope.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    rmtree_force(d)
    if page:
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (d / "scope.txt").write_text(page, encoding="utf-8")
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("DELETE FROM findings WHERE pid=?", (pid,))
        c.execute("DELETE FROM log WHERE pid=?", (pid,))
        c.execute("""UPDATE projects SET toolchain='unknown', type_locked=0, type_conf='none',
                     type_evidence=NULL, type_all='[]', status='idle', stage='', attempts=0,
                     escalation=0, cycle=0, brief_ok=0, cond_ok=0, readiness=0, details_ok=0,
                     targets_n=0, address_mode=0, notes='', last_run=0, tvl=0, fund_hits=0
                     WHERE id=?""", (pid,))
    return True


def restart(pid):
    if not getp(pid):
        return False, "no project"
    purge(pid)
    log(pid, "restart: state cleared, requeueing")
    return start_attack(pid, "full")


def _clean_out(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]", "", s or "")
    s = s.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    return "".join(ch for ch in s if ch in "\n\t" or 32 <= ord(ch) < 0x3000)


def sh(cmd, cwd=None, timeout=900, env=None):
    e = dict(os.environ)
    e.setdefault("GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT", "0")
    e.setdefault("GCM_INTERACTIVE", "never")
    e.setdefault("GIT_ASKPASS", "echo")
    e["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
    if env:
        e.update(env)
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None, capture_output=True,
                           text=True, timeout=timeout, env=e, errors="replace",
                           encoding="utf-8")
        return p.returncode, _clean_out(p.stdout), _clean_out(p.stderr)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return 127, "", "not found: %s" % cmd[0]
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124, "", "timeout after %ss" % timeout


def _rm_onerr(fn, path, exc):
    try:
        os.chmod(path, stat.S_IWRITE | stat.S_IREAD)
        fn(path)
    except Exception:
        try:
            os.chmod(os.path.dirname(path), stat.S_IWRITE)
            fn(path)
        except Exception:
            pass


def rmtree_force(d):
    d = Path(d)
    if not d.exists():
        return True
    for i in range(4):
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(d, onerror=_rm_onerr)
            return True
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.4 + i * 0.5)
            sh(["cmd", "/c", "attrib", "-r", "-h", "-s", "/s", "/d", str(d) + "\\*"])
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    return not d.exists()


def norm_url(u):
    u = (u or "").strip()
    if not u.startswith("http"):
        u = "https://" + u
    host = urllib.parse.urlparse(u).netloc.lower().replace("www.", "")
    path = urllib.parse.urlparse(u).path
    if path in ("", "/"):
        return u.rstrip("/")
    if any(host.endswith(h) for h in TRAIL_SLASH_HOSTS) and not path.endswith("/"):
        return u + "/"
    return u.rstrip("/")


GH_BAD = {"en", "contact", "feature-actions", "topics", "collections", "sponsors", "orgs",
          "settings", "marketplace", "about", "site", "pricing", "readme", "security",
          "enterprise", "login", "join", "new", "explore", "trending", "apps", "users",
          "programs", "program", "bounty", "bug-bounty", "audits", "audit", "competitions",
          "engagements", "opportunities", "contests", "blog", "docs", "api", "jobs",
          "careers", "team", "privacy", "terms", "search", "dashboard", "profile"}
BAD_SEG = {"static", "css", "js", "chunks", "assets", "images", "img", "fonts", "media",
           "nuxt", "react-dom", "react", "next", "client", "server", "styles", "_next"}
ASSET_EXT = (".css", ".js", ".mjs", ".map", ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".png", ".jpg",
             ".svg", ".ico", ".json", ".html", ".md")


def repos_in(html, limit=6):
    out = []
    pat = r'(github\.com/|_next/)?([A-Za-z0-9][\w.-]{0,38})/([\w.-]{1,80})'
    for m in re.finditer(pat, html):
        prefix, owner, repo = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        if owner.lower() in GH_BAD or repo.lower() in GH_BAD:
            continue
        if repo.endswith(ASSET_EXT) or owner.lower() in BAD_SEG:
            continue
        s = "%s/%s" % (owner, repo)
        if not REPO_RE.match(s) or s in out:
            continue
        if prefix:
            out.insert(0, s)
        else:
            out.append(s)
        if len(out) >= limit * 3:
            break
    return out


def c4_repo(url):
    m = C4_REPO.search(url)
    return "code-423n4/%s" % m.group(1) if m else None


def probe_bounty(host):
    if not host or not PROBE_BOUNTY:
        return None
    for p in BOUNTY_PATHS:
        u = "https://%s%s" % (host, p)
        try:
            b = fetch(u, timeout=12)
        except Exception:
            continue
        low = b.lower()
        if "bounty" in low and ("$" in b or ADDR_RE.search(b)):
            return u
    return None


def _suffix_lang(s):
    for lang, exts in EXT.items():
        if s in exts:
            return lang
    return None


def manifest_type(root):
    root = Path(root)
    hits = []
    for lang, names in MANIFESTS:
        for n in names:
            for f in list(root.glob(n)) + list(root.glob("*/" + n)):
                if f.is_file():
                    hits.append((lang, f.name))
    if not hits:
        return None, []
    for lang, _ in MANIFESTS:
        if any(l == lang for l, _ in hits):
            return lang, hits
    return None, hits


def census(*roots):
    counts = {k: 0 for k in TYPES}
    primary = {k: 0 for k in TYPES}
    total = 0
    for root in roots:
        root = Path(root)
        if not root.exists():
            continue
        for f in root.rglob("*"):
            if not f.is_file():
                continue
            lang = _suffix_lang(f.suffix.lower())
            if not lang:
                continue
            total += 1
            parts = {p.lower() for p in f.parts}
            in_src = bool(parts & SOURCE_DIRS) or "onchain" in parts or "staged" in parts
            if parts & NOISE_DIRS and not in_src:
                continue
            counts[lang] += 1
            if in_src:
                primary[lang] += 1
    return counts, primary, total


def langs_path(pid):
    return WORK / str(pid) / "langs.json"


def read_gh_lang(pid):
    f = langs_path(pid)
    if not f.exists():
        return None
    try:
        js = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None
    for repo, lang in js.items():
        t = GH_LANG.get((lang or "").lower())
        if t and t != "web":
            return t
    return None


def docs_only(pid):
    f = langs_path(pid)
    if not f.exists():
        return False
    try:
        js = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return False
    return bool(js) and all(DOCS_RE.search(k.split("/")[-1]) for k in js)


def addr_exists(pid):
    f = WORK / str(pid) / "addresses.txt"
    return f.exists() and bool(f.read_text().strip())


def web_target(pid):
    f = WORK / str(pid) / "web_target.txt"
    if f.exists():
        u = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        if u:
            return u
    return ""


def web_only(pid):
    """Program whose scope is the app, not a contract. Only trusted after scope."""
    if addr_exists(pid):
        return False
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    if (p.get("type_locked") and (p.get("toolchain") or "") == "web"):
        return True
    f = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    if f.exists():
        low = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:400000].lower()
        if re.search(r"only (?:the )?(?:web|website|frontend|api)", low):
            return True
        if re.search(r'"(?:type|category|asset_type)"\s*:\s*"(?:web|website|frontend)"', low):
            return True
    if (WORK / str(pid) / "scoped").exists() and web_target(pid):
        return True
    if WEB_WORDS.search(p.get("name") or "") and not addr_exists(pid):
        return True
    return False


def details_ok(pid):
    """True once the program page, contract or scope has actually been retrieved."""
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    if p.get("cond_ok") or p.get("brief_ok") or p.get("details_ok"):
        return True
    if addr_exists(pid) or web_target(pid):
        return True
    m = GH_URL_RE.match(p.get("url") or "")
    return bool(m and REPO_RE.match(m.group(1)))


def langs_of(p):
    out = set()
    prim = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    if prim not in ("unknown", "web"):
        out.add(prim)
    try:
        for l in json.loads(p.get("type_all") or "[]"):
            if l not in ("unknown", "web"):
                out.add(l)
    except Exception:
        pass
    if prim == "web":
        out.add("js")
    return out


def chains_for(text):
    hits = []
    low = text.lower()
    for w, ch in CHAIN_WORDS.items():
        if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % re.escape(w), low) and ch not in hits:
            hits.append(ch)
    live = [c for c in hits if CHAINS.get(c, {}).get("rpc")]
    rest = [c for c in CHAINS if c not in hits and CHAINS[c].get("rpc")]
    return (live + rest)[:4] or ["eth"]

def note_repair(pid, kind, detail):
    REPAIR_LOG.append({"pid": pid, "kind": kind, "detail": detail, "ts": time.time()})
    del REPAIR_LOG[:-500]
    log(pid, "repair: %s - %s" % (kind, detail))


def ensure_module(name):
    try:
        __import__(name)
        return True
    except ImportError:
        pass
    pkg = MODULE_MAP.get(name, name)
    rc, out, err = sh([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", pkg], timeout=300)
    if rc == 0:
        try:
            __import__(name)
            return True
        except ImportError:
            return False
    return False


def have(binary):
    return shutil.which(binary) is not None


def classify(err):
    e = (err or "").lower()
    if "winerror 5" in e or "access is denied" in e or "permission denied" in e:
        return "locked_files"
    if "no module named" in e:
        return "missing_module"
    if "not found" in e and ("remapping" in e or "import" in e or ".sol" in e):
        return "bad_remapping"
    if "not found:" in e or "is not recognized" in e:
        return "missing_binary"
    if "expected pragma" in e or "source file requires different compiler" in e:
        return "pragma_mismatch"
    if "spdx" in e:
        return "missing_spdx"
    if "stack too deep" in e:
        return "stack_too_deep"
    if "non-json" in e or "expecting value" in e:
        return "bad_json"
    if "timeout" in e:
        return "timeout"
    if "no_files" in e:
        return "no_files"
    if "sqlite" in e or "database is locked" in e:
        return "db_locked"
    return "unknown"


def repair_locked_files(pid, root):
    rmtree_force(Path(root) / ".git")
    return "git objects unlocked"


def repair_missing_module(pid, err, root=None):
    m = re.search(r"no module named '([\w.]+)'", (err or "").lower())
    if not m:
        return False
    mod = m.group(1).split(".")[0]
    ok = ensure_module(mod)
    note_repair(pid, "module", "%s %s" % (mod, "installed" if ok else "unavailable"))
    return ok


def repair_missing_binary(pid, err, root=None):
    m = re.search(r"not found: ([\w.-]+)", (err or "").lower())
    b = m.group(1) if m else ""
    note_repair(pid, "binary", "%s missing - %s" % (b, BIN_HINTS.get(b, "skipped")))
    return False


def repair_remappings(pid, root):
    root = Path(root)
    lines = []
    for libdir in ("lib", "node_modules"):
        base = root / libdir
        if not base.exists():
            continue
        for d in base.iterdir():
            if not d.is_dir():
                continue
            name = d.name.split("@")[0]
            lines.append("%s/=%s/%s/" % (name, libdir, d.name))
            if (d / "src").exists():
                lines.append("%s/src/=%s/%s/src/" % (name, libdir, d.name))
    if not lines:
        return False
    (root / "remappings.txt").write_text("\n".join(sorted(set(lines))) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    note_repair(pid, "remapping", "%d remapping(s) rebuilt" % len(set(lines)))
    return True


def repair_forge_toml(pid, root):
    f = Path(root) / "foundry.toml"
    body = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if f.exists() else ""
    if "[profile.default]" in body:
        return False
    add = '\n[profile.default]\nsrc = "src"\nout = "out"\nlibs = ["lib"]\n'
    if "solc" not in body:
        add += 'solc_version = "0.8.24"\n'
    add += "optimizer = true\noptimizer_runs = 200\nvia_ir = false\n"
    f.write_text(body + add, encoding="utf-8")
    note_repair(pid, "forge.toml", "profile defaults written")
    return True


def repair_source(pid, root):
    root = Path(root)
    changed = 0
    for f in list(root.rglob("*.sol"))[:400]:
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        o = t
        if "SPDX-License-Identifier" not in t:
            t = "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n" + t
        t = re.sub(r"pragma solidity[^;]*;", "pragma solidity ^0.8.20;", t, count=1)
        t = re.sub(r"\bpragma\s+experimental\s+AbtEncoder\s*;", "", t)
        if t != o:
            f.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
            changed += 1
    if changed:
        note_repair(pid, "source", "%d file(s) normalized" % changed)
    return changed > 0


def run_repair(pid, kind, err="", root=None):
    try:
        root = Path(root or (WORK / str(pid) / "repo"))
        if kind == "locked_files":
            return repair_locked_files(pid, root)
        if kind == "missing_module":
            return repair_missing_module(pid, err, root)
        if kind == "missing_binary":
            return repair_missing_binary(pid, err, root)
        if kind == "bad_remapping":
            return repair_remappings(pid, root)
        if kind in ("pragma_mismatch", "missing_spdx", "stack_too_deep"):
            return repair_source(pid, root)
        if kind == "remapping":
            return repair_remappings(pid, root)
        if kind == "forge_toml":
            return repair_forge_toml(pid, root)
        if kind == "source":
            return repair_source(pid, root)
        if kind == "reclone":
            rmtree_force(root)
            note_repair(pid, "reclone", "repo tree dropped")
            return True
        if kind == "deps":
            st_deps(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root})
            return True
        if kind == "reparse":
            st_conditions(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root})
            st_scopeaddr(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root})
            return True
        if kind == "stage_onchain":
            return bool(st_onchain_stage(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root}))
        if kind == "probe_bounty":
            host = urllib.parse.urlparse((getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or "").netloc
            b = probe_bounty(host.replace("www.", ""))
            note_repair(pid, "probe_bounty", b or "no bounty page found")
            return bool(b)
        if kind == "db_locked":
            time.sleep(2)
            return True
        if kind in ("bad_json", "timeout"):
            note_repair(pid, kind, "retrying with wider budget")
            time.sleep(2)
            return True
        if kind == "no_files":
            note_repair(pid, "scope", "switching to address mode")
            return True
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "repair failed (%s): %s" % (kind, ex))
    return False


def self_check(pid=0):
    problems = []
    if sys.version_info < (3, 8):
        problems.append("python < 3.8")
    for d in (WORK, ROOT):
        try:
            t = d / ".bh_probe"
            t.write_text("x")
            t.unlink()
        except Exception:
            problems.append("unwritable: %s" % d)
    missing = [b for b in ("git", "forge", "slither", "semgrep", "aderyn", "myth", "echidna",
                           "halmos", "medusa", "gitleaks", "osv-scanner", "bandit", "gosec",
                           "cargo", "cppcheck", "nuclei") if not have(b)]
    if "git" in missing:
        problems.append("git missing - clone disabled")
    if missing:
        log(pid, "selfcheck: absent -> %s" % ", ".join(missing))
    if problems:
        log(pid, "selfcheck: " + "; ".join(problems))
    return problems


# ============================ EMBEDDED PAYLOAD ===============================

def flatten_json(obj, prefix="", out=None, cap=3000):
    if out is None:
        out = []
    if len(out) >= cap:
        return out
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            flatten_json(v, "%s.%s" % (prefix, k) if prefix else str(k), out, cap)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj[:200]:
            flatten_json(v, prefix, out, cap)
    elif isinstance(obj, (str, int, float)) and str(obj).strip():
        out.append("%s: %s" % (prefix, str(obj)[:400]))
    return out


def extract_structured(html):
    """Pull every embedded JSON payload out of a SPA shell into flat text."""
    chunks = []
    for rx in (NEXT_DATA, NUXT_DATA, INIT_STATE, JSON_SCRIPTS):
        for m in rx.finditer(html):
            raw = m.group(1).strip()
            if len(raw) < 40:
                continue
            try:
                chunks += flatten_json(json.loads(raw))
            except Exception:
                continue
    seen, out = set(), []
    for c in chunks:
        k = c[:90]
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        out.append(c)
    return "\n".join(out[:2500])


def app_urls(pid, limit=4):
    """Project-owned app hosts only: no CDNs, no namespaces, no asset files."""
    f = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    if not f.exists():
        return []
    blob = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    listing = urllib.parse.urlparse((getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or "").netloc.replace("www.", "")
    scored = []
    seen_host = set()
    for m in APP_URL_RE.finditer(blob):
        u = m.group(0).rstrip(".,);]")
        p = urllib.parse.urlparse(u)
        if not p.netloc or APP_BAD_HOST.match(p.netloc):
            continue
        if ASSET_PATH.search(p.path or ""):
            continue
        if p.netloc.replace("www.", "") in seen_host:
            continue
        seen_host.add(p.netloc.replace("www.", ""))
        score = p.path.count("/")
        if p.netloc.replace("www.", "") == listing:
            score -= 2
        if p.scheme == "https":
            score += 1
        scored.append((score, u))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
    return [u for _, u in scored[:limit]]


DETAIL_JSON = [
    ("hackerone.com", r"^https://hackerone\.com/(?:opportunities/)?([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://hackerone.com/%s.json"),
    ("bugcrowd.com", r"^https://bugcrowd\.com/engagements/([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://bugcrowd.com/engagements/%s.json"),
    ("intigriti.com", r"/programs/([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://api.intigriti.com/external/program/public?handle=%s"),
    ("code4rena.com", r"/audits/([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/code-423n4/%s/main/README.md"),
    ("hackenproof.com", r"/programs/([\w-]+)/?$", "https://hackenproof.com/api/programs/%s"),
    ("sherlock.xyz", r"/contests/([\w-]+)/?$", "https://audits.sherlock.xyz/contests/%s"),
    ("cantina.xyz", r"/competitions/([\w-]+)/?$", "https://cantina.xyz/api/competitions/%s"),
]


def detail_urls(url):
    out = []
    for host, rx, tmpl in DETAIL_JSON:
        if host not in url:
            continue
        m = re.search(rx, url)
        if m:
            out.append(tmpl % m.group(1))
        break
    out.append((url.rstrip("/") if url.endswith("/") else url) + ".json")
    return out


URL_FIX = [("hackerone.com/opportunities/", "hackerone.com/")]


def url_alternates(u):
    out = []
    for a, b in URL_FIX:
        if a in u:
            out.append(u.replace(a, b))
    out.append(u.rstrip("/") if u.endswith("/") else u + "/")
    host = urllib.parse.urlparse(u).netloc
    if host and not host.startswith("www."):
        out.append(u.replace("//" + host, "//www." + host, 1))
    return [x for x in dict.fromkeys(out) if x != u]


# ============================== GITHUB, NO QUOTA =============================

GH_CACHE = ROOT / "gh_cache.json"
GH_QUEUE = ROOT / "gh_queue.txt"
_GH_MEM = {}
_GH_LEFT = [None]
_GH_RESET = [0.0]


def _gh_load():
    if _GH_MEM:
        return
    try:
        _GH_MEM.update(json.loads(GH_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    except Exception:
        pass


def _gh_save():
    try:
        GH_CACHE.write_text(json.dumps(_GH_MEM), encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        pass


def gh_exists(full):
    """Strict existence check over plain HTTPS - no git, no quota, no false positives."""
    try:
        body = fetch("https://github.com/%s" % full, timeout=20, limit=60000)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
        return ex.code in (401, 403)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return "page not found" not in body[:5000].lower()


def _gh_budget():
    if GH_TOKEN:
        return True
    if time.time() < _GH_RESET[0]:
        return False
    return _GH_LEFT[0] is None or _GH_LEFT[0] > 5


def _gh_lang(full):
    try:
        body, hdr = fetch("https://api.github.com/repos/%s" % full,
                          headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + GH_TOKEN} if GH_TOKEN else {},
                          want_headers=True, timeout=25)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
        if ex.code in (403, 429):
            _GH_LEFT[0] = 0
            _GH_RESET[0] = time.time() + 3600
        return None
    except Exception:
        return None
    for line in (hdr or "").splitlines():
        low = line.lower()
        if low.startswith("x-ratelimit-remaining:"):
            try:
                _GH_LEFT[0] = int(line.split(":")[1].strip() or 0)
            except ValueError:
                pass
        elif low.startswith("x-ratelimit-reset:"):
            try:
                _GH_RESET[0] = float(line.split(":")[1].strip())
            except ValueError:
                pass
    try:
        return json.loads(body).get("language")
    except Exception:
        return None


def gh_enqueue(full):
    try:
        seen = set(GH_QUEUE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()) if GH_QUEUE.exists() else set()
        if full in seen:
            return
        with GH_QUEUE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(full + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def gh_meta(full):
    if "." in full.split("/")[0]:
        return None, None
    _gh_load()
    e = _GH_MEM.get(full)
    if e and time.time() - e.get("ts", 0) < 7 * 86400:
        return (True, e.get("lang")) if e.get("ok") else (None, None)
    ok = gh_exists(full)
    lang = _gh_lang(full) if (ok and _gh_budget()) else None
    _GH_MEM[full] = {"ok": ok, "lang": lang, "ts": time.time()}
    _gh_save()
    if ok and lang is None:
        gh_enqueue(full)
    return (True, lang) if ok else (None, None)


def gh_worker():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        if not GH_QUEUE.exists() or not _gh_budget():
            time.sleep(20)
            continue
        try:
            lines = GH_QUEUE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(10)
            continue
        if not lines:
            time.sleep(20)
            continue
        full = lines[0]
        lang = _gh_lang(full)
        _gh_load()
        if full in _GH_MEM:
            _GH_MEM[full]["lang"] = lang
            _GH_MEM[full]["ts"] = time.time()
            _gh_save()
        rest = lines[1:]
        if lang is None:
            rest = rest + [full]
        try:
            GH_QUEUE.write_text("\n".join(rest[:500]), encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(3)


# ================================ ETHERSCAN ==================================

_ES_CACHE = {}
_ES_LAST = [0.0]


def es_call(chain, params):
    if not ETHERSCAN_KEY:
        return None
    key = (chain, tuple(sorted(params.items())))
    if key in _ES_CACHE:
        return _ES_CACHE[key]
    gap = time.time() - _ES_LAST[0]
    if gap < 0.35:
        time.sleep(0.35 - gap)
    _ES_LAST[0] = time.time()
    q = dict(params)
    q["chainid"] = str(CHAINS.get(chain, {}).get("id", 1))
    q["apikey"] = ETHERSCAN_KEY
    url = "https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(q)
    try:
        js = fetch_json(url)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if js.get("status") == "1":
        _ES_CACHE[key] = js.get("result")
        return js.get("result")
    return None


def es_source(chain, addr):
    r = es_call(chain, {"module": "contract", "action": "getsourcecode", "address": addr})
    if not r or not isinstance(r, list) or not r:
        return None
    e = r[0]
    src = e.get("SourceCode") or ""
    if src.startswith("{{"):
        try:
            m = json.loads(src[1:-1])
            src = "\n".join(v.get("content", "") for v in m.get("sources", {}).values())
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {"name": e.get("ContractName") or "Target", "src": src,
            "abi": e.get("ABI") or "", "proxy": e.get("Proxy") == "1"}


def impl_of(chain, addr):
    for slot in (IMPL_SLOT, BEACON_SLOT):
        try:
            v = rpc(chain, "eth_getStorageAt", [addr, slot, "latest"])
            if v and v != "0x" and int(v, 16):
                a = "0x%040x" % int(v, 16)
                if ADDR_RE.fullmatch(a):
                    return a
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


# ============================ SOURCE PARSING =================================

def clean_src(t):
    t = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", " ", t, flags=re.S)
    t = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", " ", t)
    return t


def brace_span(t, i):
    if i < 0:
        return ""
    depth = 0
    for j in range(i, len(t)):
        if t[j] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif t[j] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return t[i:j + 1]
    return t[i:]


def units(src):
    t = clean_src(src)
    out = []
    for m in FN_RE.finditer(t):
        b = t.find("{", m.end(), m.end() + 600)
        out.append({"name": m.group(1), "args": m.group(2), "head": m.group(3),
                    "body": brace_span(t, b)})
    return out


FUND_CLASSES = {"drain", "flash", "share", "liquidate", "reward", "fee", "cap", "value",
                "accounting", "oracle", "proxy", "sig", "reentrancy", "math", "token",
                "erc4626", "slippage", "invariant", "chain"}
MONEY_WORDS = re.compile(
    r"\b(balance|totalassets|totalsupply|share|reserve|price|collateral|debt|borrow|"
    r"withdraw|redeem|deposit|mint|burn|sweep|skim|sync|transfer|approve|liquidat|"
    r"reward|fee|stake|unstake|harvest|flash|loan|oracle|payout|claim|refund)\w*", re.I)


def add_finding(pid, sev, title, cls, file, line, impact, poc, evidence, gate):
    key = hashlib.sha1(("%s|%s|%s|%s" % (pid, cls, file, title)).encode()).hexdigest()
    fund = 1 if cls in FUND_CLASSES else 0
    with db() as c:
        if c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM findings WHERE root=?", (key,)).fetchone():
            return None
        c.execute("INSERT INTO findings(pid,sev,title,cls,file,line,root,impact,poc,evidence,"
                  "gate,created,fund) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                  (pid, sev, title, cls, file, int(line or 1), key, impact, poc,
                   evidence[:3000], gate, time.time(), fund))
    return key


def score_findings(pid):
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=?", (pid,))]
        p = c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
        p = dict(p) if p else {}
        for r in rows:
            s = SEV_BASE.get(r["sev"], 10)
            ev = (r["evidence"] or "").lower()
            fp = (r["file"] or "").lower().replace("\\", "/")
            hay = "%s %s %s" % (r["cls"], r["title"], ev)
            money = len(set(m.group(0).lower() for m in MONEY_WORDS.finditer(hay)))
            s += min(30, money * 4)
            if r.get("fund") or r["cls"] in FUND_CLASSES:
                s += 14
            if "external call" in ev or "delegatecall" in ev:
                s += 8
            if "value" in ev or "balance" in ev or "ether" in ev:
                s += 7
            if "public" in ev or "external" in ev:
                s += 5
            if "/test" in fp or fp.startswith("test/"):
                s -= 10
            if "/example" in fp or "/mock" in fp or "/interfaces/" in fp or "/lib/" in fp:
                s -= 8
            if (p.get("dupe") or "") == "high":
                s -= 6
            if (p.get("max") or 0) >= 100000:
                s += 3
            tvl = p.get("tvl") or 0
            if tvl >= 10 ** 21:
                s += 8
            elif tvl >= 10 ** 19:
                s += 5
            elif tvl > 0:
                s += 2
            s += BAND.get(r["sev"], 0) // 2
            if (r["gate"] or "").startswith("H"):
                s += 6
            if (r["gate"] or "").startswith("F"):
                s += 5
            r["score"] = max(1, min(100, s))
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET score=? WHERE id=?", (r["score"], r["id"]))
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r["score"])
    return rows


def best_score(pid):
    with db() as c:
        sevs = [x[0] for x in c.execute(
            "SELECT sev FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1", (pid,))]
    for s in SEV_ORDER:
        if s in sevs:
            return s
    return None


def best_rank(pid):
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT MAX(score) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1",
                      (pid,)).fetchone()
    return int(r[0] or 0) if r else 0


TOOLS = {}


def files_for(root, langs, cap=500):
    root = Path(root)
    exts = set()
    for l in langs:
        exts.update(EXT.get(l, []))
    out = []
    if not root.exists():
        return out
    for f in root.rglob("*"):
        if len(out) >= cap:
            break
        if not f.is_file() or f.suffix.lower() not in exts:
            continue
        if SKIP_DIRS & set(p.lower() for p in f.parts):
            continue
        out.append(f)
    return out


def sol_files(root):
    return files_for(root, ("solidity",), 400)


def rel(root, f):
    try:
        return str(Path(f).relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/")
    except Exception:
        return str(f)


def ln(t, i):
    return t[:i].count("\n") + 1


def snip(t, i, n=160):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t[i:i + n]).strip()
