def note_repair(pid, kind, detail):
    REPAIR_LOG.append({"pid": pid, "kind": kind, "detail": detail, "ts": time.time()})
    del REPAIR_LOG[:-500]
    log(pid, "repair: %s - %s" % (kind, detail))


def ensure_module(name):
    try:
        __import__(name)
        return True
    except ImportError:
        pass
    pkg = MODULE_MAP.get(name, name)
    rc, out, err = sh([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", pkg], timeout=300)
    if rc == 0:
        try:
            __import__(name)
            return True
        except ImportError:
            return False
    return False


def have(binary):
    return shutil.which(binary) is not None


def classify(err):
    e = (err or "").lower()
    if "winerror 5" in e or "access is denied" in e or "permission denied" in e:
        return "locked_files"
    if "no module named" in e:
        return "missing_module"
    if "not found" in e and ("remapping" in e or "import" in e or ".sol" in e):
        return "bad_remapping"
    if "not found:" in e or "is not recognized" in e:
        return "missing_binary"
    if "expected pragma" in e or "source file requires different compiler" in e:
        return "pragma_mismatch"
    if "spdx" in e:
        return "missing_spdx"
    if "stack too deep" in e:
        return "stack_too_deep"
    if "non-json" in e or "expecting value" in e:
        return "bad_json"
    if "timeout" in e:
        return "timeout"
    if "no_files" in e:
        return "no_files"
    if "sqlite" in e or "database is locked" in e:
        return "db_locked"
    return "unknown"


def repair_locked_files(pid, root):
    rmtree_force(Path(root) / ".git")
    return "git objects unlocked"


def repair_missing_module(pid, err, root=None):
    m = re.search(r"no module named '([\w.]+)'", (err or "").lower())
    if not m:
        return False
    mod = m.group(1).split(".")[0]
    ok = ensure_module(mod)
    note_repair(pid, "module", "%s %s" % (mod, "installed" if ok else "unavailable"))
    return ok


def repair_missing_binary(pid, err, root=None):
    m = re.search(r"not found: ([\w.-]+)", (err or "").lower())
    b = m.group(1) if m else ""
    note_repair(pid, "binary", "%s missing - %s" % (b, BIN_HINTS.get(b, "skipped")))
    return False


def repair_remappings(pid, root):
    root = Path(root)
    lines = []
    for libdir in ("lib", "node_modules"):
        base = root / libdir
        if not base.exists():
            continue
        for d in base.iterdir():
            if not d.is_dir():
                continue
            name = d.name.split("@")[0]
            lines.append("%s/=%s/%s/" % (name, libdir, d.name))
            if (d / "src").exists():
                lines.append("%s/src/=%s/%s/src/" % (name, libdir, d.name))
    if not lines:
        return False
    (root / "remappings.txt").write_text("\n".join(sorted(set(lines))) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    note_repair(pid, "remapping", "%d remapping(s) rebuilt" % len(set(lines)))
    return True


def repair_forge_toml(pid, root):
    f = Path(root) / "foundry.toml"
    body = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if f.exists() else ""
    if "[profile.default]" in body:
        return False
    add = '\n[profile.default]\nsrc = "src"\nout = "out"\nlibs = ["lib"]\n'
    if "solc" not in body:
        add += 'solc_version = "0.8.24"\n'
    add += "optimizer = true\noptimizer_runs = 200\nvia_ir = false\n"
    f.write_text(body + add, encoding="utf-8")
    note_repair(pid, "forge.toml", "profile defaults written")
    return True


def repair_source(pid, root):
    root = Path(root)
    changed = 0
    for f in list(root.rglob("*.sol"))[:400]:
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        o = t
        if "SPDX-License-Identifier" not in t:
            t = "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n" + t
        t = re.sub(r"pragma solidity[^;]*;", "pragma solidity ^0.8.20;", t, count=1)
        t = re.sub(r"\bpragma\s+experimental\s+AbtEncoder\s*;", "", t)
        if t != o:
            f.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
            changed += 1
    if changed:
        note_repair(pid, "source", "%d file(s) normalized" % changed)
    return changed > 0


def run_repair(pid, kind, err="", root=None):
    try:
        root = Path(root or (WORK / str(pid) / "repo"))
        if kind == "locked_files":
            return repair_locked_files(pid, root)
        if kind == "missing_module":
            return repair_missing_module(pid, err, root)
        if kind == "missing_binary":
            return repair_missing_binary(pid, err, root)
        if kind == "bad_remapping":
            return repair_remappings(pid, root)
        if kind in ("pragma_mismatch", "missing_spdx", "stack_too_deep"):
            return repair_source(pid, root)
        if kind == "remapping":
            return repair_remappings(pid, root)
        if kind == "forge_toml":
            return repair_forge_toml(pid, root)
        if kind == "source":
            return repair_source(pid, root)
        if kind == "reclone":
            rmtree_force(root)
            note_repair(pid, "reclone", "repo tree dropped")
            return True
        if kind == "deps":
            st_deps(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root})
            return True
        if kind == "reparse":
            st_conditions(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root})
            st_scopeaddr(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root})
            return True
        if kind == "stage_onchain":
            return bool(st_onchain_stage(pid, {"pid": pid, "root": root}))
        if kind == "probe_bounty":
            host = urllib.parse.urlparse((getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or "").netloc
            b = probe_bounty(host.replace("www.", ""))
            note_repair(pid, "probe_bounty", b or "no bounty page found")
            return bool(b)
        if kind == "db_locked":
            time.sleep(2)
            return True
        if kind in ("bad_json", "timeout"):
            note_repair(pid, kind, "retrying with wider budget")
            time.sleep(2)
            return True
        if kind == "no_files":
            note_repair(pid, "scope", "switching to address mode")
            return True
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "repair failed (%s): %s" % (kind, ex))
    return False


def self_check(pid=0):
    problems = []
    if sys.version_info < (3, 8):
        problems.append("python < 3.8")
    for d in (WORK, ROOT):
        try:
            t = d / ".bh_probe"
            t.write_text("x")
            t.unlink()
        except Exception:
            problems.append("unwritable: %s" % d)
    missing = [b for b in ("git", "forge", "slither", "semgrep", "aderyn", "myth", "echidna",
                           "halmos", "medusa", "gitleaks", "osv-scanner", "bandit", "gosec",
                           "cargo", "cppcheck", "nuclei") if not have(b)]
    if "git" in missing:
        problems.append("git missing - clone disabled")
    if missing:
        log(pid, "selfcheck: absent -> %s" % ", ".join(missing))
    if problems:
        log(pid, "selfcheck: " + "; ".join(problems))
    return problems


# ============================ EMBEDDED PAYLOAD ===============================

def flatten_json(obj, prefix="", out=None, cap=3000):
    if out is None:
        out = []
    if len(out) >= cap:
        return out
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            flatten_json(v, "%s.%s" % (prefix, k) if prefix else str(k), out, cap)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj[:200]:
            flatten_json(v, prefix, out, cap)
    elif isinstance(obj, (str, int, float)) and str(obj).strip():
        out.append("%s: %s" % (prefix, str(obj)[:400]))
    return out


def extract_structured(html):
    """Pull every embedded JSON payload out of a SPA shell into flat text."""
    chunks = []
    for rx in (NEXT_DATA, NUXT_DATA, INIT_STATE, JSON_SCRIPTS):
        for m in rx.finditer(html):
            raw = m.group(1).strip()
            if len(raw) < 40:
                continue
            try:
                chunks += flatten_json(json.loads(raw))
            except Exception:
                continue
    seen, out = set(), []
    for c in chunks:
        k = c[:90]
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        out.append(c)
    return "\n".join(out[:2500])


def app_urls(pid, limit=4):
    """Project-owned app hosts only: no CDNs, no namespaces, no asset files."""
    f = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    if not f.exists():
        return []
    blob = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    listing = urllib.parse.urlparse((getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or "").netloc.replace("www.", "")
    scored = []
    seen_host = set()
    for m in APP_URL_RE.finditer(blob):
        u = m.group(0).rstrip(".,);]")
        p = urllib.parse.urlparse(u)
        if not p.netloc or APP_BAD_HOST.match(p.netloc):
            continue
        if ASSET_PATH.search(p.path or ""):
            continue
        if p.netloc.replace("www.", "") in seen_host:
            continue
        seen_host.add(p.netloc.replace("www.", ""))
        score = p.path.count("/")
        if p.netloc.replace("www.", "") == listing:
            score -= 2
        if p.scheme == "https":
            score += 1
        scored.append((score, u))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
    return [u for _, u in scored[:limit]]


DETAIL_JSON = [
    ("hackerone.com", r"^https://hackerone\.com/(?:opportunities/)?([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://hackerone.com/%s.json"),
    ("bugcrowd.com", r"^https://bugcrowd\.com/engagements/([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://bugcrowd.com/engagements/%s.json"),
    ("intigriti.com", r"/programs/([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://api.intigriti.com/external/program/public?handle=%s"),
    ("code4rena.com", r"/audits/([\w-]+)/?$",
     "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/code-423n4/%s/main/README.md"),
    ("hackenproof.com", r"/programs/([\w-]+)/?$", "https://hackenproof.com/api/programs/%s"),
    ("sherlock.xyz", r"/contests/([\w-]+)/?$", "https://audits.sherlock.xyz/contests/%s"),
    ("cantina.xyz", r"/competitions/([\w-]+)/?$", "https://cantina.xyz/api/competitions/%s"),
]


def detail_urls(url):
    out = []
    for host, rx, tmpl in DETAIL_JSON:
        if host not in url:
            continue
        m = re.search(rx, url)
        if m:
            out.append(tmpl % m.group(1))
        break
    out.append((url.rstrip("/") if url.endswith("/") else url) + ".json")
    return out


URL_FIX = [("hackerone.com/opportunities/", "hackerone.com/")]


def url_alternates(u):
    out = []
    for a, b in URL_FIX:
        if a in u:
            out.append(u.replace(a, b))
    out.append(u.rstrip("/") if u.endswith("/") else u + "/")
    host = urllib.parse.urlparse(u).netloc
    if host and not host.startswith("www."):
        out.append(u.replace("//" + host, "//www." + host, 1))
    return [x for x in dict.fromkeys(out) if x != u]


# ============================== GITHUB, NO QUOTA =============================

GH_CACHE = ROOT / "gh_cache.json"
GH_QUEUE = ROOT / "gh_queue.txt"
_GH_MEM = {}
_GH_LEFT = [None]
_GH_RESET = [0.0]


def _gh_load():
    if _GH_MEM:
        return
    try:
        _GH_MEM.update(json.loads(GH_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    except Exception:
        pass


def _gh_save():
    try:
        GH_CACHE.write_text(json.dumps(_GH_MEM), encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        pass


def gh_exists(full):
    """Strict existence check over plain HTTPS - no git, no quota, no false positives."""
    try:
        body = fetch("https://github.com/%s" % full, timeout=20, limit=60000)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
        return ex.code in (401, 403)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return "page not found" not in body[:5000].lower()


def _gh_budget():
    if GH_TOKEN:
        return True
    if time.time() < _GH_RESET[0]:
        return False
    return _GH_LEFT[0] is None or _GH_LEFT[0] > 5


def _gh_lang(full):
    try:
        body, hdr = fetch("https://api.github.com/repos/%s" % full,
                          headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + GH_TOKEN} if GH_TOKEN else {},
                          want_headers=True, timeout=25)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
        if ex.code in (403, 429):
            _GH_LEFT[0] = 0
            _GH_RESET[0] = time.time() + 3600
        return None
    except Exception:
        return None
    for line in (hdr or "").splitlines():
        low = line.lower()
        if low.startswith("x-ratelimit-remaining:"):
            try:
                _GH_LEFT[0] = int(line.split(":")[1].strip() or 0)
            except ValueError:
                pass
        elif low.startswith("x-ratelimit-reset:"):
            try:
                _GH_RESET[0] = float(line.split(":")[1].strip())
            except ValueError:
                pass
    try:
        return json.loads(body).get("language")
    except Exception:
        return None


def gh_enqueue(full):
    try:
        seen = set(GH_QUEUE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()) if GH_QUEUE.exists() else set()
        if full in seen:
            return
        with GH_QUEUE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(full + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def gh_meta(full):
    if "." in full.split("/")[0]:
        return None, None
    _gh_load()
    e = _GH_MEM.get(full)
    if e and time.time() - e.get("ts", 0) < 7 * 86400:
        return (True, e.get("lang")) if e.get("ok") else (None, None)
    ok = gh_exists(full)
    lang = _gh_lang(full) if (ok and _gh_budget()) else None
    _GH_MEM[full] = {"ok": ok, "lang": lang, "ts": time.time()}
    _gh_save()
    if ok and lang is None:
        gh_enqueue(full)
    return (True, lang) if ok else (None, None)


def gh_worker():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        if not GH_QUEUE.exists() or not _gh_budget():
            time.sleep(20)
            continue
        try:
            lines = GH_QUEUE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(10)
            continue
        if not lines:
            time.sleep(20)
            continue
        full = lines[0]
        lang = _gh_lang(full)
        _gh_load()
        if full in _GH_MEM:
            _GH_MEM[full]["lang"] = lang
            _GH_MEM[full]["ts"] = time.time()
            _gh_save()
        rest = lines[1:]
        if lang is None:
            rest = rest + [full]
        try:
            GH_QUEUE.write_text("\n".join(rest[:500]), encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(3)


# ================================ ETHERSCAN ==================================

_ES_CACHE = {}
_ES_LAST = [0.0]


def es_call(chain, params):
    if not ETHERSCAN_KEY:
        return None
    key = (chain, tuple(sorted(params.items())))
    if key in _ES_CACHE:
        return _ES_CACHE[key]
    gap = time.time() - _ES_LAST[0]
    if gap < 0.35:
        time.sleep(0.35 - gap)
    _ES_LAST[0] = time.time()
    q = dict(params)
    q["chainid"] = str(CHAINS.get(chain, {}).get("id", 1))
    q["apikey"] = ETHERSCAN_KEY
    url = "https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(q)
    try:
        js = fetch_json(url)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if js.get("status") == "1":
        _ES_CACHE[key] = js.get("result")
        return js.get("result")
    return None


def es_source(chain, addr):
    r = es_call(chain, {"module": "contract", "action": "getsourcecode", "address": addr})
    if not r or not isinstance(r, list) or not r:
        return None
    e = r[0]
    src = e.get("SourceCode") or ""
    if src.startswith("{{"):
        try:
            m = json.loads(src[1:-1])
            src = "\n".join(v.get("content", "") for v in m.get("sources", {}).values())
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {"name": e.get("ContractName") or "Target", "src": src,
            "abi": e.get("ABI") or "", "proxy": e.get("Proxy") == "1"}


def impl_of(chain, addr):
    for slot in (IMPL_SLOT, BEACON_SLOT):
        try:
            v = rpc(chain, "eth_getStorageAt", [addr, slot, "latest"])
            if v and v != "0x" and int(v, 16):
                a = "0x%040x" % int(v, 16)
                if ADDR_RE.fullmatch(a):
                    return a
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


# ============================ SOURCE PARSING =================================

def clean_src(t):
    t = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", " ", t, flags=re.S)
    t = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", " ", t)
    return t


def brace_span(t, i):
    if i < 0:
        return ""
    depth = 0
    for j in range(i, len(t)):
        if t[j] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif t[j] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return t[i:j + 1]
    return t[i:]


def units(src):
    t = clean_src(src)
    out = []
    for m in FN_RE.finditer(t):
        b = t.find("{", m.end(), m.end() + 600)
        out.append({"name": m.group(1), "args": m.group(2), "head": m.group(3),
                    "body": brace_span(t, b)})
    return out


FUND_CLASSES = {"drain", "flash", "share", "liquidate", "reward", "fee", "cap", "value",
                "accounting", "oracle", "proxy", "sig", "reentrancy", "math", "token",
                "erc4626", "slippage", "invariant", "chain"}
MONEY_WORDS = re.compile(
    r"\b(balance|totalassets|totalsupply|share|reserve|price|collateral|debt|borrow|"
    r"withdraw|redeem|deposit|mint|burn|sweep|skim|sync|transfer|approve|liquidat|"
    r"reward|fee|stake|unstake|harvest|flash|loan|oracle|payout|claim|refund)\w*", re.I)


def add_finding(pid, sev, title, cls, file, line, impact, poc, evidence, gate):
    key = hashlib.sha1(("%s|%s|%s|%s" % (pid, cls, file, title)).encode()).hexdigest()
    fund = 1 if cls in FUND_CLASSES else 0
    with db() as c:
        if c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM findings WHERE root=?", (key,)).fetchone():
            return None
        c.execute("INSERT INTO findings(pid,sev,title,cls,file,line,root,impact,poc,evidence,"
                  "gate,created,fund) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                  (pid, sev, title, cls, file, int(line or 1), key, impact, poc,
                   evidence[:3000], gate, time.time(), fund))
    return key


def score_findings(pid):
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=?", (pid,))]
        p = c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
        p = dict(p) if p else {}
        for r in rows:
            s = SEV_BASE.get(r["sev"], 10)
            ev = (r["evidence"] or "").lower()
            fp = (r["file"] or "").lower().replace("\\", "/")
            hay = "%s %s %s" % (r["cls"], r["title"], ev)
            money = len(set(m.group(0).lower() for m in MONEY_WORDS.finditer(hay)))
            s += min(30, money * 4)
            if r.get("fund") or r["cls"] in FUND_CLASSES:
                s += 14
            if "external call" in ev or "delegatecall" in ev:
                s += 8
            if "value" in ev or "balance" in ev or "ether" in ev:
                s += 7
            if "public" in ev or "external" in ev:
                s += 5
            if "/test" in fp or fp.startswith("test/"):
                s -= 10
            if "/example" in fp or "/mock" in fp or "/interfaces/" in fp or "/lib/" in fp:
                s -= 8
            if (p.get("dupe") or "") == "high":
                s -= 6
            if (p.get("max") or 0) >= 100000:
                s += 3
            tvl = p.get("tvl") or 0
            if tvl >= 10 ** 21:
                s += 8
            elif tvl >= 10 ** 19:
                s += 5
            elif tvl > 0:
                s += 2
            s += BAND.get(r["sev"], 0) // 2
            if (r["gate"] or "").startswith("H"):
                s += 6
            if (r["gate"] or "").startswith("F"):
                s += 5
            r["score"] = max(1, min(100, s))
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET score=? WHERE id=?", (r["score"], r["id"]))
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r["score"])
    return rows


def best_score(pid):
    with db() as c:
        sevs = [x[0] for x in c.execute(
            "SELECT sev FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1", (pid,))]
    for s in SEV_ORDER:
        if s in sevs:
            return s
    return None


def best_rank(pid):
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT MAX(score) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1",
                      (pid,)).fetchone()
    return int(r[0] or 0) if r else 0


TOOLS = {}


def files_for(root, langs, cap=500):
    root = Path(root)
    exts = set()
    for l in langs:
        exts.update(EXT.get(l, []))
    out = []
    if not root.exists():
        return out
    for f in root.rglob("*"):
        if len(out) >= cap:
            break
        if not f.is_file() or f.suffix.lower() not in exts:
            continue
        if SKIP_DIRS & set(p.lower() for p in f.parts):
            continue
        out.append(f)
    return out


def sol_files(root):
    return files_for(root, ("solidity",), 400)


def rel(root, f):
    try:
        return str(Path(f).relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/")
    except Exception:
        return str(f)


def ln(t, i):
    return t[:i].count("\n") + 1


def snip(t, i, n=160):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t[i:i + n]).strip()

def run_pat(ctx, rx, langs, gate, tid, name, cls, sev, cap=40):
    n = 0
    for f in files_for(ctx["root"], langs, 500):
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:400000]
        except Exception:
            continue
        if f.suffix.lower() == ".sol":
            t = clean_src(t)
        for m in rx.finditer(t):
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], sev, name, cls, rel(ctx["root"], f), ln(t, m.start()),
                        name, "static", snip(t, m.start()), "L%s/%s" % (gate, tid))
            n += 1
            if n >= cap:
                return n
    return n


def reg(tid, name, cls, sev, lvl, rx, langs, gate="1"):
    def _run(ctx):
        return run_pat(ctx, rx, langs, gate, tid, name, cls, sev)
    TOOLS[tid] = {"id": tid, "name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev, "lvl": lvl,
                  "run": _run, "langs": tuple(langs), "fund": cls in FUND_CLASSES}


for _t, _n, _c, _s, _p in SOL:
    reg(_t, _n, _c, _s, 1, re.compile(_p, re.M), ("solidity",))

for _t, _n, _c, _s, _p in FUND:
    reg(_t, _n, _c, _s, 1, re.compile(_p, re.M | re.S), ("solidity",), "1F")

for _lang, _t, _n, _c, _s, _p in GEN:
    reg(_t, _n, _c, _s, 4, re.compile(_p, re.M), (_lang,), "4")


# ============================ WEB ATTACK SURFACE =============================

def _web_files(ctx):
    return WORK / str(ctx["pid"]) / "web"


def _target_url(pid):
    u = web_target(pid)
    if u:
        return u
    return (getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or ""


def _host(pid):
    return urllib.parse.urlparse(_target_url(pid)).netloc.replace("www.", "")


def _save_web(ctx, name, text):
    d = _web_files(ctx)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    safe = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", "_", name)[:120] or "blob"
    (d / safe).write_text(text[:200000], encoding="utf-8")


def web_audit(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    hf = WORK / str(pid) / "headers.txt"
    scope = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    body = scope.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:300000] if scope.exists() else ""
    h = hf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if hf.exists() else ""
    low = h.lower()
    bl = body.lower()
    n = 0
    if low.strip() and "via: reader" not in low:
        for tid, needle, label, sev in (
                ("W01", "content-security-policy", "Missing CSP", "medium"),
                ("W02", "strict-transport-security", "Missing HSTS", "medium"),
                ("W03", "x-frame-options", "Missing X-Frame-Options", "low"),
                ("W04", "x-content-type-options", "Missing X-Content-Type-Options", "low"),
                ("W12", "referrer-policy", "Missing Referrer-Policy", "info"),
                ("W13", "permissions-policy", "Missing Permissions-Policy", "info")):
            if needle not in low and ('name="%s"' % needle) not in bl:
                add_finding(pid, sev, label, "web", "headers", 1,
                            "response header absent", "header",
                            "header missing: %s" % needle, "L1/%s" % tid)
                n += 1
        for m in re.finditer(r"set-cookie:\s*([^\r\n]+)", low):
            c = m.group(1)
            for flag, tid, sev, label in (("secure", "W06", "medium", "Cookie without Secure"),
                                          ("httponly", "W07", "medium", "Cookie without HttpOnly"),
                                          ("samesite", "W08", "low", "Cookie without SameSite")):
                if flag not in c:
                    add_finding(pid, sev, label, "web", "headers", 1,
                                "cookie flag absent", "header", c[:200], "L1/%s" % tid)
                    n += 1
        m = re.search(r"server:\s*([^\r\n]{2,60})", low)
        if m:
            add_finding(pid, "info", "Server banner leak", "web", "headers", 1,
                        "version disclosure", "header", m.group(1), "L1/W05")
            n += 1
        if "access-control-allow-origin: *" in low:
            add_finding(pid, "medium", "Wildcard CORS header", "web", "headers", 1,
                        "any origin may read responses", "header", "ACAO *", "L1/W11")
            n += 1
    m = re.search(r"[\w./-]+\.js\.map", body)
    if m:
        add_finding(pid, "low", "Source map referenced", "web", m.group(0), 1,
                    "original sources recoverable", "bundle", m.group(0), "L1/W09")
        n += 1
    m = re.search(r"(?:stack trace|Traceback \(most recent|SQLSTATE)", body)
    if m:
        add_finding(pid, "medium", "Stack trace in response body", "web", "body", 1,
                    "internal path disclosure", "body", snip(body, m.start(), 120), "L1/W16")
        n += 1
    eps = sorted(set(CHAIN.findall(body)))
    if eps:
        (WORK / str(pid) / "endpoints.txt").write_text("\n".join(eps[:200]), encoding="utf-8")
    return n


def web_paths(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    host = _host(pid)
    if not host:
        return 0
    paths = ["/robots.txt", "/sitemap.xml", "/.well-known/security.txt", "/.git/config",
             "/.env", "/package.json", "/api", "/graphql", "/swagger.json",
             "/openapi.json", "/actuator/env", "/debug", "/server-status", "/admin",
             "/api/v1", "/healthz"]
    n = 0
    for p in paths[:WEB_CAP]:
        try:
            body, hdr = fetch("https://%s%s" % (host, p), timeout=12, want_headers=True)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
            body, hdr = "", "status: %s" % ex.code
            if ex.code not in (200, 401, 403):
                continue
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not body.strip():
            continue
        low = body.lower()
        _save_web(ctx, "path_" + p.strip("/").replace("/", "_") + ".txt", body)
        interesting = None
        if p == "/.git/config" and "[core]" in low:
            interesting = ("high", "Exposed .git/config", "repository metadata readable")
        elif p == "/.env" and "=" in body and len(body) < 20000:
            interesting = ("critical", "Exposed .env file", "environment secrets readable")
        elif p == "/package.json" and '"dependencies"' in low:
            interesting = ("low", "package.json exposed", "dependency inventory leak")
        elif p in ("/swagger.json", "/openapi.json") and ('"paths"' in low or '"openapi"' in low):
            interesting = ("medium", "API schema exposed", "full endpoint inventory")
        elif p == "/robots.txt" and "disallow" in low:
            interesting = ("info", "robots.txt reveals paths", "hidden paths listed")
        elif p == "/.well-known/security.txt":
            interesting = ("info", "security.txt present", "contact channel")
        elif p in ("/actuator/env", "/server-status", "/debug") and len(body) > 200:
            interesting = ("medium", "Debug endpoint exposed: %s" % p, "internal state readable")
        elif p in ("/api", "/graphql", "/api/v1") and len(body) > 100:
            interesting = ("info", "API root responds: %s" % p, "attack surface")
        if interesting:
            sev, title, impact = interesting
            add_finding(pid, sev, title, "web", p, 1, impact, "probe",
                        snip(body, 0, 300), "L1/W20")
            n += 1
    log(pid, "W20: %d disclosure hit(s)" % n)
    return n


def web_bundles(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    scope = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    body = scope.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if scope.exists() else ""
    host = _host(pid)
    if not body or not host:
        return 0
    srcs = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'<script[^>]+src=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', body, re.I):
        u = urllib.parse.urljoin("https://%s/" % host, m.group(1))
        if u not in srcs:
            srcs.append(u)
    cf = WORK / str(pid) / "chunks.txt"
    if cf.exists():
        for c in cf.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split():
            u = urllib.parse.urljoin("https://%s/" % host, c)
            if u not in srcs:
                srcs.append(u)
    log(pid, "W21: %d script(s) to mine" % len(srcs))
    n = 0
    seen = set()
    for u in srcs[:25]:
        try:
            js = fetch(u, timeout=20, limit=1500000)
        except Exception:
            continue
        name = urllib.parse.urlparse(u).path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or "bundle.js"
        _save_web(ctx, name, js)
        for m in re.finditer(
                r"(?:api[_-]?key|apikey|secret|token|bearer|private[_-]?key|"
                r"alchemy|infura|walletconnect|stripe|pinata|rpc[_-]?url)"
                r"\s*[:=]\s*[\"']([A-Za-z0-9_\-\./]{16,})", js, re.I):
            val = m.group(1)
            if val in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(val)
            add_finding(pid, "high", "Secret-looking value in JS bundle", "secret", name, 1,
                        "credential may be live", "bundle", m.group(0)[:160], "L1/W21")
            n += 1
        for m in re.finditer(r"[\"'](/(?:api|v\d|graphql|internal|admin|pay|checkout|"
                             r"withdraw|redeem|balance|order)[^\"']{2,80})[\"']", js):
            ep = m.group(1)
            if ep in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(ep)
            add_finding(pid, "info", "Endpoint in JS bundle: %s" % ep[:60], "web", name, 1,
                        "hidden route", "bundle", ep, "L1/W21")
            n += 1
            if n >= 30:
                break
        for m in re.finditer(r"sourceMappingURL=([^\s*]+\.map)", js):
            add_finding(pid, "low", "Source map present: %s" % m.group(1)[:60], "web", name, 1,
                        "original sources recoverable", "bundle", m.group(1), "L1/W21")
            n += 1
    log(pid, "W21: %d bundle hit(s) from %d script(s)" % (n, len(srcs)))
    return n


def web_endpoints(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    ef = WORK / str(pid) / "endpoints.txt"
    if not ef.exists():
        return 0
    eps = [e for e in ef.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split() if e.startswith("http")][:WEB_CAP]
    host = _host(pid)
    n = 0
    for e in eps:
        if urllib.parse.urlparse(e).netloc.replace("www.", "") != host:
            continue
        try:
            body, hdr = fetch(e, timeout=12, want_headers=True)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
            body, hdr = "", "status: %s" % ex.code
        except Exception:
            continue
        low = (hdr or "").lower()
        if "access-control-allow-origin: *" in low:
            add_finding(pid, "medium", "Wildcard CORS on %s" % e[:70], "cors", e, 1,
                        "any origin may read this response", "probe", e, "L1/W22")
            n += 1
        if '"stack"' in body.lower() or "traceback" in body.lower():
            add_finding(pid, "medium", "Verbose error on %s" % e[:70], "web", e, 1,
                        "internal detail disclosure", "probe", snip(body, 0, 200), "L1/W22")
            n += 1
    log(pid, "W22: %d endpoint hit(s)" % n)
    return n


REDIR_PARAMS = ("next", "redirect", "redirect_uri", "redirect_url", "url", "return",
                "returnTo", "return_to", "continue", "callback", "dest", "destination",
                "goto", "target", "r", "u")


def web_redirect(ctx):
    """A real redirect test: 3xx plus a Location on a foreign host, with a control."""
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    base = _target_url(pid)
    if not base:
        return 0
    probe = "https://bh-probe.example.org/x"
    host = _host(pid)
    n = 0
    for param in REDIR_PARAMS:
        u = base + ("&" if "?" in base else "?") + "%s=%s" % (param, urllib.parse.quote(probe))
        code, hd, _ = fetch_noredirect(u)
        loc = (hd.get("Location") or hd.get("location") or "").strip()
        if code not in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) or not loc:
            continue
        dest = urllib.parse.urlparse(urllib.parse.urljoin(base, loc)).netloc.replace("www.", "")
        if not dest or dest == host:
            continue
        add_finding(pid, "high", "Open redirect via %s" % param, "redirect", base, 1,
                    "attacker-controlled external redirect on an in-scope host", "probe",
                    "%s %s -> %s" % (code, param, loc[:200]), "L4/W40")
        n += 1
    log(pid, "W40: %d redirect hit(s)" % n)
    return n


MARKER = str(7919 * 7)          # 55433
WEB_PAYLOADS = [("'", "sqli", r"sql|syntax error|SQLSTATE|mysql|postgres|sqlite", None),
                ('"><svg/onload=alert(1)>', "xss", r"<svg/onload=alert\(1\)>", None),
                ("../../../../../../etc/passwd", "path", r"root:.*:0:0:", None),
                ("{{7919*7}}", "ssti", None, MARKER),
                ("${7919*7}", "ssti", None, MARKER)]


def web_errors(ctx):
    """Injection probes with unique markers and a baseline control request."""
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    base = _target_url(pid)
    if not base:
        return 0
    sep = "&" if "?" in base else "?"
    try:
        ctl = fetch(base + sep + "bhctl=1", timeout=12).lower()
    except Exception:
        ctl = ""
    n = 0
    for payload, cls, rx, marker in WEB_PAYLOADS:
        u = base + sep + "bh=" + urllib.parse.quote(payload)
        try:
            body = fetch(u, timeout=12)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError:
            body = ""
        except Exception:
            continue
        low = body.lower()
        if not low:
            continue
        if marker:
            if marker in body and marker not in ctl:
                add_finding(pid, "high", "Template expression evaluated (%s)" % payload[:14],
                            "ssti", base, 1,
                            "server-side template injection, likely RCE chain", "probe",
                            snip(body, body.find(marker) - 120, 300), "L4/W41")
                n += 1
            continue
        if cls == "path":
            if re.search(rx, body):
                add_finding(pid, "critical", "Path traversal reads /etc/passwd", "path", base, 1,
                            "arbitrary file read on the host", "probe",
                            snip(body, max(0, body.find("root:") - 60), 300), "L4/W41")
                n += 1
            continue
        if cls == "xss":
            if re.search(rx, body) and not re.search(rx, ctl):
                add_finding(pid, "medium", "Reflected XSS marker survives", "xss", base, 1,
                            "unencoded reflection of markup", "probe",
                            snip(body, max(0, body.find("<svg") - 80), 260), "L4/W41")
                n += 1
            continue
        if re.search(rx, low) and not re.search(rx, ctl):
            add_finding(pid, "high", "SQL error reflected for %r" % payload, "sqli", base, 1,
                        "injectable parameter, error-based", "probe",
                        snip(body, 0, 260), "L4/W41")
            n += 1
    log(pid, "W41: %d injection hint(s)" % n)
    return n


MONEY_FIELD = re.compile(
    r"(?:amount|price|total|subtotal|qty|quantity|value|fee|discount|coupon|"
    r"balance|credit|points|shares|withdraw|redeem|pay)", re.I)
MONEY_VALUE = re.compile(r"(?:^|[?&;,\s\"])([\w.]*(?:amount|price|total|fee|discount|"
                         r"balance|credit|shares|withdraw|redeem)[\w.]*)\s*[=:]\s*"
                         r"([\d.]+)", re.I)


def web_value_flow(ctx):
    """Anything where a number crosses the client boundary is a fund candidate."""
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    base = _target_url(pid)
    scope = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    body = scope.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if scope.exists() else ""
    ef = WORK / str(pid) / "endpoints.txt"
    eps = ef.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split() if ef.exists() else []
    blob = body + "\n" + "\n".join(eps[:120])
    n = 0
    for m in MONEY_VALUE.finditer(blob):
        field, val = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if float(val or 0) <= 0:
            continue
        if not MONEY_FIELD.search(field):
            continue
        add_finding(pid, "medium", "Client-supplied money field: %s" % field[:40],
                    "value", base or field, 1,
                    "server may trust %s from the client; try lowering it" % field[:30],
                    "probe", m.group(0)[:160], "L4/W42")
        n += 1
        if n >= 12:
            break
    for e in eps[:60]:
        p = urllib.parse.urlparse(e).path.lower()
        if not re.search(r"/(?:withdraw|redeem|claim|pay|checkout|order|transfer|swap|"
                         r"balance|credit|wallet|invoice)", p):
            continue
        add_finding(pid, "high", "Value endpoint: %s" % p[:60], "value", e, 1,
                    "direct fund path, test IDOR and amount tampering", "probe", e, "L4/W42")
        n += 1
        if n >= 20:
            break
    if re.search(r"(?:webhook|callback_url|notify_url)", blob, re.I) and \
            not re.search(r"(?:hmac|signature|x-signature|verify)", blob, re.I):
        add_finding(pid, "high", "Webhook endpoint without signature check", "value",
                    base or "body", 1,
                    "forge payment or credit callbacks", "probe", "webhook + no hmac", "L4/W43")
        n += 1
    if re.search(r"graphql", blob, re.I) and base:
        try:
            r = fetch(base.rstrip("/") + "/graphql", data=b'{"query":"{__typename}"}',
                      headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=12)
            if "__typename" in r:
                add_finding(pid, "medium", "GraphQL introspection reachable", "value",
                            "/graphql", 1, "schema and mutation inventory", "probe",
                            r[:200], "L4/W44")
                n += 1
        except Exception:
            pass
    log(pid, "W42: %d value-flow hit(s)" % n)
    return n

]

for _tid, _nm, _cls, _sev, _lvl, _fn in WEB_TOOLS:
    TOOLS[_tid] = {"id": _tid, "name": _nm, "cls": _cls, "sev": _sev, "lvl": _lvl,
                   "run": _fn, "web": True, "langs": ("web",),

# ================================ HAMMERS ====================================

def _contracts(root):
    out = {}
    for f in sol_files(root):
        t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        for m in CONTRACT_RE.finditer(t):
            out.setdefault(m.group(1), {"file": f, "src": t,
                                        "span": brace_span(t, t.find("{", m.end()))})
    return out


def hammer(tid, name, cls, sev, lvl=5, langs=("solidity",)):
    def deco(fn):
        TOOLS[tid] = {"id": tid, "name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev, "lvl": lvl,
                      "run": fn, "langs": langs, "fund": cls in FUND_CLASSES}
        return fn
    return deco


def _value_fns(span):
    """Functions that move value out of the contract."""
    out = []
    for u in units(span):
        if re.search(r"transfer|safeTransfer|call\{|\.call\(|_mint|_burn|sweep|skim|"
                     r"withdraw|redeem|liquidate", u["body"]):
            out.append(u)
    return out


@hammer("H01", "Access matrix: external fn without guard", "auth", "high")
def h01(ctx):
    n = 0
    for cname, c in _contracts(ctx["root"]).items():
        for u in units(c["span"]):
            if not re.search(r"external|public", u["head"]):
                continue
            if re.search(r"onlyOwner|onlyRole|onlyAdmin|onlyGovernance|auth|initializer", u["head"]):
                continue
            if not re.search(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*(\[[^\]]*\])?\s*(?:=|\+=|-=|\+\+|--)|transfer|call|mint|burn", u["body"]):
                continue
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], "high", "%s.%s callable by anyone" % (cname, u["name"]),
                        "auth", rel(ctx["root"], c["file"]), 1,
                        "unprivileged state mutation", "poc",
                        re.sub(r"\s+", " ", u["body"][:260]), "H01")
            n += 1
            if n >= 30:
                return n
    return n


@hammer("H02", "Accounting drift: transfer without balance delta", "accounting", "high")
def h02(ctx):
    n = 0
    for cname, c in _contracts(ctx["root"]).items():
        for u in units(c["span"]):
            b = u["body"]
            if not re.search(r"\.transfer(?:From)?\s*\(", b):
                continue
            if re.search(r"balanceOf|before|after|delta", b):
                continue
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], "high", "Unchecked balance delta in %s.%s" % (cname, u["name"]),
                        "accounting", rel(ctx["root"], c["file"]), 1,
                        "fee-on-transfer or rebasing breaks accounting", "poc",
                        re.sub(r"\s+", " ", b[:260]), "H02")
            n += 1
            if n >= 25:
                return n
    return n


@hammer("H03", "Cross-contract reentrancy chain", "reentrancy", "critical")
def h03(ctx):
    n = 0
    cs = _contracts(ctx["root"])
    callers = {}
    for cname, c in cs.items():
        for u in units(c["span"]):
            for target in cs:
                if re.search(r"\b%s\s*\(" % re.escape(target), u["body"]):
                    callers.setdefault(target, []).append((cname, u["name"], u["body"]))
    for cname, c in cs.items():
        for u in units(c["span"]):
            if not re.search(r"\.(?:call|transfer)\s*[({]", u["body"]):
                continue
            if "nonReentrant" in u["head"]:
                continue
            for c2, fn2, body2 in callers.get(cname, []):
                if re.search(r"balance|totalSupply|share", body2):
                    add_finding(ctx["pid"], "critical",
                                "Reentrancy chain %s.%s -> %s.%s" % (cname, u["name"], c2, fn2),
                                "reentrancy", rel(ctx["root"], c["file"]), 1,
                                "unguarded external call reachable from a value reader", "poc",
                                "%s.%s" % (c2, fn2), "H03")
                    n += 1
                    break
            if n >= 20:
                return n
    return n


@hammer("H04", "Rounding direction favours user", "math", "high")
def h04(ctx):
    n = 0
    for cname, c in _contracts(ctx["root"]).items():
        for u in units(c["span"]):
            b = u["body"]
            if not re.search(r"/\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*", b):
                continue
            if re.search(r"mulDiv|Math\.mulDiv|ceil|floor|Rounding", b):
                continue
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], "high", "Unrounded division in %s.%s" % (cname, u["name"]),
                        "math", rel(ctx["root"], c["file"]), 1,
                        "integer truncation can leak value per call", "poc",
                        re.sub(r"\s+", " ", b[:240]), "H04")
            n += 1
            if n >= 25:
                return n
    return n


@hammer("H05", "Oracle composite: price path without guard", "oracle", "critical")
def h05(ctx):
    n = 0
    for cname, c in _contracts(ctx["root"]).items():
        for u in units(c["span"]):
            b = u["body"]
            if not re.search(r"getReserves|latestRoundData|price|rate", b):
                continue
            if re.search(r"stale|heartbeat|sequencer|updatedAt", b):

@hammer("H14", "Fuzz stubs for boundary conditions", "fuzz", "medium")
def h14(ctx):
    depth = ctx.get("depth", 1)
    p = getp(ctx["pid"]) or {}
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(p) or not have("forge"):
        return 0
    root = ctx["root"]
    sol = sol_files(root)
    if not sol:
        return 0
    prim = sol[0]
    m = CONTRACT_RE.search(prim.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    if not m:
        return 0
    name = m.group(1)
    t = clean_src(prim.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    conds = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", x.group(1)).strip()
             for x in re.finditer(r"(?:require|if)\s*\(([^)]*(?:>=|<=|>|<)[^)]*)\)", t)][:12 * depth]
    if not conds:
        return 0
    body = ["// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT", "pragma solidity ^0.8.20;",
            'import "forge-std/Test.sol";', 'import "../%s";' % rel(root, prim), "",
            "contract BHFuzz is Test {", "  %s t;" % name,
            "  function setUp() public { t = new %s(); }" % name]
    for i, c in enumerate(conds, 1):
        body.append("  function test_bound_%d() public { assertTrue(true); /* %s */ }"
                    % (i, c.replace("*/", "")))
    body.append("}")
    tdir = root / "test"
    tdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (tdir / "BHFuzz.t.sol").write_text("\n".join(body) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    log(ctx["pid"], "H14: %d fuzz stub(s) for %s" % (len(conds), name))
    return len(conds)


@hammer("H15", "Attack chain builder", "chain", "critical", langs=None)
def h15(ctx):
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND gate NOT LIKE 'H15%'", (ctx["pid"],))]
    if web_only(ctx["pid"]):
        real = rows
    else:
        real = [r for r in rows if (r["file"] or "").endswith(".sol")
                or (r["file"] or "").startswith("onchain")]
    if len(real) < 2:
        return 0
    by_file = {}
    for r in real:
        by_file.setdefault(r["file"], []).append(r)
    n = 0
    for f, group in by_file.items():
        classes = sorted({r["cls"] for r in group})
        if len(classes) < 2:
            continue
        sevs = {r["sev"] for r in group}
        sev = ("critical" if "critical" in sevs else
               "high" if "high" in sevs else "medium")
        if sev == "medium" and len(classes) < 3:
            continue
        group.sort(key=lambda r: -SEV_BASE.get(r["sev"], 0))
        ev = "\n".join("%s %s (%s:%s)" % (r["sev"], r["title"][:80], r["file"], r["line"])
                       for r in group[:6])
        add_finding(ctx["pid"], sev, "Chain in %s: %s" % (f, " + ".join(classes[:3])),
                    "chain", f, group[0]["line"],
                    "combined weakness: %s" % ", ".join(classes), "poc", ev, "H15")
        n += 1
        if n >= 8:
            break
    return n

@hammer("H26", "Deposit/withdraw asymmetry", "share", "high")
def h26(ctx):
    n = 0
    for cname, c in _contracts(ctx["root"]).items():
        deps = [u for u in units(c["span"]) if re.search(r"deposit|stake|mint", u["name"], re.I)]
        outs = [u for u in units(c["span"]) if re.search(r"withdraw|redeem|unstake", u["name"], re.I)]
        if not deps or not outs:
            continue
        dchk = any(re.search(r"require|if\s*\(", u["body"]) for u in deps)
        ochk = any(re.search(r"require|if\s*\(", u["body"]) for u in outs)
        if dchk == ochk:
            continue
        add_finding(ctx["pid"], "high",
                    "Asymmetric validation on %s (%s side unchecked)"
                    % (cname, "exit" if dchk else "entry"), "share",
                    rel(ctx["root"], c["file"]), 1,
                    "one side of the flow is validated, the other is not", "poc",
                    "in=%d out=%d" % (len(deps), len(outs)), "H26")
        n += 1
        if n >= 12:
            return n
    return n

    return n

    n = 0
    for cname, c in _contracts(ctx["root"]).items():
        em = [u for u in units(c["span"]) if re.search(r"emergency|panic|force", u["name"], re.I)]
        if not em:
            continue
        for u in em:
            if not re.search(r"transfer|call|_burn|sweep", u["body"]):
                continue
            if re.search(r"reward|accrue|update", u["body"]):
                continue
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], "high",
                        "Emergency path skips accrual in %s.%s" % (cname, u["name"]),
                        "lifecycle", rel(ctx["root"], c["file"]), 1,
                        "exiting through emergency avoids the normal accounting", "poc",
                        re.sub(r"\s+", " ", u["body"][:240]), "H30")
            n += 1
            if n >= 15:
                return n
    return n


# ============================= EXTERNAL TOOLS ================================

def cvss_sev(s):
    if s >= 9.0:
        return "critical"
    if s >= 7.0:
        return "high"
    if s >= 4.0:
        return "medium"
    if s > 0:
        return "low"
    return "medium"


EXT_NOISE = re.compile(
    r"no contract was analyzed|compilation failed|^\s*error|^\s*info:|"
    r"^\s*warning:\s*slither|contracts? analyzed|^\W*$|"
    r"Traceback \(most recent call last\)|^\s+File \"", re.I)


def _ext_bandit(text):
    cur = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r">>\s*Issue:\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(.*)", line)
        if m:
            cur = (m.group(1), m.group(2).strip())
            continue
        m = re.search(r"Severity:\s*(Critical|High|Medium|Low)", line, re.I)
        if m and cur:
            yield m.group(1).lower(), "%s %s" % (cur[0], cur[1][:80])
            cur = None


def _ext_osv(text):
    seen = set()
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.search(r"(GHSA-[\w-]+|CVE-\d{4}-\d+|PYSEC-\d{4}-\d+)", line)
        if not m:
            continue
        oid = m.group(1)
        if oid in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(oid)
        nums = re.findall(r"\b(\d{1,2}\.\d)\b", line)
        score = max((float(n) for n in nums), default=0.0)
        pkg = ""
        pm = re.search(r"\|\s*([A-Za-z][\w.-]*)\s*\|\s*([\w.@/-]+)\s*\|", line)
        if pm:
            pkg = "%s/%s" % (pm.group(1), pm.group(2))
        yield cvss_sev(score), "%s %s" % (oid, pkg)


def _ext_gitleaks(text):
    cur = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"\s*RuleID:\s*(\S+)", line)
        if m:
            cur = {"rule": m.group(1)}
            continue
        m = re.match(r"\s*File:\s*(.+)", line)
        if m:
            cur["file"] = m.group(1).strip()
            continue
        m = re.match(r"\s*Secret:\s*(.+)", line)
        if m and cur.get("rule"):
            yield "high", "%s in %s" % (cur["rule"], cur.get("file", "?"))
            cur = {}


EXT_PARSERS = {"bandit": _ext_bandit, "osv-scanner": _ext_osv, "gitleaks": _ext_gitleaks}


def _has(root, *names):
    return any((Path(root) / n).exists() for n in names)


def _has_sol(root):
    return bool(sol_files(root))


_MEDUSA_FLAG = [None]


def _medusa_targets(root):
    if _MEDUSA_FLAG[0] is None:
        rc, out, err = sh(["medusa", "--help"], timeout=60)
        blob = out + err
        _MEDUSA_FLAG[0] = "--target-contracts" if "--target-contracts" in blob else \
            ("--target" if "--target" in blob else "")
    f = _MEDUSA_FLAG[0]
    return ["fuzz"] + ([f, "src"] if f else ["src"])


def ext(tid, name, cls, sev, lvl, binary, argv, web=False, langs=None, analyzer=True,
        guard=None):
    def _run(ctx):
        if guard and not guard(ctx["root"]):
            log(ctx["pid"], "%s: manifest absent - skipped" % tid)
            return 0
        if not have(binary):
            log(ctx["pid"], "%s: %s absent - skipped" % (tid, binary))
            return 0
        rc, out, err = sh([binary] + argv(ctx), cwd=ctx["root"], timeout=1800)
        text = out + err
        parser = EXT_PARSERS.get(binary)
        n = 0
        if parser:
            for s, title in parser(text):
                add_finding(ctx["pid"], s, "%s: %s" % (name, title), cls, "tree", 1,
                            "external analyzer", "tool", title[:300], "L%d/%s" % (lvl, tid))
                n += 1
                if n >= 25:
                    break
            return n
        for line in text.splitlines():
            if re.search(r"Traceback \(most recent call last\)|^\s+File \"|^\s+\w+Error:", line):
                continue
            m = re.search(r"Severity:\s*(Critical|High|Medium|Low)\b", line, re.I)
            if m:
                s = m.group(1).lower()
                title = line.strip()[:90]
            else:
                if EXT_NOISE.search(line):
                    continue
                m = re.search(r"(?:Critical|High|Medium|ERROR|WARNING)[^\n]{5,200}", line)
                if not m:
                    continue
                g = m.group(0)
                s = "critical" if "Critical" in g else (
                    "high" if re.search(r"High|ERROR", g) else "medium")
                title = g[:90]
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], s, "%s: %s" % (name, title), cls, "tree", 1,
                        "external analyzer", "tool", line[:400], "L%d/%s" % (lvl, tid))
            n += 1
            if n >= 25:
                break
        if tid == "X01" and "no contract was analyzed" in text.lower():
            log(ctx["pid"], "slither: nothing compiled - tree may not match the type")
        if n == 0:
            first = next((l.strip() for l in text.splitlines()
                          if l.strip() and not EXT_NOISE.search(l)), "")
            log(ctx["pid"], "%s: 0 findings%s" % (tid, " - " + first[:110] if first else ""))
        return n
    TOOLS[tid] = {"id": tid, "name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev, "lvl": lvl,
                  "run": _run, "web": web, "langs": langs, "analyzer": analyzer,
                  "fund": cls in FUND_CLASSES}
