def lang_ok(t, langs, prim):
    if t.get("web"):
        return prim == "web"
    tl = t.get("langs")
    if tl is None:
        return True
    return bool(set(tl) & langs)


def tools_for(pid, lvl=None):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    langs = langs_of(p)
    prim = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    out = [t for t in TOOLS.values()
           if lang_ok(t, langs, prim) and (lvl is None or t["lvl"] == lvl)]
    if FUND_ONLY:
        out = [t for t in out if t.get("fund") or t["lvl"] == 0]
    return sorted(out, key=lambda t: t["id"])


# ============================ CONDITIONS ENGINE ==============================

def cond_path(pid):
    return WORK / str(pid) / "conditions.json"


def load_cond(pid):
    f = cond_path(pid)
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if f.exists() else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _deep(dst, src):
    for k, v in src.items():
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            dst[k] = _deep(dst.get(k, {}) if isinstance(dst.get(k), dict) else {}, v)
        else:
            dst[k] = v
    return dst


def policy(pid):
    pol = json.loads(json.dumps(COND_DEFAULT))
    _deep(pol, load_cond(pid))
    for k in CONSTRAINT_KEYS:
        pol["constraints"].setdefault(k, False)
    for k in COND_DEFAULT["poc"]:
        pol["poc"].setdefault(k, COND_DEFAULT["poc"][k])
    for k in COND_DEFAULT["exclusions"]:
        pol["exclusions"].setdefault(k, [])
    for k in COND_DEFAULT["submit"]:
        pol["submit"].setdefault(k, "")
    if not pol["severity"]:
        pol["severity"] = [dict(r) for r in DEFAULT_TIERS]
        pol["severity_assumed"] = True
    b = load_brief(pid)
    pol["source_sha"] = b.get("sha256", "")
    if pol["scope_model"] == "repo" and pol["targets"]:
        pol["scope_model"] = "address"
    return pol


def _bullets_after(blob, patterns, stop_heads=True):
    out = []
    for pat in patterns:
        m = re.search(pat, blob, re.I)
        if not m:
            continue
        rest = blob[m.end():]
        if stop_heads:
            nxt = re.search(r"\n#{2,4}\s|\n\*\*[A-Z][^*]{2,40}\*\*", rest)
            if nxt:
                rest = rest[:nxt.start()]
        for line in rest.splitlines():
            s = line.strip().lstrip("-*+").strip()
            s = re.sub(r"\*\*|`", "", s)
            if len(s) < 6 or s.lower().startswith(("the following", "not ")):
                continue
            out.append(s[:400])
    seen, ded = set(), []
    for s in out:
        k = s.lower()[:90]
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        ded.append(s)
    return ded[:40]


def p_scope(blob):
    targets, chain, pos = [], "eth", 0
    for m in HEAD_RE.finditer(blob):
        for a in ADDR_RE.findall(blob[pos:m.start()]):
            targets.append({"contract": "", "address": a, "chain": chain, "kind": ""})
        head = m.group(1).lower()
        for w, ch in CHAIN_WORDS.items():
            if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % w, head):
                chain = ch
                break
        pos = m.start()
    for a in ADDR_RE.findall(blob[pos:]):
        targets.append({"contract": "", "address": a, "chain": chain, "kind": ""})
    table = []
    for m in re.finditer(
            r"\|\s*([A-Za-z][^|\n]{1,60}?)\s*\|\s*`?(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40})`?\s*\|\s*([a-zA-Z0-9 \-]+?)\s*\|",
            blob):
        table.append({"contract": m.group(1).strip(), "address": m.group(2),
                      "kind": m.group(3).strip()})
    seen, ded = set(), []
    for t in targets:
        if t["address"] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(t["address"])
        match = next((x for x in table if x["address"].lower() == t["address"].lower()), None)
        t["contract"] = match["contract"] if match else ""
        t["kind"] = match["kind"] if match else ""
        ded.append(t)
    for t in ded:
        if t["chain"] != "eth":
            continue
        i = blob.find(t["address"])
        if i < 0:
            continue
        window = blob[max(0, i - 400):i + 400].lower()
        for w, ch in CHAIN_WORDS.items():
            if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % w, window):
                t["chain"] = ch
                break
    by_addr = bool(table) or bool(re.search(
        r"only the (?:contract )?addresses|scope is defined by deployed address", blob, re.I))
    return {"scope_model": "address" if by_addr and ded else "repo", "targets": ded[:60]}


def p_exclusions(blob):
    out = {"surfaces": [], "non_vulns": [], "non_submissions": []}
    for s in _bullets_after(blob, [r"out of scope[^\n]*\n", r"not smart contracts[^\n]*\n"]):
        s = s[:180]
        low = s.lower()
        if re.search(r"frontend|web interface|website|dashboard|api\b|rpc|subgraph|indexer|"
                     r"agent|client|documentation|discord|testnet|staging|third-party", low):
            out["surfaces"].append(s)
        elif re.search(r"poc|proof of concept|template|one page|ai\b|unverified", low):
            out["non_submissions"].append(s)
        else:
            out["non_vulns"].append(s)
    out["non_vulns"] += [s[:180] for s in _bullets_after(blob, [r"not a vulnerability[^\n]*\n"])
                         if s not in out["non_vulns"]]
    out["non_submissions"] += [s[:180] for s in
                               _bullets_after(blob, [r"not a submission[^\n]*\n"])
                               if s not in out["non_submissions"]]
    for k in out:
        out[k] = out[k][:12]
    return out


def p_poc(blob):
    low = blob.lower()
    poc = dict(COND_DEFAULT["poc"])
    if re.search(r"proof of concept|poc\b", low):
        poc["required"] = bool(re.search(
            r"no poc|without a (?:working )?proof|poc (?:is )?(?:mandatory|required)|"
            r"must (?:contain|include|be)[^.\n]{0,60}poc", low))
    if re.search(r"foundry|forge test", low):
        poc["framework"] = "foundry"
    elif re.search(r"hardhat", low):
        poc["framework"] = "hardhat"
    poc["fork"] = bool(re.search(r"fork(?:ed)? (?:mainnet|against)|mainnet fork", low))
    poc["block_pin"] = bool(re.search(r"pinned (?:to a )?block|fork-block|specific block", low))
    poc["must_assert"] = bool(re.search(r"assert(?:ion)?[^.\n]{0,60}(?:loss|balance|invariant)", low))
    poc["no_privileged"] = bool(re.search(
        r"no privileged|unprivileged|no vm\.prank|without (?:admin|owner)", low))
    poc["public_link"] = bool(re.search(r"public (?:github )?(?:repo|repository|gist)|gist", low))
    if not poc["required"] and re.search(r"poc", low):
        poc["required"] = True
    return poc


def p_template(blob):
    heads, one_page = [], False
    for block in re.findall(r"```([\s\S]{20,800}?)```", blob):
        for line in block.splitlines():
            m = re.match(r"\s*([A-Z][A-Z _/]{2,30}):", line)
            if m and m.group(1).strip() not in heads:
                heads.append(m.group(1).strip())
    if len(heads) < 3:
        for h in ("TARGET", "INVARIANT", "IMPACT", "PRECONDITIONS", "ATTACK", "POC", "FIX"):
            if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % h, blob) and h not in heads:
                heads.append(h)
    if re.search(r"one page|maximum one page|longer than one page", blob, re.I):
        one_page = True
    return {"template": heads[:12], "one_page": one_page, "max_lines": 60 if one_page else 0}


def p_submit(blob):
    out = dict(COND_DEFAULT["submit"])
    mails = [m for m in EMAIL_RE.findall(blob) if re.search(r"security|bounty|dev|sec", m, re.I)]
    if mails:
        out["channel"], out["address"] = "email", mails[0]
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://(?:www\.)?(hackerone|bugcrowd|intigriti|"
                         r"hackenproof|yeswehack|code4rena|sherlock|cantina)\.\w+", blob):
        out["channel"], out["address"] = "platform", m.group(0)
        break
    m = re.search(r"\[\s*BOUNTY\s*\][^\n`]{0,90}", blob)
    if m:
        out["subject_fmt"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(0)).strip()
    return out


def p_severity(blob):
    rows = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"\|\s*\*{0,2}(Critical|High|Medium|Low)\*{0,2}\s*\|([^|\n]{10,400})\|"
                         r"([^|\n]{0,120})\|", blob, re.I):
        band = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(3)).strip()
        nums = [int(x.replace(",", "")) for x in re.findall(r"\$\s?([\d,]{3,})", band)]
        rows.append({"tier": m.group(1).lower(),
                     "definition": re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(2)).strip()[:300],
                     "min": min(nums) if nums else 0, "max": max(nums) if nums else 0,
                     "band": band[:120]})
    if not rows:
        for tier in ("critical", "high", "medium", "low"):
            m = re.search(r"\b%s\b[^\n]{0,200}?\\?\$\s?([\d,]{3,})" % tier, blob, re.I)
            if m:
                v = int(m.group(1).replace(",", ""))
                rows.append({"tier": tier, "definition": "", "min": v, "max": v, "band": ""})
    return rows


def p_constraints(blob):
    low = blob.lower()
    c = {k: False for k in CONSTRAINT_KEYS}
    c["no_analyzer_only"] = bool(re.search(
        r"raw output from (?:static )?analyzers|automated tool[^.]{0,80}without", low))
    c["no_admin_key"] = bool(re.search(r"admin key|owner role|privileged role|centralization", low))
    c["no_mev"] = bool(re.search(r"front-running|mev", low))
    c["no_griefing"] = bool(re.search(r"griefing|denial-of-service that does not", low))
    c["rounding_exception"] = bool(re.search(
        r"rounding[^.]{0,200}(?:in scope|compounds|exception)", low))
    c["dupe_first_wins"] = bool(re.search(r"first (?:valid )?report|duplicates? receive no", low))
    c["no_theoretical"] = bool(re.search(r"theoretical|speculative", low))
    c["no_third_party"] = bool(re.search(r"third-party (?:protocols|contracts)", low))
    c["testnets_out"] = bool(re.search(r"testnets?[^.\n]{0,40}out of scope|testnets? \(", low))
    return c


def p_caps(blob):
    return [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(0)).strip()[:160]
            for m in re.finditer(r"cap(?:ped)? at [^\n.]{0,120}", blob, re.I)][:6]


def p_disclosure(blob):
    m = re.search(r"(confidential[^\n.]{0,200}|do not disclose[^\n.]{0,200})", blob, re.I)
    return m.group(1) if m else ""


def parse_conditions(blob):
    cond = {"source_sha": hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest()}
    cond.update(p_scope(blob))
    cond["exclusions"] = p_exclusions(blob)
    cond["poc"] = p_poc(blob)
    cond.update(p_template(blob))
    cond["submit"] = p_submit(blob)
    cond["severity"] = p_severity(blob)
    cond["constraints"] = p_constraints(blob)
    cond["caps"] = p_caps(blob)
    cond["disclosure"] = p_disclosure(blob)
    body = {k: v for k, v in cond.items() if k != "source_sha"}
    cond["contract_sha"] = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    return cond


def _phrase_hit(phrase, hay):
    words = [w for w in re.findall(r"[a-z]{5,}", phrase.lower())]
    if not words:
        return False
    hits = sum(1 for w in words if re.search(r"\b%s" % re.escape(w), hay))
    return hits >= (2 if len(words) >= 3 else 1)


TOOLISH_POC = ("static", "tool", "header", "probe", "body", "bundle", "value")


def judge(f, pol):
    """(eligible, blockers, reward). Analyzer output never counts as a PoC."""
    blockers = []
    hay = ("%s %s %s" % (f["cls"], f["title"], f["impact"])).lower()
    file = (f["file"] or "").lower().replace("\\", "/")
    ex = pol.get("exclusions") or {}
    cons = pol.get("constraints") or {}
    poc = pol.get("poc") or {}
    webish = file.startswith("web/") or any(k in file for k in WEBISH)
    if pol.get("scope_model") == "address" and not (file.startswith("onchain") or
                                                    file.endswith(".sol")) and webish:
        blockers.append("not-scoped-bytecode")
    if any(_phrase_hit(s, hay) for s in ex.get("surfaces", [])):
        blockers.append("excluded-surface")
    if any(_phrase_hit(s, hay) for s in ex.get("non_vulns", [])):
        blockers.append("excluded-topic")
    if any(_phrase_hit(s, hay) for s in ex.get("non_submissions", [])):
        blockers.append("not-submittable")
    if cons.get("no_admin_key") and re.search(r"owner|admin|multisig|centraliz|timelock", hay):
        blockers.append("assumes-privileged")
    if cons.get("no_analyzer_only") and f["poc"] == "tool":
        blockers.append("analyzer-only")
    if poc.get("required") and f["poc"] in TOOLISH_POC:
        blockers.append("no-exploit")
    reward = 0
    for row in pol.get("severity", []):
        if row["tier"] == f["sev"]:
            reward = row["max"] or row["min"]
            break
    if pol.get("severity") and not reward:
        blockers.append("sev-not-listed")
    if not pol.get("severity"):
        blockers.append("no-tier-table")
    if cons.get("no_theoretical") and not reward:
        blockers.append("no-usd-impact")
    hard = {"excluded-surface", "excluded-topic", "not-submittable", "assumes-privileged",
            "sev-not-listed", "no-tier-table"}
    eligible = 0 if (hard & set(blockers)) else 1
    return eligible, sorted(set(blockers)), reward


def readiness(pid):
    pol = policy(pid)
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=?", (pid,))]
    eligible = [r for r in rows if r["eligible"] and r["judged"]]
    ready = [r for r in eligible if not json.loads(r["blockers"] or "[]")]
    score = int(100 * len(ready) / len(eligible)) if eligible else 0
    req = []
    if pol["poc"]["required"]:
        req.append({"key": "poc", "label": "exploit or repro required", "met": bool(ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["framework"]:
        req.append({"key": "framework", "label": "PoC must be %s" % pol["poc"]["framework"],
                    "met": any(r["poc_path"] for r in ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["block_pin"]:
        chains = {t.get("chain") or "eth" for t in pol["targets"]} or {"eth"}
        pinned = {c for c in chains if fork_block(c)}
        req.append({"key": "block",
                    "label": "fork pinned to a block (%s)" % ", ".join(sorted(chains)),
                    "met": pinned == chains})
    if pol["poc"]["must_assert"]:
        req.append({"key": "assert", "label": "assertion on the loss",
                    "met": any("assert" in (r["evidence"] or "").lower() for r in ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["no_privileged"]:
        req.append({"key": "unprivileged", "label": "no privileged accounts", "met": bool(ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["public_link"]:
        req.append({"key": "link", "label": "public repo or gist link", "met": False})
    if pol["template"]:
        req.append({"key": "template", "label": "template: %s" % " / ".join(pol["template"][:4]),
                    "met": bool(ready)})
    if pol["submit"]["address"]:
        req.append({"key": "channel", "label": "submit to %s" % pol["submit"]["address"],
                    "met": True})
    return {"score": score, "ready": len(ready), "eligible": len(eligible),
            "total": len(rows), "requirements": req, "policy": pol,
            "unjudged": sum(1 for r in rows if not r["judged"])}


def poc_http(pid, finding, pol):
    """Repro artefact for a web finding."""
    tgt = web_target(pid) or (getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or "https://target"
    d = WORK / str(pid) / "poc"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("repro_%s.md" % finding["id"])
    lines = [
        "# %s" % finding["title"], "",
        "- severity: %s" % finding["sev"], "- class: %s" % finding["cls"],
        "- where: %s" % finding["file"], "",
        "## reproduce", "", "Target: `%s`" % tgt, "",
        "```bash",
    ]
    where = (finding["file"] or "").lower()
    if where == "headers":
        lines.append("curl -sSI %s | grep -iE 'content-security-policy|"
                     "strict-transport-security|x-frame-options|set-cookie'" % tgt)
    elif finding["cls"] in ("redirect", "sqli", "ssti", "path", "xss"):
        sep = "&" if "?" in tgt else "?"
        lines.append("curl -sS -o /dev/null -D - -w '%%{http_code} %%{redirect_url}\\n' \\\n"
                     "  '%s%snext=https://bh-probe.example.org/x'" % (tgt, sep))
    elif finding["cls"] == "secret":
        lines.append("curl -sS %s | head -c 4000" % tgt)
        lines.append("# compare the leaked value against the service console")
    elif finding["cls"] == "value":
        lines.append("# capture the request, then change the amount and replay it")
        lines.append("curl -sS -X POST '%s' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n"
                     "  -d '{\"amount\":1,\"price\":0.01}'" % tgt)
    elif where.startswith("path_") or finding["cls"] == "web":
        path = finding["file"] if finding["file"].startswith("/") else "/"
        lines.append("curl -sS -i '%s%s'" % (tgt.rstrip("/"), path))
    else:
        lines.append("curl -sS -i %s" % tgt)
    lines += ["```", "",
              "## expected", "", finding["impact"] or "-", "",
              "## observed", "", "```",
              (finding["evidence"] or "")[:1200], "```", ""]
    if pol["poc"]["required"]:
        lines += ["## fund impact", "",
                  "State the amount a user or the protocol loses, and whether it repeats.",
                  "", "## notes", "",
                  "Steps must run unauthenticated unless the program allows otherwise.", ""]
    f.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(f), finding["id"]))
    return str(f)


def poc_stub(pid, finding, pol):
    webish = any(k in (finding["file"] or "") for k in WEBISH) or web_only(pid)
    if webish:
        return poc_http(pid, finding, pol)
    if pol["poc"]["framework"] not in ("foundry", ""):
        return ""
    tgt = (pol["targets"] or [{}])[0]
    addr = tgt.get("address") or "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
    block = fork_block(tgt.get("chain") or "eth") or 0
    body = [
        "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT",
        "pragma solidity ^0.8.20;",
        "",
        'import "forge-std/Test.sol";',
        "",
        "// generated skeleton - fill the attack, keep the assertions",
        "// %s" % finding["title"][:110],
        "contract BHExploit is Test {",
        "    address constant TARGET = %s;" % addr,
        "    address attacker = address(0xBEEF);",
        "    address victim = address(0xCAFE);",
        "",
        "    function setUp() public {",
        '        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envString("RPC_URL"), %s);' % block,
        "        vm.deal(attacker, 100 ether);",
        "        vm.deal(victim, 100 ether);",
        "    }",
        "",
        "    function test_exploit() public {",
        "        uint256 before = address(attacker).balance;",
        "        vm.startPrank(attacker);",
        "        // 1. seed or borrow",
        "        // 2. skew the price or the accounting",
        "        // 3. exit at the skewed state",
        "        vm.stopPrank();",
        "        uint256 profit = address(attacker).balance - before;",
        "        assertGt(profit, 0, \"no value captured\");",
        "        emit log_named_uint(\"profit wei\", profit);",
        "    }",
        "}",
    ]
    d = WORK / str(pid) / "poc"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("exploit_%s.t.sol" % finding["id"])
    f.write_text("\n".join(body) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(f), finding["id"]))
    return str(f)


# ================================= STAGES ====================================

BRIEF_TMPL = ["TARGET", "INVARIANT", "IMPACT", "PRECONDITIONS", "ATTACK", "POC", "FIX"]
OUT_TERMS = ["frontend", "web interface", "dashboard", "website", "api", "rpc", "subgraph",
             "indexer", "testnet", "staging", "admin key", "owner role", "multisig",
             "centraliz", "gas optimization", "natspec", "theoretical", "known issue",
             "phishing", "mev", "front-run", "griefing", "rounding", "dust", "third-party"]


def brief_path(pid):
    return WORK / str(pid) / "brief.json"


def load_brief(pid):
    f = brief_path(pid)
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if f.exists() else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def web_disabled(pid):
    if web_only(pid):
        return False
    pol = load_cond(pid)
    if not pol:
        oos = " ".join(load_brief(pid).get("out_of_scope", [])).lower()
        return any(t in oos for t in ("frontend", "web interface"))
    if pol.get("scope_model") == "address":
        return True
    surf = " ".join(pol.get("exclusions", {}).get("surfaces", [])).lower()
    return any(t in surf for t in ("frontend", "web interface", "website", "api"))


def _try_page(pid, url, cookie):
    for wait in (0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 120):
        if wait:
            log(pid, "intake: backing off %ds" % wait)
            time.sleep(wait)
        try:
            return fetch_host(url, cookie, want_headers=True)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as ex:
            if ex.code == 429:
                NET_PENALTY[0] = min(25.0, NET_PENALTY[0] + 4)
                continue
            return None, ex.code
        except Exception as ex:
            return None, str(ex)[:80]
    return None, "429"


def st_intake(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    url = p.get("url") or ""
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log(pid, "intake: %s" % url)

    res = platforms.resolve(pid, url, cookie=HP_COOKIE or IT_COOKIE or BC_COOKIE,
                            reader=READER, fetch=_detail_fetch,
                            log=lambda m: log(pid, m))
    (root / "details.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"adapter": res.adapter, "tier": res.tier, "problems": res.problems,
         "fields": {"assets": len(res.rec["assets"]), "tiers": len(res.rec["rewards"]),
                    "poc": res.rec["poc_any"],
                    "submit": bool(res.rec["submit"]["address"])}}, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8")

    if not res.markdown.strip():
        setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake", details_ok=0)
        log(pid, "intake: NOTHING FETCHED (adapter %s) - parked" % res.adapter)
        (root / "details_reason.txt").write_text(
            "nothing fetched via %s\ntry: paste the program text in the overview panel\n"
            % "/".join(platforms.TIERS), encoding="utf-8")
        return False

    body = res.markdown
    (root / "scope.txt").write_text(body[:600000], encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "headers.txt").write_text("via: %s" % res.tier, encoding="utf-8")
    if res.tier in ("html", "reader", "manual", "api-text"):
        (root / "web_surface").write_text(str(time.time()), encoding="utf-8")
    apps = app_urls(pid)
    if apps:
        (root / "web_target.txt").write_text(apps[0], encoding="utf-8")
        log(pid, "intake: app target %s%s" % (apps[0],
            " (+%d more)" % (len(apps) - 1) if len(apps) > 1 else ""))
    log(pid, "intake: %d bytes via %s/%s, %d asset(s), %d tier(s)"
        % (len(body), res.adapter, res.tier, len(res.rec["assets"]), len(res.rec["rewards"])))
    if res.thin:
        log(pid, "intake: THIN record (%s) - parking so you can paste"
            % ", ".join(res.problems))
        (root / "details_reason.txt").write_text(
            "record too thin: %s\npaste the program text to unblock\n"
            % ", ".join(res.problems), encoding="utf-8")
        setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake", details_ok=0,
             type_conf="none", notes="thin: " + ",".join(res.problems)[:180])
        return False
    setp(pid, details_ok=1)
    return True


def st_conditions(pid, ctx):
    """Parse the program contract. Every later stage obeys it."""
    sf = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    if not sf.exists():
        log(pid, "conditions: no page yet - contract unknown")
        setp(pid, cond_ok=0)
        return False
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:600000]
    cond = parse_conditions(blob)
    cond_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps(cond, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    if cond["targets"]:
        cond["scope_model"] = "address"
    ok = bool(cond["targets"] or cond["severity"] or cond["template"])
    setp(pid, cond_ok=1 if ok else 0, targets_n=len(cond["targets"]),
         details_ok=1 if ok else ((getp(pid) or {}).get("details_ok") or 0))
    log(pid, "conditions: %d target(s), %d tier(s), %d head(s), %d exclusion(s), "
             "poc required=%s, submit=%s, model=%s"
        % (len(cond["targets"]), len(cond["severity"]), len(cond["template"]),
           sum(len(v) for v in cond["exclusions"].values()), cond["poc"]["required"],
           cond["submit"]["address"] or "?", cond["scope_model"]))
    if not cond["severity"]:
        log(pid, "conditions: no tier table in the program - assumed default bands")
    if cond["scope_model"] == "address" and not cond["targets"]:
        log(pid, "conditions: address scope declared but nothing parsed")
    for s in cond["exclusions"]["surfaces"][:6]:
        log(pid, "conditions: out of scope -> %s" % s[:90])
    for k, v in cond["constraints"].items():
        if v:
            log(pid, "conditions: constraint %s" % k)
    if not ok:
        log(pid, "conditions: thin - no target, no tier, no template")
    return ok


def st_brief(pid, ctx):
    sf = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if sf.exists() else ""
    low = blob.lower()
    addrs = sorted(set(ADDR_RE.findall(blob)))
    oos = [t for t in OUT_TERMS if t in low]
    tmpl = [h for h in BRIEF_TMPL if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % h, blob)]
    if len(tmpl) < 5:
        tmpl = list(BRIEF_TMPL)
    mails = [m for m in EMAIL_RE.findall(blob) if re.search(r"mor|security|bounty", m)]
    m = re.search(r"(\[BOUNTY\][^\n]{0,80})", blob)
    flat = re.sub(r"[*|`]", " ", blob)
    rewards = {}
    for tier in ("critical", "high", "medium", "low"):
        mm = re.search(r"\b%s\b[^\n]{0,260}?\\?\$\s?([\d,]{3,})" % tier, flat, re.I)
        if mm:
            rewards[tier] = int(mm.group(1).replace(",", ""))
    cond = load_cond(pid)
    brief = {"source_url": (getp(pid) or {}).get("url"), "fetched_at": time.time(),
             "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest(),
             "in_scope": addrs, "out_of_scope": oos, "template": tmpl,
             "submit_to": mails[0] if mails else "",
             "subject_fmt": m.group(1).strip() if m else "",
             "rewards": rewards, "targets": cond.get("targets", []),
             "scope_by_address": cond.get("scope_model") == "address",
             "web_target": web_target(pid),
             "caps": re.findall(r"cap(?:ped)? at [^\n.]{0,60}", blob, re.I)[:4]}
    brief_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps(brief, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    ok = (bool(addrs) or bool(rewards) or bool(cond.get("severity"))
          or len(oos) >= 3 or web_only(pid))
    setp(pid, brief_ok=1 if ok else 0, details_ok=1 if ok else 0)
    log(pid, "brief: %d in-scope, %d exclusions, %d heads, %d tiers, submit=%s%s"
        % (len(addrs), len(oos), len(tmpl), len(rewards), brief["submit_to"] or "?",
           "" if ok else " - thin"))
    return ok


def st_gate(pid, ctx):
    if not GATE:
        return 0
    pol = policy(pid)
    score_findings(pid)
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? ORDER BY fund DESC, score DESC", (pid,))]
        judged = []
        for r in rows:
            try:
                ok, blockers, reward = judge(r, pol)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "gate: judge failed on %s (%s)" % (r["id"], ex))
                ok, blockers, reward = 1, ["judge-error"], 0
            judged.append((ok, blockers))
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET eligible=?, blockers=?, reward=?, judged=1, stale=0 "
                      "WHERE id=?", (ok, json.dumps(blockers), reward, r["id"]))
    kept = sum(1 for ok, _ in judged if ok)
    ready = sum(1 for ok, b in judged if ok and not b)
    setp(pid, readiness=int(100 * ready / kept) if kept else 0)
    log(pid, "gate: %d of %d eligible, %d submission-ready" % (kept, len(rows), ready))
    if not kept and rows:
        top = [r["cls"] for r in rows[:5]]
        log(pid, "gate: nothing eligible, dominant classes %s" % ",".join(sorted(set(top))))
    return kept


def st_scopeaddr(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    sf = root / "scope.txt"
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if sf.exists() else ""
    cond = load_cond(pid)
    pairs = [(t["address"], t.get("chain") or "eth") for t in cond.get("targets", [])]
    if not pairs:
        pairs = [(a, "eth") for a in sorted(set(ADDR_RE.findall(blob + " " + (p.get("url") or ""))))]
    if not pairs and PROBE_BOUNTY and not web_only(pid):
        host = urllib.parse.urlparse(p.get("url") or "").netloc.replace("www.", "")
        b = probe_bounty(host)
        if b and b.rstrip("/") != (p.get("url") or "").rstrip("/"):
            try:
                extra = fetch_host(b, HP_COOKIE)
                (root / "bounty.txt").write_text(extra, encoding="utf-8")
                blob += extra
                pairs = [(a, "eth") for a in sorted(set(ADDR_RE.findall(blob)))]
                log(pid, "scope: bounty page %s (%d addr)" % (b, len(pairs)))
            except Exception:
                pass
    chains = sorted({c for _, c in pairs}) or chains_for(blob + " " + (p.get("url") or ""))
    if pairs:
        (root / "addresses.txt").write_text("\n".join(a for a, _ in pairs), encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "addr_chain.txt").write_text(
            "\n".join("%s %s" % (a, c) for a, c in pairs), encoding="utf-8")
        setp(pid, address_mode=1, notes=",".join(chains), details_ok=1,
             targets_n=len(pairs))
        log(pid, "scope: %d address(es) across %s" % (len(pairs), ",".join(chains)))
    (root / "scoped").write_text(str(time.time()), encoding="utf-8")
    ctx["chains"] = chains
    return len(pairs)


def st_onchain(pid, ctx):
    af = WORK / str(pid) / "addr_chain.txt"
    if not af.exists() or not ETHERSCAN_KEY:
        return 0
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "onchain"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pairs = [ln.split() for ln in af.read_text().splitlines() if len(ln.split()) == 2]
    got = 0
    for addr, ch in pairs[:12]:
        if ch not in CHAINS or CHAINS[ch].get("evm") is False:
            continue
        targets = [(addr, "proxy")]
        impl = impl_of(ch, addr)
        if impl:
            targets.append((impl, "impl"))
        wrote = 0
        for a, kind in targets:
            src = es_source(ch, a)
            if not src or not src["src"].strip():
                continue
            d = root / ("%s_%s" % (ch, addr[:10]))
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (d / ("%s_%s.sol" % (src["name"], kind))).write_text(src["src"], encoding="utf-8")
            wrote += 1
            log(pid, "onchain: %s %s %s (%d bytes)" % (ch, kind, a[:10], len(src["src"])))
        got += wrote
        time.sleep(0.3)
    if got:
        log(pid, "onchain: %d contract(s) pulled" % got)
        setp(pid, details_ok=1)
    return got


def st_onchain_stage(pid, ctx):
    """Copy pulled bytecode sources into a real compile root so forge and slither see them."""
    src = WORK / str(pid) / "onchain"
    if not src.exists():
        return 0
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    dst = root / "src"
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    for f in src.rglob("*.sol"):
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not re.search(r"\b(?:contract|library)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*", t):
            continue
        (dst / ("%s__%s" % (f.parent.name, f.name))).write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
        n += 1
    if not n:
        log(pid, "stage: onchain tree empty, nothing to compile")
        return 0
    repair_forge_toml(pid, root)
    repair_source(pid, root)
    ctx["root"] = root
    sol = sol_files(root)
    if sol:
        ctx["primary"] = str(sol[0])
    log(pid, "stage: %d source(s) into src/ for compilation" % n)
    return n


def st_value(pid, ctx):
    """Price the in-scope contracts so triage can rank by dollars, not by regex."""
    af = WORK / str(pid) / "addr_chain.txt"
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    rows, total = [], 0
    if af.exists() and VALUE_CENSUS:
        for line in af.read_text().splitlines()[:20]:
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) != 2:
                continue
            addr, ch = parts
            if CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("evm") is False:
                continue
            wei, assets, supply = 0, 0, 0
            try:
                b = rpc(ch, "eth_getBalance", [addr, "latest"])
                if b:
                    wei = int(b, 16)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                v = eth_call(ch, addr, SEL_TOTAL_ASSETS)
                if v and v not in ("0x", "0x0"):
                    assets = int(v, 16)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                v = eth_call(ch, addr, SEL_TOTAL_SUPPLY)
                if v and v not in ("0x", "0x0"):
                    supply = int(v, 16)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not (wei or assets or supply):
                continue
            rows.append((addr, ch, wei, assets, supply))
            total += wei + assets
    tvl = total
    setp(pid, tvl=tvl)
    lines = ["# value census", ""]
    for addr, ch, wei, assets, supply in rows:
        lines.append("%s %s native=%d totalAssets=%d totalSupply=%d"
                     % (ch, addr, wei, assets, supply))
    if rows:
        (root / "value.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        top = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[2] + r[3])
        log(pid, "value: %d contract(s) hold funds, largest %s on %s (%d wei + %d units)"
            % (len(rows), top[0][:10], top[1], top[2], top[3]))
        if tvl:
            log(pid, "value: census total %s" % ("%.4f ETH-equivalent" % (tvl / 1e18)))
    else:
        log(pid, "value: no on-chain funds readable")
    return len(rows)


def repo_rank(full):
    r = full.split("/")[-1]
    s = 0
    if DOCS_RE.search(r):
        s -= 10
    if CODE_RE.search(r):
        s += 5
    return s


def _uniq_repos(rs):
    seen, out = set(), []
    for r in rs:
        b = r.split("/")[-1].lower()
        if b in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(b)
        out.append(r)
    return out


def st_surface(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    direct = c4_repo(p.get("url") or "")
    if direct:
        (root / "repos.txt").write_text(direct, encoding="utf-8")
        ok, lang = gh_meta(direct)
        if ok:
            langs_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps({direct: lang or ""}), encoding="utf-8")
        log(pid, "surface: code4rena repo %s" % direct)
        return [direct]
    m = GH_URL_RE.match(p.get("url") or "")
    if m and REPO_RE.match(m.group(1)):
        repo = m.group(1)
        ok, lang = gh_meta(repo)
        if ok:
            (root / "repos.txt").write_text(repo, encoding="utf-8")
            langs_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps({repo: lang or ""}), encoding="utf-8")
            log(pid, "surface: target is a repository %s" % repo)
            return [repo]
    if web_only(pid):
        (root / "repos.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        langs_path(pid).write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        log(pid, "surface: web-only program, no repo hunt")
        return []
    sf = root / "scope.txt"
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if sf.exists() else ""
    cands = repos_in(blob, limit=12)
    repos, langs = [], {}
    for r in cands:
        if not REPO_RE.match(r):
            continue
        ok, lang = gh_meta(r)
        if not ok:
            continue
        repos.append(r)
        langs[r] = lang or ""
        if len(repos) >= 2:
            break
    repos.sort(key=repo_rank, reverse=True)
    repos = _uniq_repos(repos)[:4]
    if not repos and GH_TOKEN and not addr_exists(pid):
        try:
            js = fetch_json("https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=%s&per_page=8"
                            % urllib.parse.quote(p.get("name") or ""),
                            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + GH_TOKEN})
            for it in js.get("items", []):
                ok, lang = gh_meta(it["full_name"])
                if ok:
                    repos.append(it["full_name"])
                    langs[it["full_name"]] = lang or ""
                if len(repos) >= 4:
                    break
            repos = _uniq_repos(repos)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "surface: api failed (%s)" % ex)
    (root / "repos.txt").write_text("\n".join(repos), encoding="utf-8")
    langs_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps(langs), encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "surface: %d confirmed repo(s) of %d candidate(s)" % (len(repos), len(cands)))
    return repos


def st_clone(pid, ctx):
    base = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    rmtree_force(base)
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rf = WORK / str(pid) / "repos.txt"
    repos = rf.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split() if rf.exists() else []
    ok = 0
    for r in repos:
        dest = base / re.sub(r"[^\w.-]+", "_", r.replace("/", "__"))
        url = ("https://%s@github.com/%s.git" % (GH_TOKEN, r)) if GH_TOKEN \
            else "https://github.com/%s.git" % r
        rc, out, err = sh(["git", "-c", "credential.helper=", "clone", "--depth", "1",
                           "--single-branch", url, str(dest)], timeout=600,
                          env={"GCM_INTERACTIVE": "never", "GIT_ASKPASS": "echo"})
        if rc == 0:
            ok += 1
            log(pid, "clone: ok %s" % r)
        else:
            tail = (err or out).strip().splitlines()
            log(pid, "clone: fail %s (%s)" % (r, tail[-1] if tail else "?"))
    dirs = [d for d in base.iterdir() if d.is_dir()]
    if dirs:
        ctx["root"] = dirs[0]
        log(pid, "clone: primary root -> %s" % dirs[0].name)
    return ok


def st_toolchain(pid, ctx):
    """Evidence only. manual, manifest, census, address, github, surface."""
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    cur = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    if cur not in TYPES:
        cur = "unknown"
    root = ctx["root"]
    ev = {}
    if p.get("type_locked") and cur not in ("unknown", ""):
        best, conf = cur, "manual"
        ev["reason"] = "manual lock"
    elif web_only(pid):
        best, conf = "web", "surface"
        ev["reason"] = "web-only program"
    else:
        best, conf = "unknown", "none"
        m, hits = manifest_type(root)
        if m:
            best, conf = m, "manifest"
            ev["manifest"] = sorted({h[1] for h in hits})[:6]
        else:
            counts, primary, total = census(root, WORK / str(pid) / "onchain")
            ev["files"] = total
            ev["counts"] = {k: v for k, v in counts.items() if v}
            top = max(counts, key=lambda k: counts[k]) if ev["counts"] else None
            if top and (counts[top] >= 2 or primary.get(top)):
                best, conf = top, "census"
            elif addr_exists(pid):
                best, conf = "solidity", "address"
                ev["reason"] = "in-scope addresses define scope"
            elif read_gh_lang(pid) and not docs_only(pid):
                best, conf = read_gh_lang(pid), "github"
                ev["reason"] = "github repo language, no source in tree"
            elif (WORK / str(pid) / "web_surface").exists():
                best, conf = "web", "surface"
                ev["reason"] = "html surface, no source"
        counts2, primary2, _ = census(root, WORK / str(pid) / "onchain")
        sec = sorted([k for k in counts2 if k != best and
                      (primary2.get(k) or counts2[k] >= 2)])
        setp(pid, type_all=json.dumps(sec))
    setp(pid, toolchain=best, type_conf=conf, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:900])
    sol = sol_files(root)
    if sol and not ctx.get("primary"):
        ctx["primary"] = str(sol[0])
    elif not sol:
        ctx["primary"] = str(root)
    counts = ev.get("counts") or {}
    pretty = ", ".join("%d %s" % (v, k) for k, v in sorted(counts.items()))
    log(pid, "type: %s (%s)%s" % (best, CONF_LABEL.get(conf, conf),
                                  " [" + pretty + "]" if pretty else ""))
    if best != cur:
        log(pid, "type: %s -> %s" % (cur, best))
        if cur not in ("unknown", ""):
            keep = tuple(EXT.get(best, []))
            gone = 0
            with db() as c:
                for r in [dict(x) for x in c.execute(
                        "SELECT id,file FROM findings WHERE pid=?", (pid,))]:
                    f = (r["file"] or "").lower()
                    if f.startswith("onchain") or (keep and f.endswith(keep)):
                        continue
                    if best == "web" and any(k in f for k in WEBISH):
                        continue
                    c.execute("DELETE FROM findings WHERE id=?", (r["id"],))
                    gone += 1
            if gone:
                log(pid, "type: %d finding(s) dropped, no longer matching %s" % (gone, best))
    if best == "unknown":
        log(pid, "type: UNRESOLVED - set it from the overview panel")
    if best == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    elif sol and addr_exists(pid):
        ctx["root"] = root
    return counts.get(best, 0)


def _write_echidna_cfg(root):
    f = Path(root) / "echidna.yaml"
    if f.exists():
        return
    f.write_text("testMode: assertion\nseqLen: 100\ntestLimit: 50000\n"
                 "shrinkLimit: 5000\ncorpusDir: echidna-corpus\n", encoding="utf-8")


def st_deps(pid, ctx):
    root = ctx["root"]
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}):
        return True
    _write_echidna_cfg(root)
    if not (root / "foundry.toml").exists():
        repair_forge_toml(pid, root)
    if (root / "lib").exists() or (root / "node_modules").exists():
        repair_remappings(pid, root)
    rc, out, err = sh(["forge", "install", "--no-git"], cwd=root, timeout=900)
    if rc != 0 and "not found" in err.lower():
        log(pid, "deps: forge absent")
    return True


def st_build(pid, ctx):
    root = ctx["root"]
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}) or not have("forge"):
        return True
    if not any((root / n).exists() for n in ("foundry.toml", "hardhat.config.ts",
                                             "hardhat.config.js")):
        log(pid, "build: no config at root, skipped")
        return True
    rc, out, err = sh(["forge", "build"], cwd=root, timeout=1800)
    if rc != 0:
        log(pid, "build failed: %s" % classify(err + out))
        repair_source(pid, root)
        repair_remappings(pid, root)
        rc, out, err = sh(["forge", "build"], cwd=root, timeout=1800)
    log(pid, "build: %s" % ("ok" if rc == 0 else "failing, static continues"))
    return rc == 0


def _run_lvl(pid, ctx, lvl, label, token=None):
    n = 0
    wd = web_disabled(pid)
    tools = tools_for(pid, lvl)
    if not tools:
        log(pid, "%s: no applicable method for this type" % label)
        return 0
    for t in tools:
        if token is not None and token.is_set():
            break
        if wd and t.get("web"):
            continue
        try:
            n += t["run"](ctx) or 0
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "%s crashed: %s" % (t["id"], str(ex)[:160]))
            run_repair(pid, classify(str(ex)), str(ex), ctx["root"])
    log(pid, "%s: %d hit(s) via %d method(s)" % (label, n, len(tools)))
    return n


def st_static(pid, ctx):
    return _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 1, "static")


def st_baseline(pid, ctx):
    bl = ctx["root"] / "audits"
    if bl.exists():
        log(pid, "baseline: %d audit file(s)" % len(list(bl.rglob("*"))))
    return True


def _primary_contract(root):
    """Largest contract body, not the first match in the first file."""
    best = (0, None, None)
    for f in sol_files(root):
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        for m in re.finditer(r"\bcontract\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)", t):
            span = brace_span(t, t.find("{", m.end()))
            if len(span) > best[0]:
                best = (len(span), m.group(1), f)
    return best[1], best[2]


def st_harness(pid, ctx):
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}) or not have("forge"):
        return True
    root = ctx["root"]
    name, prim = _primary_contract(root)
    if not name or not prim:
        log(pid, "harness: no contract body found")
        return False
    sh(["forge", "build"], cwd=root, timeout=1800)
    rc, abi, err = sh(["forge", "inspect", name, "abi"], cwd=root, timeout=300)
    if rc != 0:
        log(pid, "harness: abi inspect failed for %s (%s) - file still written"
            % (name, classify(err)))
    tdir = root / "test"
    tdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tgt = (policy(pid)["targets"] or [{}])[0]
    (tdir / "BHAttacker.t.sol").write_text(
        '// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n'
        'import "forge-std/Test.sol";\nimport "../%s";\n\n'
        'contract BHAttacker is Test {\n  %s t;\n'
        '  address constant TARGET = %s;\n'
        '  function setUp() public {\n    t = new %s();\n  }\n'
        '  function test_probe() public { assertTrue(address(t) != address(0)); }\n}\n'
        % (rel(root, prim), name, tgt.get("address") or "address(0)", name), encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "harness: BHAttacker for %s" % name)
    return True


def st_symbolic(pid, ctx):
    return _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 2, "symbolic")


def st_fork(pid, ctx):
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}) or not have("forge"):
        return True
    root = ctx["root"]
    pol = policy(pid)
    if not ctx.get("chains"):
        ctx["chains"] = sorted({t.get("chain") or "eth" for t in pol["targets"]}) or ["eth"]
    for ch in ctx["chains"]:
        if CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("evm") is not False and not fork_block(ch):
            log(pid, "fork: %s has no pin in FORK_BLOCKS" % ch)
    if not (root / "test" / "BHAttacker.t.sol").exists():
        log(pid, "fork: no harness, skipped")
        return True
    done = 0
    for ch in ctx["chains"]:
        if CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("evm") is False:
            log(pid, "fork: %s is not EVM, skipped" % ch)
            continue
        rpc_url = CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("rpc")
        if not rpc_url:
            continue
        blk = safe_fork_block(ch)
        if not blk:
            log(pid, "fork: no pin for %s, skipped" % ch)
            continue
        cmd = ["forge", "test", "--fork-url", rpc_url, "--match-contract", "BHAttacker",
               "-vv", "--fork-block-number", str(blk)]
        log(pid, "fork: pinned %s at %d" % (ch, blk))
        rc, out, err = sh(cmd, cwd=root, timeout=1800)
        if rc == 0:
            done += 1
            log(pid, "fork: ok on %s" % ch)
        else:
            log(pid, "fork: failed on %s (%s)" % (ch, classify(err + out)))
    return done


def st_adversarial(pid, ctx):
    ctx["depth"] = 1 + int((getp(pid) or {}).get("cycle") or 0)
    return _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 4, "adversarial")


def st_hammer(pid, ctx):
    depth = min(HAMMER_DEPTH, 1 + int((getp(pid) or {}).get("cycle") or 0))
    ctx["depth"] = depth
    n = _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 5, "hammer")
    log(pid, "hammer: depth %d" % depth)
    return n


def st_triage(pid, ctx):
    pol = policy(pid)
    rows = score_findings(pid)
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-(r.get("fund") or 0), -r["score"]))
    ready = 0
    fund = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("fund"))
    setp(pid, fund_hits=fund)
    seen, shown = set(), 0
    for r in rows:
        if shown >= 14:
            break
        key = (r["title"], r["file"])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        shown += 1
        ok, blockers, reward = judge(r, pol)
        tag = "FUND " if r.get("fund") else ""
        if ok and not blockers:
            ready += 1
            log(pid, "triage: READY %s%s %s reward<=$%s" % (tag, r["sev"], r["title"], reward))
        elif blockers:
            log(pid, "triage: %s%s blocked by %s" % (tag, r["title"][:60], ",".join(blockers)))
    if fund:
        log(pid, "triage: %d of %d findings are money classes" % (fund, len(rows)))
    return ready


def st_report(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    pol = policy(pid)
    with db() as c:
        unj = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND judged=0",
                        (pid,)).fetchone()[0]
    if unj:
        log(pid, "report: %d finding(s) never judged - judging now" % unj)
        st_gate(pid, ctx)
    if not pol["targets"] and pol["scope_model"] == "address":
        log(pid, "report: address scope but no target parsed - ungrounded")
    if not p.get("cond_ok"):
        log(pid, "report: no program contract parsed - conditions unknown")
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1 "
            "ORDER BY score DESC", (pid,))]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-(r.get("fund") or 0), -SEV_BASE.get(r["sev"], 0)))
    tmpl = pol["template"] or BRIEF_TMPL
    tgt = (pol["targets"] or [{}])[0]
    src = ("onchain bytecode" if (WORK / str(pid) / "onchain").exists()
           else "repository source" if (WORK / str(pid) / "repos.txt").exists()
           else "app surface" if web_target(pid) else "page only")
    tvl = p.get("tvl") or 0
    out = ["# %s - submission pack" % p.get("name"), "",
           "<!-- generated %s · contract %s · cycle %s -->"
           % (time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), (pol["contract_sha"] or "none")[:12],
              p.get("cycle")), "",
           "- grounded on: %s" % src,
           "- target: %s @ %s (%s)" % (tgt.get("contract") or "-", tgt.get("address") or "-",
                                       tgt.get("chain") or "-"),
           "- scope model: %s · contracts in scope: %d"
           % (pol["scope_model"], len(pol["targets"])),
           "- url: %s" % p.get("url")]
    if web_target(pid):
        out.append("- app: %s" % web_target(pid))
    if tvl:
        out.append("- value census: %.4f ETH-equivalent across %d contract(s)"
                   % (tvl / 1e18, p.get("targets_n") or 0))
    out += ["- type: %s (%s)" % (TYPE_LABEL.get(p.get("toolchain") or "unknown", "?"),
                                 CONF_LABEL.get(p.get("type_conf") or "none", "?")),
            "- submit: %s via %s" % (pol["submit"]["address"] or "?",
                                     pol["submit"]["channel"] or "?"),
            "- subject: %s" % (pol["submit"]["subject_fmt"] or "[BOUNTY] <contract> - <impact>"),
            "- poc: %s%s" % (pol["poc"]["framework"] or "any",
                             ", fork pinned" if pol["poc"]["block_pin"] else ""),
            "- template: %s" % " / ".join(tmpl),
            "- length: %s" % ("one page max" if pol["one_page"] else "unbounded"), ""]
    if pol.get("severity_assumed"):
        out += ["- reward bands: ASSUMED defaults, no table in the program", ""]
    hard = [k for k, v in pol["constraints"].items() if v]
    if hard:
        out += ["- program constraints: %s" % ", ".join(hard), ""]
    if pol["caps"]:
        out += ["- caps: %s" % "; ".join(pol["caps"]), ""]
    fund = [r for r in rows if r.get("fund")]
    out += ["## findings", "",
            "%d money-class finding(s) of %d. Ranked by value at risk." % (len(fund), len(rows)),
            ""]
    if not rows:
        out += ["Nothing passed the gate.", ""]
    for i, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
        blockers = json.loads(r["blockers"] or "[]")
        ok, _, reward = judge(r, pol)
        vals = {"TARGET": "%s block %s" % (r["file"], r.get("line") or 1),
                "INVARIANT": r["title"], "IMPACT": r["impact"],
                "PRECONDITIONS": "see evidence", "ATTACK": (r["evidence"] or "")[:600],
                "POC": r["poc_path"] or r["poc"], "FIX": "see evidence"}
        out += ["### %d. [%s] %s%s" % (i, r["sev"].upper(),
                                       "FUND " if r.get("fund") else "", r["title"]), "",
                "- class: %s" % r["cls"], "- where: %s" % r["file"],
                "- reward band: %s" % ("$%s" % reward if reward else "unlisted"),
                "- status: %s" % ("READY" if ok and not blockers else
                                  "blocked: " + ", ".join(blockers) if blockers
                                  else "ineligible"), ""]
        for h in tmpl:
            out.append("%s: %s" % (h, vals.get(h, "")))
        out += ["", "```", (r["evidence"] or "")[:1200], "```", ""]
    txt = "\n".join(out)
    (WORK / str(pid) / "report.md").write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
    slug = p.get("slug")
    if slug:
        try:
            (WORK / slug).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (WORK / slug / "report.md").write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass
    if pol["one_page"] and len(txt.splitlines()) > pol["max_lines"]:
        log(pid, "report: %d lines, program caps at one page" % len(txt.splitlines()))
    log(pid, "report: %d finding(s) (%d fund), template %s"
        % (len(rows), len(fund), "/".join(tmpl[:4])))
    return len(rows)


def st_poc(pid, ctx):
    pol = policy(pid)
    if not pol["poc"]["required"] and not web_only(pid):
        log(pid, "poc: not required by this program")
        return 0
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1 AND poc_path='' "
            "AND sev IN ('critical','high','medium') ORDER BY fund DESC, score DESC LIMIT 12",
            (pid,))]
    n = 0
    for r in rows:
        if poc_stub(pid, r, pol):
            n += 1
    log(pid, "poc: %d artefact(s) written" % n)
    return n


PREP_STEPS = ["intake", "conditions", "brief", "scope", "onchain", "onchain_stage",
              "value", "surface"]
ACQUIRE_STEPS = ["clone", "toolchain", "deps", "build"]

LEVEL_STEPS = {
    0: PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS,
    1: ["static", "gate", "baseline"],
    2: ["harness", "symbolic"],
    3: ["fork"],
    4: ["adversarial"],
    5: ["hammer", "triage", "gate", "poc"],
}
LEVEL_NAME = {0: "recon", 1: "static", 2: "symbolic", 3: "dynamic", 4: "adversarial", 5: "hammer"}

STEP_FN = {"intake": st_intake, "conditions": st_conditions, "brief": st_brief,
           "gate": st_gate, "scope": st_scopeaddr, "onchain": st_onchain,
           "onchain_stage": st_onchain_stage, "value": st_value,
           "surface": st_surface, "clone": st_clone, "toolchain": st_toolchain,
           "deps": st_deps, "build": st_build, "static": st_static,
           "baseline": st_baseline, "harness": st_harness, "symbolic": st_symbolic,
           "fork": st_fork, "adversarial": st_adversarial, "hammer": st_hammer,
           "triage": st_triage, "report": st_report, "poc": st_poc}


def run_step(pid, name, ctx):
    fn = STEP_FN[name]
    setp(pid, stage=name)
    try:
        return fn(pid, ctx)
    except Exception as ex:
        kind = classify(str(ex))
        log(pid, "%s failed [%s]: %s" % (name, kind, str(ex)[:300]))
        setp(pid, repairs=int((getp(pid) or {}).get("repairs") or 0) + 1)
        for _ in range(MAX_REPAIRS):
            if not run_repair(pid, kind, str(ex), ctx.get("root")):
                break
            try:
                return fn(pid, ctx)
            except Exception as ex2:
                log(pid, "%s retry failed: %s" % (name, str(ex2)[:200]))
                kind = classify(str(ex2))
        return None


def has_surface(pid):
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    for f in ("repos.txt", "addresses.txt", "web_target.txt"):
        p = root / f
        if p.exists() and p.read_text().strip():
            return True
    return (root / "web_surface").exists()


def _run_once(pid, token, start_level=0):
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root, "depth": 1}
    if start_level == 0:
        for name in PREP_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            if name == "intake":
                if not run_step(pid, name, ctx):
                    setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake")
                    log(pid, "details thin or absent - parked, nothing downloaded")
                    return "needs-details"
            else:
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        if not details_ok(pid):
            setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="prep")
            log(pid, "details incomplete - repo not downloaded, retry with restart")
            return "needs-details"
        log(pid, "details complete - acquiring code")
        for name in ACQUIRE_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    tc = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    pol = policy(pid)
    if tc == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    if not has_surface(pid):
        raise RuntimeError("no_files: no repo, no address, no app target")
    if tc == "unknown":
        log(pid, "type unresolved - language-agnostic methods only")
    if pol["scope_model"] == "address":
        log(pid, "address-defined scope: repo-only findings demoted")
    for lvl in range(max(start_level, 1), 6):
        if token.is_set():
            return
        if not tools_for(pid, lvl):
            setp(pid, escalation=lvl + 1)
            continue
        log(pid, "--- L%d %s ---" % (lvl, LEVEL_NAME[lvl]))
        for name in LEVEL_STEPS[lvl]:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        score_findings(pid)
        found = best_score(pid)
        rank = best_rank(pid)
        if found and rank >= THRESHOLD and lvl >= 3:
            log(pid, "L%d landed %s (rank %d >= %s)" % (lvl, found.upper(), rank, THRESHOLD))
            setp(pid, escalation=lvl)
            return found
        if lvl >= 5:
            if found:
                log(pid, "L%d best %s rank %d, under threshold %s"
                    % (lvl, found.upper(), rank, THRESHOLD))
                setp(pid, escalation=lvl)
                return found
            log(pid, "L%d nothing above threshold" % lvl)
        setp(pid, escalation=lvl + 1)
    return best_score(pid)


def attack_until_finding(pid, token):
    setp(pid, status="running", cycle=0, attempts=0)
    for cycle in range(1, MAX_CYCLES + 1):
        if token.is_set():
            setp(pid, status="stopped")
            return "stopped"
        setp(pid, cycle=cycle)
        if cycle == 1:
            log(pid, "----- new run %s -----" % time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
        log(pid, "===== cycle %d/%d =====" % (cycle, MAX_CYCLES))
        ok = False
        for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
            if token.is_set():
                break
            setp(pid, attempts=attempt)
            try:
                r = _run_once(pid, token, start_level=0 if attempt == 1 else 1)
                ok = r != "needs-details"
                break
            except Exception as ex:
                kind = classify(str(ex))
                log(pid, "cycle %d attempt %d failed [%s]: %s"
                    % (cycle, attempt, kind, str(ex)[:250]))
                if kind == "no_files":
                    setp(pid, address_mode=1)
                else:
                    run_repair(pid, kind, str(ex), WORK / str(pid) / "repo")
                time.sleep(3 * attempt)
        if ok and best_score(pid) in ("critical", "high", "medium") and \
                best_rank(pid) >= THRESHOLD:
            run_step(pid, "report", {"pid": pid, "root": WORK / str(pid) / "repo"})
            setp(pid, status="done", stage="report")
            return best_score(pid)
        if ok:
            run_step(pid, "report", {"pid": pid, "root": WORK / str(pid) / "repo"})
        if cycle < MAX_CYCLES:
            wait = int(CYCLE_SLEEP * cycle)
            log(pid, "widening, next cycle in %ds" % wait)
            for _ in range(wait):
                if token.is_set():
                    break
                time.sleep(1)
    setp(pid, status="barren", stage="report")
    log(pid, "barren after %d cycles" % MAX_CYCLES)
    return "barren"


def attack_plan(pid):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    tc = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    langs = langs_of(p)
    pol = policy(pid)
    wd = web_disabled(pid)
    levels = []
    for lvl in range(0, 6):
        if lvl == 0:
            levels.append({"level": 0, "name": LEVEL_NAME[0],
                           "count": len(PREP_STEPS) + len(ACQUIRE_STEPS),
                           "tools": PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS, "applicable": True,
                           "note": "details first, download only when they are in"})
            continue
        tools = [t["id"] for t in TOOLS.values() if t["lvl"] == lvl and lang_ok(t, langs, tc)]
        fund = [t for t in tools if TOOLS[t].get("fund")]
        note = ""
        if not tools:
            note = "no %s method for %s" % (LEVEL_NAME[lvl], tc)
        elif wd and all(TOOLS[t].get("web") for t in tools):
            note = "web surface excluded by program"
        elif wd:
            tools = [t for t in tools if not TOOLS[t].get("web")]
        if fund:
            note = (note + " · " if note else "") + "%d fund method(s)" % len(fund)
        levels.append({"level": lvl, "name": LEVEL_NAME[lvl], "count": len(tools),
                       "tools": tools, "applicable": bool(tools), "note": note})
    return {"toolchain": tc, "label": TYPE_LABEL.get(tc, tc),
            "conf": p.get("type_conf") or "none", "levels": levels,
            "scope_model": pol["scope_model"], "poc_required": pol["poc"]["required"],
            "details_ok": bool(p.get("details_ok")), "web_target": web_target(pid),
            "tvl": p.get("tvl") or 0, "threshold": THRESHOLD}


def _single_tool(pid, token, tid):
    t = TOOLS.get(tid)
    if not t:
        log(pid, "tool: unknown id %s" % tid)
        return
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    if not lang_ok(t, langs_of(p), p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"):
        log(pid, "tool: %s does not apply to %s (skipped)" % (tid, p.get("toolchain")))
        return
    setp(pid, status="running", stage=tid)
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root, "depth": 1}
    if p.get("toolchain") == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    if not has_surface(pid):
        log(pid, "tool: no surface yet, running recon first")
        for name in PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        if (getp(pid) or {}).get("toolchain") == "web":
            ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    log(pid, "tool: manual %s (%s)" % (tid, t["name"]))
    try:
        n = t["run"](ctx) or 0
        log(pid, "tool: %s -> %d hit(s)" % (tid, n))
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "tool: %s failed (%s)" % (tid, str(ex)[:200]))
        run_repair(pid, classify(str(ex)), str(ex), ctx["root"])
    score_findings(pid)
    run_step(pid, "gate", ctx)
    run_step(pid, "report", ctx)
    setp(pid, status="done", stage=tid)


def _single_level(pid, token, lvl):
    setp(pid, status="running", stage=LEVEL_NAME.get(lvl, "?"))
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root, "depth": 1}
    if (getp(pid) or {}).get("toolchain") == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    if lvl == 0:
        for name in PREP_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            if name == "intake" and not run_step(pid, name, ctx):
                setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake")
                log(pid, "details thin or absent - parked, nothing downloaded")
                return
            if name != "intake":
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        if details_ok(pid):
            for name in ACQUIRE_STEPS:
                if token.is_set():
                    return
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        else:
            setp(pid, status="needs-details")
            log(pid, "details incomplete - nothing downloaded")
            return
    else:
        if not has_surface(pid):
            log(pid, "level %d: no surface yet, running recon first" % lvl)
            for name in PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS:
                if token.is_set():
                    return
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
            if (getp(pid) or {}).get("toolchain") == "web":
                ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
        log(pid, "--- manual L%d %s ---" % (lvl, LEVEL_NAME[lvl]))
        for name in LEVEL_STEPS.get(lvl, []):
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
    score_findings(pid)
    run_step(pid, "gate", ctx)
    run_step(pid, "report", ctx)
    setp(pid, status="done", stage=LEVEL_NAME.get(lvl, "?"))


def pool_worker():
    while True:
        job = JOBQ.get()
        if job is None:
            return
        pid, token, mode, value = job
        try:
            if mode == "tool":
                _single_tool(pid, token, value)
            elif mode == "level":
                _single_level(pid, token, int(value))
            else:
                attack_until_finding(pid, token)
        except Exception:
            log(pid, "FATAL " + traceback.format_exc(limit=4))
            setp(pid, status="failed")
        finally:
            with RUN_LOCK:
                RUNNING.pop(pid, None)
            setp(pid, last_run=time.time())
            JOBQ.task_done()


def start_attack(pid, mode="full", value=None):
    if not getp(pid):
        return False, "no project"
    with RUN_LOCK:
        if pid in RUNNING:
            return False, "already running"
        token = threading.Event()
        RUNNING[pid] = token
    JOBQ.put((pid, token, mode, value))
    return True, "queued"


def stop_attack(pid):
    with RUN_LOCK:
        token = RUNNING.get(pid)
    if not token:
        return False
    token.set()
    return True


def running_pids():
    with RUN_LOCK:
        return sorted(RUNNING.keys())


def start_all():
    STOP.clear()
    claimed = []
    with db() as c:
        free = max(1, WORKERS - len(running_pids()))
        rows = [r["id"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM projects WHERE status IN ('idle','failed','barren','stopped',"
            "'needs-details') AND auto=1 ORDER BY rank LIMIT ?", (free,))]
        for pid in rows:
            if c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='running' WHERE id=? AND status IN "
                         "('idle','failed','barren','stopped','needs-details')",
                         (pid,)).rowcount:
                claimed.append(pid)
    started = 0
    for pid in claimed:
        ok, _ = start_attack(pid, "full")
        if ok:
            started += 1
        else:
            setp(pid, status="idle")
    log(0, "start_all: %d queued (%d busy, %d worker(s))"
        % (started, len(running_pids()), WORKERS))


def stop_all():
    for pid in running_pids():
        stop_attack(pid)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='stopped' WHERE status='running'")
    log(0, "stop_all: signalled %d job(s)" % len(running_pids()))


SEV_LINK = re.compile(r'href="(/bounty/[^"]+|/bug-bounty/[^"]+|/programs/[^"]+|/audits/[^"]+|'
                      r'/engagements/[^"]+|/competitions/[^"]+|/contests/[^"]+|'
                      r'https://github\.com/[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+)"')
MD_LINK = re.compile(r"\]\((https?://[^)\s]+)\)")
BARE_LINK = re.compile(r"(?<![\w/])(https?://[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/[\w./-]{3,})")
USD = re.compile(r"\$[\d,.]+\s*[kKmM]?")


def score_program(url, maxpay, toolchain):
    s = 40
    if maxpay >= 100000:
        s += 25
    elif maxpay >= 50000:
        s += 15
    elif maxpay >= 10000:
        s += 8
    if toolchain == "solidity":
        s += 12
    elif toolchain in ("rust", "go", "c"):
        s += 9
    elif toolchain in ("js", "python", "java", "php", "ruby", "web"):
        s += 5
    if any(k in url for k in ("code4rena", "sherlock", "cantina")):
        s += 8
    return min(100, s)


def _listing_links(body, base):
    """HTML hrefs, then markdown links, then bare URLs - the reader emits markdown."""
    seen = set()
    for m in SEV_LINK.finditer(body):
        h = m.group(1)
        u = h if h.startswith("http") else base + h
        if u not in seen:
            seen.add(u)
            yield u, m.end()
    for rx in (MD_LINK, BARE_LINK):
        for m in rx.finditer(body):
            u = m.group(1)
            if u in seen or "duckduckgo" in u:
                continue
            seen.add(u)
            yield u, m.end()


DISCOVER_AUDIT = []


def parse_listing(host, body, base):
    out, seen, rejects = [], set(), []
    for url, end in _listing_links(body, base):
        url = norm_url(url)
        if url in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(url)
        ok, why = platforms.program_url_ok(url)
        if not ok:
            rejects.append({"url": url, "why": why})
            continue
        money_m = USD.search(body[end:end + 400])
        maxpay = 0
        if money_m:
            raw = money_m.group(0).replace("$", "").replace(",", "").strip()
            mult = 1
            if raw[-1:].lower() == "k":
                mult, raw = 1000, raw[:-1]
            elif raw[-1:].lower() == "m":
                mult, raw = 1000000, raw[:-1]
            try:
                maxpay = int(float(raw) * mult)
            except ValueError:
                maxpay = 0
        seg = [s for s in urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path.split("/") if s][-1]
        out.append({"name": seg.replace("-", " ").title(), "url": url, "max": maxpay})
    del DISCOVER_AUDIT[:0]
    DISCOVER_AUDIT.extend(rejects[:400])
    del DISCOVER_AUDIT[400:]
    return out


def listing(url, base, cookie=""):
    try:
        body = fetch_host(url, cookie)
    except Exception:
        body = ""
    if not body.strip() or len(SEV_LINK.findall(body)) < 3:
        alt = read_via(url)
        if alt.strip():
            body = alt
            log(0, "listing: reader fallback for %s" % base)
    return parse_listing(url, body, base)

def src_hats():
    out = []
    for u in ("https://hats.finance/competitions", "https://hats.finance/audits"):
        try:
            out += listing(u, "https://hats.finance")
        except Exception:
            continue
    return out
