@hammer("H15", "Attack chain builder", "chain", "critical", langs=None)
def h15(ctx):
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND gate NOT LIKE 'H15%'", (ctx["pid"],))]
    real = rows if web_only(ctx["pid"]) else [
        r for r in rows if (r["file"] or "").endswith(".sol") or (r["file"] or "").startswith("onchain")]
    if len(real) < 2:
        return 0
    by_file = {}
    for r in real:
        by_file.setdefault(r["file"], []).append(r)
    n = 0
    for f, group in by_file.items():
        classes = sorted({r["cls"] for r in group})
        if len(classes) < 2:
            continue
        sevs = {r["sev"] for r in group}
        sev = "critical" if "critical" in sevs else ("high" if "high" in sevs else "medium")
        if sev == "medium" and len(classes) < 3:
            continue
        group.sort(key=lambda r: -SEV_BASE.get(r["sev"], 0))
        ev = "\n".join("%s %s (%s:%s)" % (r["sev"], r["title"][:80], r["file"], r["line"])
                       for r in group[:6])
        add_finding(ctx["pid"], sev, "Chain in %s: %s" % (f, " + ".join(classes[:3])),
                    "chain", f, group[0]["line"], "combined weakness: %s" % ", ".join(classes),
                    "poc", ev, "H15")
        n += 1
        if n >= 8:
            break
    return n


# ============================= EXTERNAL TOOLS ================================

EXT_NOISE = re.compile(
    r"no contract was analyzed|compilation failed|^\s*error|^\s*info:|"
    r"^\s*warning:\s*slither|contracts? analyzed|^\W*$|"
    r"Traceback \(most recent call last\)|^\s+File \"", re.I)


def _ext_aderyn(text):
    cur = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        m = re.match(r"#{2,4}\s*(Critical|High|Medium|Low|Informational)\s*"
                     r"(?:Issues?|Vulnerabilit\w*)?\s*$", s, re.I)
        if m:
            cur = m.group(1).lower()
            continue
        m = re.match(r"#{3,5}\s*(?:\[?([A-Z]-\d+)\]?\s*)?(.{8,})$", s)
        if m and cur:
            yield cur, ("%s %s" % (m.group(1), m.group(2)))[:90]


EXT_PARSERS = {"aderyn": _ext_aderyn}


def _has(root, *names):
    return any((Path(root) / n).exists() for n in names)


def _has_sol(root):
    return bool(sol_files(root))


def _medusa_targets(root):
    f = Path(root) / "medusa.json"
    if not f.exists():
        f.write_text(json.dumps({"fuzzing": {"targetContracts": ["src"], "testLimit": 20000,
                                             "seqLen": 100}}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return ["fuzz"]


def _slither_argv(c):
    root = Path(c["root"])
    args = [".", "--exclude-dependencies"]
    if (root / "foundry.toml").exists():
        args += ["--compile-force-framework", "foundry"]
    elif any((root / n).exists() for n in ("hardhat.config.ts", "hardhat.config.js")):
        args += ["--compile-force-framework", "hardhat"]
    return args


def ext(tid, name, cls, sev, lvl, binary, argv, web=False, langs=None, analyzer=True,
        guard=None):
    def _run(ctx):
        if guard and not guard(ctx["root"]):
            log(ctx["pid"], "%s: manifest absent - skipped" % tid)
            return 0
        exe = _resolve_bin(binary)
        if not exe:
            log(ctx["pid"], "%s: %s absent - skipped" % (tid, binary))
            return 0
        rc, out, err = sh([exe] + argv(ctx), cwd=ctx["root"], timeout=1800)
        text = out + err
        if tid == "X02":
            rep = Path(ctx["root"]) / "aderyn-report.md"
            if rep.exists():
                text += "\n" + rep.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        parser = EXT_PARSERS.get(binary)
        n = 0
        if parser:
            for s, title in parser(text):
                add_finding(ctx["pid"], s, "%s: %s" % (name, title), cls, "tree", 1,
                            "external analyzer", "tool", title[:300], "L%d/%s" % (lvl, tid))
                n += 1
                if n >= 25:
                    break
            return n
        for line in text.splitlines():
            if re.search(r"Traceback \(most recent call last\)|^\s+File \"|^\s+\w+Error:", line):
                continue
            m = re.search(r"Severity:\s*(Critical|High|Medium|Low)\b", line, re.I)
            if m:
                s, title = m.group(1).lower(), line.strip()[:90]
            else:
                if EXT_NOISE.search(line):
                    continue
                m = re.search(r"(?:Critical|High|Medium|ERROR|WARNING)[^\n]{5,200}", line)
                if not m:
                    continue
                g = m.group(0)
                s = "critical" if "Critical" in g else ("high" if re.search(r"High|ERROR", g) else "medium")
                title = g[:90]
            add_finding(ctx["pid"], s, "%s: %s" % (name, title), cls, "tree", 1,
                        "external analyzer", "tool", line[:400], "L%d/%s" % (lvl, tid))
            n += 1
            if n >= 25:
                break
        if n == 0:
            first = next((l.strip() for l in text.splitlines()
                          if l.strip() and not EXT_NOISE.search(l)), "")
            log(ctx["pid"], "%s: 0 findings%s" % (tid, " - " + first[:110] if first else ""))
        return n
    TOOLS[tid] = {"id": tid, "name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev, "lvl": lvl,
                  "run": _run, "web": web, "langs": langs, "analyzer": analyzer,
                  "fund": cls in FUND_CLASSES}


ext("X01", "slither", "static", "high", 1, "slither", _slither_argv,
    langs=("solidity",), guard=_has_sol)
ext("X02", "aderyn", "static", "high", 1, "aderyn",
    lambda c: ["-o", "aderyn-report.md", "."], langs=("solidity",), guard=_has_sol)
ext("X03", "semgrep auto", "static", "medium", 1, "semgrep",
    lambda c: ["--config", "auto", "--quiet", "."], langs=None)
ext("X04", "mythril", "symbolic", "high", 2, "myth",
    lambda c: ["analyze", "--execution-timeout", "300", c.get("primary", ".")],
    langs=("solidity",), guard=_has_sol)
ext("X06", "echidna", "fuzz", "critical", 2, "echidna",
    lambda c: [c.get("primary", "."), "--config", "echidna.yaml"], langs=("solidity",),
    guard=_has_sol)
ext("X07", "medusa", "fuzz", "critical", 2, "medusa",
    lambda c: _medusa_targets(c["root"]), langs=("solidity",), guard=_has_sol)
ext("X20", "gitleaks", "secret", "critical", 1, "gitleaks", lambda c: ["detect", "--no-git", "-v"],
    analyzer=False)


def lang_ok(t, langs, prim):
    if t.get("web"):
        return prim == "web"
    tl = t.get("langs")
    if tl is None:
        return True
    return bool(set(tl) & langs)


def tools_for(pid, lvl=None):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    langs = langs_of(p)
    prim = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    out = [t for t in TOOLS.values()
           if lang_ok(t, langs, prim) and (lvl is None or t["lvl"] == lvl)]
    if FUND_ONLY:
        out = [t for t in out if t.get("fund") or t["lvl"] == 0]
    return sorted(out, key=lambda t: t["id"])


# ============================ CONDITIONS ENGINE ==============================

def cond_path(pid):
    return WORK / str(pid) / "conditions.json"


def load_cond(pid):
    f = cond_path(pid)
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if f.exists() else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _deep(dst, src):
    for k, v in src.items():
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            dst[k] = _deep(dst.get(k, {}) if isinstance(dst.get(k), dict) else {}, v)
        elif isinstance(v, list) and isinstance(dst.get(k), list) and dst.get(k):
            dst[k] = list(dict.fromkeys(list(dst[k]) + list(v)))
        else:
            dst[k] = v
    return dst


def seed_conditions(pid):
    """The program's published terms, as a policy. This is the floor, not a guess."""
    spec = program_spec(pid)
    if not spec:
        return {}
    cond = json.loads(json.dumps(COND_DEFAULT))
    cond["program"] = (getp(pid) or {}).get("prog")
    cond["scope_model"] = spec.get("scope_model", "address")
    cond["poc"] = dict(COND_DEFAULT["poc"], **spec.get("poc", {}))
    cond["exclusions"] = json.loads(json.dumps(spec.get("exclusions", COND_DEFAULT["exclusions"])))
    cond["constraints"] = {k: False for k in CONSTRAINT_KEYS}
    cond["constraints"].update(spec.get("constraints", {}))
    cond["severity"] = [dict(r) for r in spec["tiers"]]
    cond["template"] = list(spec.get("template", []))
    cond["submit"] = dict(COND_DEFAULT["submit"], **spec.get("submit", {}))
    cond["scope_dirs"] = list(spec.get("scope_dirs", []))
    cond["web_critical_only"] = bool(spec.get("web_critical_only"))
    cond["web_cap"] = int(spec.get("web_cap") or 0)
    cond["tvl_cap_pct"] = float(spec.get("tvl_cap_pct") or 0)
    cond["plain_text"] = bool(spec.get("plain_text"))
    cond["notes"] = spec.get("notes", "")
    cond["source_url"] = spec["docs"]
    cond["contract_sha"] = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(spec, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    return cond


def policy(pid):
    pol = json.loads(json.dumps(COND_DEFAULT))
    _deep(pol, seed_conditions(pid))
    _deep(pol, load_cond(pid))
    for k in CONSTRAINT_KEYS:
        pol["constraints"].setdefault(k, False)
    for k in COND_DEFAULT["poc"]:
        pol["poc"].setdefault(k, COND_DEFAULT["poc"][k])
    for k in COND_DEFAULT["exclusions"]:
        pol["exclusions"].setdefault(k, [])
    for k in COND_DEFAULT["submit"]:
        pol["submit"].setdefault(k, "")
    if not pol["severity"]:
        pol["severity"] = [dict(r) for r in DEFAULT_TIERS]
        pol["severity_assumed"] = True
    pol.setdefault("scope_dirs", [])
    pol.setdefault("web_cap", 0)
    pol.setdefault("tvl_cap_pct", 0)
    pol.setdefault("web_critical_only", False)
    pol.setdefault("plain_text", False)
    pol["_tvl_wei"] = (getp(pid) or {}).get("tvl") or 0
    return pol


def _bullets_after(blob, patterns, stop_heads=True):
    out = []
    for pat in patterns:
        m = re.search(pat, blob, re.I)
        if not m:
            continue
        rest = blob[m.end():]
        if stop_heads:
            nxt = re.search(r"\n#{2,4}\s|\n\*\*[A-Z][^*]{2,40}\*\*", rest)
            if nxt:
                rest = rest[:nxt.start()]
        for line in rest.splitlines():
            s = line.strip().lstrip("-*+").strip()
            s = re.sub(r"\*\*|`", "", s)
            if len(s) < 6 or s.lower().startswith(("the following", "not ")):
                continue
            out.append(s[:400])
    seen, ded = set(), []
    for s in out:
        k = s.lower()[:90]
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        ded.append(s)
    return ded[:40]


def p_scope(blob):
    targets, chain, pos = [], "eth", 0
    for m in HEAD_RE.finditer(blob):
        for a in ADDR_RE.findall(blob[pos:m.start()]):
            targets.append({"contract": "", "address": a, "chain": chain, "kind": ""})
        head = m.group(1).lower()
        for w, ch in CHAIN_WORDS.items():
            if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % w, head):
                chain = ch
                break
        pos = m.start()
    for a in ADDR_RE.findall(blob[pos:]):
        targets.append({"contract": "", "address": a, "chain": chain, "kind": ""})
    table = []
    for m in re.finditer(
            r"\|\s*([A-Za-z][^|\n]{1,60}?)\s*\|\s*`?(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40})`?\s*\|\s*([a-zA-Z0-9 \-]+?)\s*\|",
            blob):
        table.append({"contract": m.group(1).strip(), "address": m.group(2),
                      "kind": m.group(3).strip()})
    seen, ded = set(), []
    for t in targets:
        if t["address"] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(t["address"])
        match = next((x for x in table if x["address"].lower() == t["address"].lower()), None)
        t["contract"] = match["contract"] if match else ""
        t["kind"] = match["kind"] if match else ""
        ded.append(t)
    for t in ded:
        if t["chain"] != "eth":
            continue
        i = blob.find(t["address"])
        if i < 0:
            continue
        window = blob[max(0, i - 400):i + 400].lower()
        for w, ch in CHAIN_WORDS.items():
            if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % w, window):
                t["chain"] = ch
                break
    by_addr = bool(table) or bool(re.search(
        r"only the (?:contract )?addresses|scope is defined by deployed address", blob, re.I))
    return {"scope_model": "address" if by_addr and ded else "repo", "targets": ded[:60]}


def p_poc(blob):
    low = blob.lower()
    poc = dict(COND_DEFAULT["poc"])
    if re.search(r"proof of concept|poc\b", low):
        poc["required"] = bool(re.search(
            r"no poc|without a (?:working )?proof|poc (?:is )?(?:mandatory|required)|"
            r"must (?:contain|include|be)[^.\n]{0,60}poc", low))
    if re.search(r"foundry|forge test", low):
        poc["framework"] = "foundry"
    poc["fork"] = bool(re.search(r"fork(?:ed)? (?:mainnet|against)|mainnet fork|mainnet-fork", low))
    poc["block_pin"] = bool(re.search(r"pinned (?:to a )?block|fork-block|specific block", low))
    poc["must_assert"] = bool(re.search(r"before-and-after|before and after|assert(?:ion)?[^.\n]{0,60}(?:loss|balance|invariant)", low))
    poc["no_privileged"] = bool(re.search(
        r"no privileged|unprivileged|no vm\.prank|without (?:admin|owner)", low))
    poc["public_link"] = bool(re.search(r"public (?:github )?(?:repo|repository|gist)|gist", low))
    return poc


def p_template(blob):
    heads, one_page = [], False
    for block in re.findall(r"```([\s\S]{20,800}?)```", blob):
        for line in block.splitlines():
            m = re.match(r"\s*([A-Z][A-Z _/]{2,30}):", line)
            if m and m.group(1).strip() not in heads:
                heads.append(m.group(1).strip())
    if re.search(r"one page|maximum one page|longer than one page", blob, re.I):
        one_page = True
    return {"template": heads[:12], "one_page": one_page, "max_lines": 60 if one_page else 0}


def p_submit(blob):
    out = dict(COND_DEFAULT["submit"])
    mails = [m for m in EMAIL_RE.findall(blob) if re.search(r"security|bounty|dev|sec", m, re.I)]
    if mails:
        out["channel"], out["address"] = "email", mails[0]
    m = re.search(r"\[\s*BOUNTY\s*\][^\n`]{0,90}", blob)
    if m:
        out["subject_fmt"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(0)).strip()
    return out


def p_severity(blob):
    rows = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"\|\s*\*{0,2}(Critical|High|Medium|Low)\*{0,2}\s*\|([^|\n]{3,400})\|"
                         r"([^|\n]{0,120})\|", blob, re.I):
        band = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(3)).strip()
        nums = [int(x.replace(",", "")) for x in re.findall(r"\$\s?([\d,]{3,})", band)]
        rows.append({"tier": m.group(1).lower(),
                     "definition": re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(2)).strip()[:300],
                     "min": min(nums) if nums else 0, "max": max(nums) if nums else 0,
                     "band": band[:120]})
    return rows


def p_constraints(blob):
    low = blob.lower()
    c = {k: False for k in CONSTRAINT_KEYS}
    c["no_admin_key"] = bool(re.search(r"privileged role|admin key|owner role|governance takeover", low))
    c["no_mev"] = bool(re.search(r"front-running|mev", low))
    c["no_griefing"] = bool(re.search(r"griefing", low))
    c["no_theoretical"] = bool(re.search(r"theoretical|speculative", low))
    c["no_third_party"] = bool(re.search(r"third-party (?:protocols|contracts|code)", low))
    c["no_rounding"] = bool(re.search(r"rounding errors?[^.]{0,80}out of scope|rounding errors?\n", low))
    c["no_oracle_manip"] = bool(re.search(r"oracle manipulation", low))
    c["no_gov_takeover"] = bool(re.search(r"governance takeover|voting power rental", low))
    c["no_low_info"] = bool(re.search(r"three level|3 level|no low|lower.severity[^.]{0,40}not eligible", low))
    c["dupe_first_wins"] = bool(re.search(r"first valid report|duplicate", low))
    c["live_only"] = bool(re.search(r"currently supported production|not solely by the continued availability", low))
    return c


def parse_conditions(blob):
    cond = {"source_sha": hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest()}
    cond.update(p_scope(blob))
    cond["poc"] = p_poc(blob)
    cond.update(p_template(blob))
    cond["submit"] = p_submit(blob)
    sev = p_severity(blob)
    if sev:
        cond["severity"] = sev
    cond["constraints"] = p_constraints(blob)
    body = {k: v for k, v in cond.items() if k != "source_sha"}
    cond["contract_sha"] = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    return cond


def _phrase_hit(phrase, hay):
    words = [w for w in re.findall(r"[a-z]{5,}", phrase.lower())]
    if not words:
        return False
    hits = sum(1 for w in words if re.search(r"\b%s" % re.escape(w), hay))
    return hits >= (2 if len(words) >= 3 else 1)


TOOLISH_POC = ("static", "tool", "header", "probe", "body", "bundle", "value")


def judge(f, pol):
    """(eligible, blockers, reward). Every program clause lands here."""
    blockers = []
    hay = ("%s %s %s" % (f["cls"], f["title"], f["impact"])).lower()
    file = (f["file"] or "").lower().replace("\\", "/")
    ex = pol.get("exclusions") or {}
    cons = pol.get("constraints") or {}
    poc = pol.get("poc") or {}
    webish = file.startswith("web/") or file == "headers" or any(k in file for k in WEBISH)

    if pol.get("scope_model") == "address" and not (file.startswith("onchain") or
                                                    file.endswith(".sol")) and webish:
        blockers.append("not-scoped-bytecode")
    if cons.get("live_only") and pol.get("scope_model") == "address" and \
            not file.startswith("onchain") and not webish:
        blockers.append("not-onchain-source")
    if pol.get("scope_dirs") and file.endswith(".sol") and \
            not any(file.startswith(d) for d in pol["scope_dirs"]):
        blockers.append("out-of-scope-dir")
    if pol.get("web_critical_only") and webish and f["sev"] != "critical":
        blockers.append("web-below-critical")
    if any(_phrase_hit(s, hay) for s in ex.get("surfaces", [])):
        blockers.append("excluded-surface")
    if any(_phrase_hit(s, hay) for s in ex.get("non_vulns", [])):
        blockers.append("excluded-topic")
    if any(_phrase_hit(s, hay) for s in ex.get("non_submissions", [])):
        blockers.append("not-submittable")
    if cons.get("no_admin_key") and re.search(r"owner|admin|multisig|centraliz|timelock|role", hay):
        blockers.append("assumes-privileged")
    if cons.get("no_theoretical"):
        blockers.append("needs-poc")
    if cons.get("no_rounding") and (f["cls"] == "math" or "round" in hay):
        blockers.append("rounding")
    if cons.get("no_oracle_manip") and f["cls"] == "oracle":
        blockers.append("oracle-manip")
    if cons.get("no_gov_takeover") and re.search(r"governance|voting power|quorum|proposal", hay):
        blockers.append("gov-takeover")
    if cons.get("no_third_party") and re.search(r"chainlink|ccip|third-party|external protocol", hay):
        blockers.append("third-party")
    if poc.get("required") and f["poc"] in TOOLISH_POC:
        blockers.append("no-exploit")

    reward, rmin = 0, 0
    for row in pol.get("severity", []):
        if row["tier"] == f["sev"]:
            reward, rmin = row["max"] or row["min"], row["min"]
            break
    if not reward and pol.get("severity"):
        blockers.append("sev-not-listed")
    if not pol.get("severity"):
        blockers.append("no-tier-table")
    if pol.get("web_cap") and webish:
        reward = min(reward, pol["web_cap"])
    if pol.get("tvl_cap_pct") and reward:
        tvl_usd = (pol.get("_tvl_wei") or 0) / 1e18 * ETH_USD
        if tvl_usd > 0:
            reward = max(rmin, min(reward, int(tvl_usd * pol["tvl_cap_pct"])))
    if cons.get("no_theoretical") and not reward:
        blockers.append("no-usd-impact")

    hard = {"excluded-surface", "excluded-topic", "not-submittable", "assumes-privileged",
            "sev-not-listed", "no-tier-table", "out-of-scope-dir", "web-below-critical",
            "not-onchain-source", "third-party"}
    eligible = 0 if (hard & set(blockers)) else 1
    return eligible, sorted(set(blockers)), reward


def readiness(pid):
    pol = policy(pid)
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=?", (pid,))]
    eligible = [r for r in rows if r["eligible"] and r["judged"]]
    ready = [r for r in eligible if not json.loads(r["blockers"] or "[]")]
    score = int(100 * len(ready) / len(eligible)) if eligible else 0
    req = []
    if pol["poc"]["required"]:
        req.append({"key": "poc", "label": "working PoC required (foundry fork)",
                    "met": any(r["poc_path"] for r in ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["must_assert"]:
        req.append({"key": "assert", "label": "before/after balances asserted",
                    "met": any("assert" in (r["evidence"] or "").lower() for r in ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["no_privileged"]:
        req.append({"key": "unprivileged", "label": "unprivileged path", "met": bool(ready)})
    if pol["poc"]["block_pin"]:
        req.append({"key": "block", "label": "fork pinned to a block", "met": False})
    if pol.get("plain_text"):
        req.append({"key": "plain", "label": "plain-text body, no attachments",
                    "met": (WORK / str(pid) / "body.txt").exists()})
    if pol.get("scope_dirs"):
        req.append({"key": "dirs", "label": "scope dirs: %s" % ", ".join(pol["scope_dirs"]),
                    "met": True})
    if pol["template"]:
        req.append({"key": "template", "label": "template: %s" % " / ".join(pol["template"][:4]),
                    "met": bool(ready)})
    if pol["submit"]["address"]:
        req.append({"key": "channel", "label": "submit to %s" % pol["submit"]["address"],
                    "met": True})
    return {"score": score, "ready": len(ready), "eligible": len(eligible),
            "total": len(rows), "requirements": req, "policy": pol,
            "unjudged": sum(1 for r in rows if not r["judged"])}


def poc_http(pid, finding, pol):
    tgt = web_target(pid) or (getp(pid) or {}).get("url") or "https://target"
    d = WORK / str(pid) / "poc"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("repro_%s.md" % finding["id"])
    lines = ["# %s" % finding["title"], "", "- severity: %s" % finding["sev"],
             "- class: %s" % finding["cls"], "- where: %s" % finding["file"], "",
             "## reproduce", "", "Target: `%s`" % tgt, "", "```bash"]
    where = (finding["file"] or "").lower()
    if where == "headers":
        lines.append("curl -sSI %s" % tgt)
    elif finding["cls"] == "value":
        lines.append("# capture the request, change the amount, replay it")
        lines.append("curl -sS -X POST '%s' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n"
                     "  -d '{\"amount\":1,\"price\":0.01}'" % tgt)
    elif where.startswith("path_") or finding["cls"] == "web":
        path = finding["file"] if finding["file"].startswith("/") else "/"
        lines.append("curl -sS -i '%s%s'" % (tgt.rstrip("/"), path))
    else:
        lines.append("curl -sS -i %s" % tgt)
    lines += ["```", "", "## expected", "", finding["impact"] or "-", "",
              "## observed", "", "```", (finding["evidence"] or "")[:1200], "```", "",
              "## fund impact", "", "State what a user or the protocol loses, and whether it repeats.", ""]
    f.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(f), finding["id"]))
    return str(f)


def poc_stub(pid, finding, pol):
    if any(k in (finding["file"] or "") for k in WEBISH) or web_only(pid):
        return poc_http(pid, finding, pol)
    tgt = (pol["targets"] or [{}])[0]
    addr = tgt.get("address") or "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
    block = fork_block(tgt.get("chain") or "eth") or 0
    body = [
        "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT", "pragma solidity ^0.8.20;", "",
        'import "forge-std/Test.sol";', "",
        "// generated skeleton - fill the attack, keep the assertions",
        "// %s" % finding["title"][:110], "contract BHExploit is Test {",
        "    address constant TARGET = %s;" % addr,
        "    address attacker = address(0xBEEF);",
        "    address victim = address(0xCAFE);", "", "    function setUp() public {",
        '        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envString("RPC_URL"), %s);' % block,
        "        vm.deal(attacker, 100 ether);", "        vm.deal(victim, 100 ether);",
        "    }", "", "    function test_exploit() public {",
        "        uint256 before = address(attacker).balance;",
        "        vm.startPrank(attacker);", "        // 1. seed or borrow",
        "        // 2. skew the price or the accounting",
        "        // 3. exit at the skewed state", "        vm.stopPrank();",
        "        uint256 profit = address(attacker).balance - before;",
        "        assertGt(profit, 0, \"no value captured\");",
        "        emit log_named_uint(\"profit wei\", profit);", "    }", "}",
    ]
    d = WORK / str(pid) / "poc"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("exploit_%s.t.sol" % finding["id"])
    f.write_text("\n".join(body) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(f), finding["id"]))
    return str(f)


# ================================= STAGES ====================================

BRIEF_TMPL = TMPL_STD
OUT_TERMS = ["frontend", "web interface", "dashboard", "website", "api", "rpc", "subgraph",
             "indexer", "testnet", "staging", "admin key", "owner role", "multisig",
             "centraliz", "gas optimization", "natspec", "theoretical", "known issue",
             "phishing", "mev", "front-run", "griefing", "rounding", "dust", "third-party"]


def brief_path(pid):
    return WORK / str(pid) / "brief.json"


def load_brief(pid):
    f = brief_path(pid)
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if f.exists() else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def web_disabled(pid):
    if web_only(pid):
        return False
    pol = load_cond(pid)
    if not pol:
        return False
    if pol.get("scope_model") in ("address", "dirs"):
        return True
    surf = " ".join(pol.get("exclusions", {}).get("surfaces", [])).lower()
    return any(t in surf for t in ("frontend", "web interface", "website", "api"))


def st_intake(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    url = p.get("url") or ""
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log(pid, "intake: %s" % url)

    res = platforms.resolve(pid, url, reader=READER, fetch=_detail_fetch,
                            log=lambda m: log(pid, m))
    (root / "details.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"adapter": res.adapter, "tier": res.tier, "problems": res.problems,
         "fields": {"assets": len(res.rec["assets"]), "tiers": len(res.rec["rewards"]),
                    "poc": res.rec["poc_any"],
                    "submit": bool(res.rec["submit"]["address"])}}, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8")

    if not res.markdown.strip():
        setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake", details_ok=0)
        log(pid, "intake: NOTHING FETCHED (adapter %s) - parked" % res.adapter)
        (root / "details_reason.txt").write_text(
            "nothing fetched via %s\npaste the program text in the overview panel\n"
            % "/".join(platforms.TIERS), encoding="utf-8")
        return False

    body = res.markdown
    (root / "scope.txt").write_text(body[:600000], encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "headers.txt").write_text("via: %s" % res.tier, encoding="utf-8")
    if res.tier in ("html", "reader", "manual", "api-text"):
        (root / "web_surface").write_text(str(time.time()), encoding="utf-8")
    apps = app_urls(pid)
    if apps:
        (root / "web_target.txt").write_text(apps[0], encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "intake: %d bytes via %s/%s, %d asset(s), %d tier(s)"
        % (len(body), res.adapter, res.tier, len(res.rec["assets"]), len(res.rec["rewards"])))
    if res.thin:
        log(pid, "intake: THIN record (%s) - parking so you can paste" % ", ".join(res.problems))
        (root / "details_reason.txt").write_text(
            "record too thin: %s\npaste the program text to unblock\n"
            % ", ".join(res.problems), encoding="utf-8")
        setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake", details_ok=0,
             type_conf="none", notes="thin: " + ",".join(res.problems)[:180])
        return False
    setp(pid, details_ok=1)
    return True


def st_conditions(pid, ctx):
    """Seed the published terms, then let the fetched page refine them."""
    seed = seed_conditions(pid)
    if not seed:
        log(pid, "conditions: no program on this target")
        setp(pid, cond_ok=0)
        return False
    sf = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    parsed = {}
    if sf.exists():
        parsed = parse_conditions(sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:600000])
    cond = json.loads(json.dumps(seed))
    if parsed.get("targets"):
        cond["targets"] = parsed["targets"]
    if parsed.get("poc", {}).get("required"):
        cond["poc"]["required"] = True
    if parsed.get("poc", {}).get("framework"):
        cond["poc"]["framework"] = parsed["poc"]["framework"]
    if parsed.get("template"):
        cond["template"] = parsed["template"]
    if parsed.get("submit", {}).get("address"):
        cond["submit"]["address"] = parsed["submit"]["address"]
    for k, v in (parsed.get("constraints") or {}).items():
        if v:
            cond["constraints"][k] = True
    if cond["targets"]:
        cond["scope_model"] = "address"
    cond_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps(cond, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    ok = bool(cond["targets"] or cond["severity"] or cond.get("scope_dirs"))
    setp(pid, cond_ok=1 if ok else 0, targets_n=len(cond["targets"]),
         details_ok=1 if ok else ((getp(pid) or {}).get("details_ok") or 0))
    log(pid, "conditions: program=%s %d target(s), %d tier(s), model=%s, web=%s, cap=%s"
        % (cond["program"], len(cond["targets"]), len(cond["severity"]),
           cond["scope_model"], "critical-only" if cond["web_critical_only"] else "full",
           cond["web_cap"] or "-"))
    for k, v in cond["constraints"].items():
        if v:
            log(pid, "conditions: constraint %s" % k)
    if not cond["targets"] and cond["scope_model"] == "address":
        log(pid, "conditions: no address parsed - paste the README addresses to unblock")
    return ok


def st_brief(pid, ctx):
    sf = WORK / str(pid) / "scope.txt"
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if sf.exists() else ""
    low = blob.lower()
    addrs = sorted(set(ADDR_RE.findall(blob)))
    cond = load_cond(pid)
    spec = program_spec(pid) or {}
    brief = {"source_url": (getp(pid) or {}).get("url"), "fetched_at": time.time(),
             "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest(),
             "in_scope": addrs, "out_of_scope": [t for t in OUT_TERMS if t in low],
             "template": cond.get("template", BRIEF_TMPL),
             "submit_to": cond.get("submit", {}).get("address", spec.get("contact", "")),
             "targets": cond.get("targets", []),
             "scope_by_address": cond.get("scope_model") == "address",
             "scope_dirs": cond.get("scope_dirs", []),
             "groups": spec.get("groups", []), "web_target": web_target(pid)}
    brief_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps(brief, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    ok = bool(addrs or cond.get("scope_dirs") or cond.get("severity"))
    setp(pid, brief_ok=1 if ok else 0, details_ok=1 if ok else 0)
    log(pid, "brief: %d in-scope, %d dir(s), %d group(s), submit=%s"
        % (len(addrs), len(brief["scope_dirs"]), len(brief["groups"]),
           brief["submit_to"] or "?"))
    return ok


def st_gate(pid, ctx):
    if not GATE:
        return 0
    pol = policy(pid)
    score_findings(pid)
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? ORDER BY fund DESC, score DESC", (pid,))]
        judged = []
        for r in rows:
            try:
                ok, blockers, reward = judge(r, pol)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "gate: judge failed on %s (%s)" % (r["id"], ex))
                ok, blockers, reward = 1, ["judge-error"], 0
            judged.append((ok, blockers))
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET eligible=?, blockers=?, reward=?, judged=1, stale=0 "
                      "WHERE id=?", (ok, json.dumps(blockers), reward, r["id"]))
    kept = sum(1 for ok, _ in judged if ok)
    ready = sum(1 for ok, b in judged if ok and not b)
    setp(pid, readiness=int(100 * ready / kept) if kept else 0)
    log(pid, "gate: %d of %d eligible, %d submission-ready" % (kept, len(rows), ready))
    if not kept and rows:
        top = sorted({r["cls"] for r in rows[:10]})
        log(pid, "gate: nothing eligible, dominant classes %s" % ",".join(top))
    return kept


def st_scopeaddr(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    sf = root / "scope.txt"
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if sf.exists() else ""
    cond = load_cond(pid)
    pairs = [(t["address"], t.get("chain") or "eth") for t in cond.get("targets", [])]
    if not pairs:
        pairs = [(a, "eth") for a in sorted(set(ADDR_RE.findall(blob)))]
    chains = sorted({c for _, c in pairs}) or chains_for(blob)
    if pairs:
        (root / "addresses.txt").write_text("\n".join(a for a, _ in pairs), encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "addr_chain.txt").write_text(
            "\n".join("%s %s" % (a, c) for a, c in pairs), encoding="utf-8")
        setp(pid, address_mode=1, notes=",".join(chains), details_ok=1, targets_n=len(pairs))
        log(pid, "scope: %d address(es) across %s" % (len(pairs), ",".join(chains)))
        spec = program_spec(pid) or {}
        if spec.get("constraints", {}).get("impl_required"):
            found = 0
            for a, ch in pairs[:20]:
                impl = impl_of(ch, a)
                if impl:
                    with (root / "impl.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        f.write("%s %s %s\n" % (a, impl, ch))
                    found += 1
                    log(pid, "scope: impl %s -> %s" % (a[:10], impl[:10]))
            log(pid, "scope: %d implementation(s) resolved of %d" % (found, len(pairs)))
    (root / "scoped").write_text(str(time.time()), encoding="utf-8")
    ctx["chains"] = chains
    return len(pairs)


def st_onchain(pid, ctx):
    af = WORK / str(pid) / "addr_chain.txt"
    if not af.exists() or not ETHERSCAN_KEY:
        return 0
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "onchain"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pairs = [ln.split() for ln in af.read_text().splitlines() if len(ln.split()) == 2]
    impls = {}
    imf = WORK / str(pid) / "impl.txt"
    if imf.exists():
        for line in imf.read_text().splitlines():
            p = line.split()
            if len(p) == 3:
                impls.setdefault(p[0], []).append((p[1], p[2]))
    got = 0
    for addr, ch in pairs[:12]:
        if ch not in CHAINS or CHAINS[ch].get("evm") is False:
            continue
        targets = [(addr, "proxy")] + [(i, "impl") for i, _ in impls.get(addr, [])]
        for a, kind in targets:
            src = es_source(ch, a)
            if not src or not src["src"].strip():
                continue
            d = root / ("%s_%s" % (ch, addr[:10]))
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (d / ("%s_%s.sol" % (src["name"], kind))).write_text(src["src"], encoding="utf-8")
            got += 1
            log(pid, "onchain: %s %s %s (%d bytes)" % (ch, kind, a[:10], len(src["src"])))
        time.sleep(0.3)
    if got:
        log(pid, "onchain: %d contract(s) pulled" % got)
        setp(pid, details_ok=1)
    return got


def st_onchain_stage(pid, ctx):
    src = WORK / str(pid) / "onchain"
    if not src.exists():
        return 0
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    dst = root / "src"
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    for f in src.rglob("*.sol"):
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not re.search(r"\b(?:contract|library)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*", t):
            continue
        (dst / ("%s__%s" % (f.parent.name, f.name))).write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
        n += 1
    if not n:
        log(pid, "stage: onchain tree empty")
        return 0
    repair_forge_toml(pid, root)
    repair_source(pid, root)
    ctx["root"] = root
    sol = sol_files(root)
    if sol:
        ctx["primary"] = str(sol[0])
    log(pid, "stage: %d onchain source(s) into src/" % n)
    return n


def st_value(pid, ctx):
    af = WORK / str(pid) / "addr_chain.txt"
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    rows, total = [], 0
    if af.exists() and VALUE_CENSUS:
        for line in af.read_text().splitlines()[:20]:
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) != 2:
                continue
            addr, ch = parts
            if CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("evm") is False:
                continue
            wei = assets = supply = 0
            try:
                b = rpc(ch, "eth_getBalance", [addr, "latest"])
                if b:
                    wei = int(b, 16)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                v = eth_call(ch, addr, SEL_TOTAL_ASSETS)
                if v and v not in ("0x", "0x0"):
                    assets = int(v, 16)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                v = eth_call(ch, addr, SEL_TOTAL_SUPPLY)
                if v and v not in ("0x", "0x0"):
                    supply = int(v, 16)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not (wei or assets or supply):
                continue
            rows.append((addr, ch, wei, assets, supply))
            total += wei + assets
    setp(pid, tvl=total)
    lines = ["# value census", ""]
    for addr, ch, wei, assets, supply in rows:
        lines.append("%s %s native=%d totalAssets=%d totalSupply=%d"
                     % (ch, addr, wei, assets, supply))
    if rows:
        (root / "value.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        log(pid, "value: %d contract(s) hold funds, %.4f ETH-equivalent"
            % (len(rows), total / 1e18))
    else:
        log(pid, "value: no on-chain funds readable")
    return len(rows)


def repo_rank(full):
    r = full.split("/")[-1]
    return (5 if CODE_RE.search(r) else 0) - (10 if DOCS_RE.search(r) else 0)


def st_surface(pid, ctx):
    spec = program_spec(pid) or {}
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    repo = spec.get("repo")
    if repo:
        ok, lang = gh_meta(repo)
        if ok:
            (root / "repos.txt").write_text(repo, encoding="utf-8")
            langs_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps({repo: lang or ""}), encoding="utf-8")
            log(pid, "surface: program repo %s" % repo)
            return [repo]
        log(pid, "surface: program repo %s unreachable" % repo)
    if web_only(pid):
        (root / "repos.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        langs_path(pid).write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        log(pid, "surface: web-only, no repo hunt")
        return []
    sf = root / "scope.txt"
    blob = sf.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if sf.exists() else ""
    repos = []
    for r in repos_in(blob, limit=6):
        if REPO_RE.match(r) and gh_meta(r)[0]:
            repos.append(r)
        if len(repos) >= 2:
            break
    (root / "repos.txt").write_text("\n".join(repos), encoding="utf-8")
    langs_path(pid).write_text(json.dumps({r: "" for r in repos}), encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "surface: %d repo(s) from page" % len(repos))
    return repos


def st_clone(pid, ctx):
    base = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    rmtree_force(base)
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rf = WORK / str(pid) / "repos.txt"
    repos = rf.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split() if rf.exists() else []
    ok = 0
    for r in repos:
        dest = base / re.sub(r"[^\w.-]+", "_", r.replace("/", "__"))
        url = ("https://%s@github.com/%s.git" % (GH_TOKEN, r)) if GH_TOKEN \
            else "https://github.com/%s.git" % r
        rc, out, err = sh(["git", "-c", "credential.helper=", "clone", "--depth", "1",
                           "--single-branch", url, str(dest)], timeout=600,
                          env={"GCM_INTERACTIVE": "never", "GIT_ASKPASS": "echo"})
        if rc == 0:
            ok += 1
            log(pid, "clone: ok %s" % r)
        else:
            tail = (err or out).strip().splitlines()
            log(pid, "clone: fail %s (%s)" % (r, tail[-1] if tail else "?"))
    dirs = [d for d in base.iterdir() if d.is_dir()]
    if dirs:
        ctx["root"] = dirs[0]
        log(pid, "clone: primary root -> %s" % dirs[0].name)
    return ok


def st_toolchain(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    cur = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    if cur not in TYPES:
        cur = "unknown"
    root = ctx["root"]
    ev = {}
    if p.get("type_locked") and cur not in ("unknown", ""):
        best, conf = cur, "manual"
        ev["reason"] = "manual lock"
    elif web_only(pid):
        best, conf = "web", "surface"
        ev["reason"] = "web-only program"
    else:
        best, conf = "unknown", "none"
        m, hits = manifest_type(root)
        if m:
            best, conf = m, "manifest"
            ev["manifest"] = sorted({h[1] for h in hits})[:6]
        else:
            counts, primary, _ = census(root, WORK / str(pid) / "onchain")
            ev["counts"] = {k: v for k, v in counts.items() if v}
            top = max(counts, key=lambda k: counts[k]) if ev["counts"] else None
            if top and (counts[top] >= 2 or primary.get(top)):
                best, conf = top, "census"
            elif addr_exists(pid):
                best, conf = "solidity", "address"
                ev["reason"] = "in-scope addresses define scope"
    setp(pid, toolchain=best, type_conf=conf, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:900])
    sol = sol_files(root)
    if sol and not ctx.get("primary"):
        ctx["primary"] = str(sol[0])
    elif not sol:
        ctx["primary"] = str(root)
    log(pid, "type: %s (%s)" % (best, CONF_LABEL.get(conf, conf)))
    if best == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    return ev.get("counts", {}).get(best, 0)


def _write_echidna_cfg(root):
    f = Path(root) / "echidna.yaml"
    if f.exists():
        return
    f.write_text("testMode: assertion\nseqLen: 100\ntestLimit: 50000\n"
                 "shrinkLimit: 5000\ncorpusDir: echidna-corpus\n", encoding="utf-8")


def st_deps(pid, ctx):
    root = ctx["root"]
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}):
        return True
    _write_echidna_cfg(root)
    if not (root / "foundry.toml").exists():
        repair_forge_toml(pid, root)
    if (root / "lib").exists() or (root / "node_modules").exists():
        repair_remappings(pid, root)
    sh(["forge", "install", "--no-git"], cwd=root, timeout=900)
    return True


def st_build(pid, ctx):
    root = ctx["root"]
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}) or not have("forge"):
        return True
    if not any((root / n).exists() for n in ("foundry.toml", "hardhat.config.ts",
                                             "hardhat.config.js")):
        log(pid, "build: no config at root, skipped")
        return True
    rc, out, err = sh(["forge", "build"], cwd=root, timeout=1800)
    if rc != 0:
        log(pid, "build failed: %s" % classify(err + out))
        repair_source(pid, root)
        repair_remappings(pid, root)
        rc, out, err = sh(["forge", "build"], cwd=root, timeout=1800)
    log(pid, "build: %s" % ("ok" if rc == 0 else "failing, static continues"))
    return rc == 0


def _run_lvl(pid, ctx, lvl, label, token=None):
    n = 0
    wd = web_disabled(pid)
    tools = tools_for(pid, lvl)
    if not tools:
        log(pid, "%s: no applicable method for this type" % label)
        return 0
    for t in tools:
        if token is not None and token.is_set():
            break
        if wd and t.get("web"):
            continue
        try:
            n += t["run"](ctx) or 0
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "%s crashed: %s" % (t["id"], str(ex)[:160]))
            run_repair(pid, classify(str(ex)), str(ex), ctx["root"])
    log(pid, "%s: %d hit(s) via %d method(s)" % (label, n, len(tools)))
    return n


def st_static(pid, ctx):
    return _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 1, "static")


def st_baseline(pid, ctx):
    bl = ctx["root"] / "audits"
    if bl.exists():
        log(pid, "baseline: %d audit file(s)" % len(list(bl.rglob("*"))))
    return True


def _primary_contract(root):
    best = (0, None, None)
    for f in sol_files(root):
        try:
            t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        for m in re.finditer(r"\bcontract\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)", t):
            span = brace_span(t, t.find("{", m.end()))
            if len(span) > best[0]:
                best = (len(span), m.group(1), f)
    return best[1], best[2]


def st_harness(pid, ctx):
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}) or not have("forge"):
        return True
    root = ctx["root"]
    name, prim = _primary_contract(root)
    if not name or not prim:
        log(pid, "harness: no contract body found")
        return False
    sh(["forge", "build"], cwd=root, timeout=1800)
    tdir = root / "test"
    tdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tgt = (policy(pid)["targets"] or [{}])[0]
    (tdir / "BHAttacker.t.sol").write_text(
        '// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n'
        'import "forge-std/Test.sol";\nimport "../%s";\n\n'
        'contract BHAttacker is Test {\n  %s t;\n'
        '  address constant TARGET = %s;\n'
        '  function setUp() public {\n    t = new %s();\n  }\n'
        '  function test_probe() public { assertTrue(address(t) != address(0)); }\n}\n'
        % (rel(root, prim), name, tgt.get("address") or "address(0)", name), encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "harness: BHAttacker for %s" % name)
    return True


def st_symbolic(pid, ctx):
    return _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 2, "symbolic")


def st_fork(pid, ctx):
    if "solidity" not in langs_of(getp(pid) or {}) or not have("forge"):
        return True
    root = ctx["root"]
    pol = policy(pid)
    if not ctx.get("chains"):
        ctx["chains"] = sorted({t.get("chain") or "eth" for t in pol["targets"]}) or ["eth"]
    if not (root / "test" / "BHAttacker.t.sol").exists():
        log(pid, "fork: no harness, skipped")
        return True
    done = 0
    for ch in ctx["chains"]:
        if CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("evm") is False:
            continue
        rpc_url = CHAINS.get(ch, {}).get("rpc")
        blk = safe_fork_block(ch)
        if not rpc_url or not blk:
            continue
        rc, out, err = sh(["forge", "test", "--fork-url", rpc_url, "--match-contract",
                           "BHAttacker", "-vv", "--fork-block-number", str(blk)],
                          cwd=root, timeout=1800)
        if rc == 0:
            done += 1
            log(pid, "fork: ok on %s at %d" % (ch, blk))
        else:
            log(pid, "fork: failed on %s (%s)" % (ch, classify(err + out)))
    return done


def st_adversarial(pid, ctx):
    ctx["depth"] = 1 + int((getp(pid) or {}).get("cycle") or 0)
    return _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 4, "adversarial")


def st_hammer(pid, ctx):
    depth = min(HAMMER_DEPTH, 1 + int((getp(pid) or {}).get("cycle") or 0))
    ctx["depth"] = depth
    n = _run_lvl(pid, ctx, 5, "hammer")
    log(pid, "hammer: depth %d" % depth)
    return n


def st_triage(pid, ctx):
    pol = policy(pid)
    rows = score_findings(pid)
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-(r.get("fund") or 0), -r["score"]))
    ready = 0
    fund = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("fund"))
    setp(pid, fund_hits=fund)
    seen, shown = set(), 0
    for r in rows:
        if shown >= 14:
            break
        key = (r["title"], r["file"])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        shown += 1
        ok, blockers, reward = judge(r, pol)
        tag = "FUND " if r.get("fund") else ""
        if ok and not blockers:
            ready += 1
            log(pid, "triage: READY %s%s %s reward<=$%s" % (tag, r["sev"], r["title"], reward))
        elif blockers:
            log(pid, "triage: %s%s blocked by %s" % (tag, r["title"][:60], ",".join(blockers)))
    if fund:
        log(pid, "triage: %d of %d findings are money classes" % (fund, len(rows)))
    return ready


def st_report(pid, ctx):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    pol = policy(pid)
    spec = program_spec(pid) or {}
    with db() as c:
        unj = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND judged=0", (pid,)).fetchone()[0]
    if unj:
        log(pid, "report: %d finding(s) never judged - judging now" % unj)
        st_gate(pid, ctx)
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1 ORDER BY score DESC",
            (pid,))]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-(r.get("fund") or 0), -SEV_BASE.get(r["sev"], 0)))
    tmpl = pol["template"] or BRIEF_TMPL
    tgt = (pol["targets"] or [{}])[0]
    src = ("onchain bytecode" if (WORK / str(pid) / "onchain").exists()
           else "repository source" if (WORK / str(pid) / "repos.txt").exists()
           else "app surface" if web_target(pid) else "page only")
    out = ["# %s - submission pack" % (p.get("name") or spec.get("name")), "",
           "<!-- generated %s · program %s · cycle %s -->"
           % (time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), pol.get("program"), p.get("cycle")), "",
           "- grounded on: %s" % src,
           "- target: %s @ %s (%s)" % (tgt.get("contract") or "-", tgt.get("address") or "-",
                                       tgt.get("chain") or "-"),
           "- scope model: %s · targets: %d · dirs: %s"
           % (pol["scope_model"], len(pol["targets"]), ", ".join(pol["scope_dirs"]) or "-"),
           "- url: %s" % p.get("url"),
           "- submit: %s via %s" % (pol["submit"]["address"] or "?",
                                    pol["submit"]["channel"] or "?"),
           "- subject: %s" % (pol["submit"]["subject_fmt"] or "<contract> - <impact>"),
           "- template: %s" % " / ".join(tmpl)]
    if pol.get("plain_text"):
        out.append("- body: plain text, no attachments")
    if pol.get("web_cap"):
        out.append("- web findings: Critical only, capped at $%s" % pol["web_cap"])
    if pol.get("tvl_cap_pct"):
        out.append("- payout capped at %d%% of TVL at risk" % int(pol["tvl_cap_pct"] * 100))
    hard = [k for k, v in pol["constraints"].items() if v]
    if hard:
        out.append("- constraints: %s" % ", ".join(hard))
    out.append("")
    fund = [r for r in rows if r.get("fund")]
    out += ["## findings", "",
            "%d money-class of %d. Ranked by value at risk." % (len(fund), len(rows)), ""]
    if not rows:
        out += ["Nothing passed the gate.", ""]
    for i, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
        blockers = json.loads(r["blockers"] or "[]")
        ok, _, reward = judge(r, pol)
        vals = {"TARGET": "%s block %s" % (r["file"], r.get("line") or 1),
                "TITLE": r["title"], "SUMMARY": r["impact"], "INVARIANT": r["title"],
                "CHAIN": tgt.get("chain") or "-", "ADDRESS": tgt.get("address") or "-",
                "IMPLEMENTATION": "-", "PATH": "%s:%s" % (r["file"], r.get("line") or 1),
                "PRECONDITIONS": "see evidence", "STEPS": "see evidence",
                "ATTACK": (r["evidence"] or "")[:600], "POC": r["poc_path"] or r["poc"],
                "BEFORE_AFTER": "assert balances before and after",
                "IMPACT": r["impact"], "CAPITAL": "state required capital",
                "REMEDIATION": "see evidence", "FIX": "see evidence"}
        out += ["### %d. [%s] %s%s" % (i, r["sev"].upper(),
                                       "FUND " if r.get("fund") else "", r["title"]), "",
                "- class: %s" % r["cls"], "- where: %s" % r["file"],
                "- band: %s" % ("$%s" % reward if reward else "unlisted"),
                "- status: %s" % ("READY" if ok and not blockers
                                  else ("blocked: " + ", ".join(blockers) if blockers else "ineligible")),
                ""]
        for h in tmpl:
            out.append("%s: %s" % (h, vals.get(h, "")))
        out += ["", "```", (r["evidence"] or "")[:1200], "```", ""]
    txt = "\n".join(out)
    (WORK / str(pid) / "report.md").write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
    if pol.get("plain_text"):
        body = re.sub(r"^#{1,6}\s*", "", txt, flags=re.M)
        body = body.replace("```", "").replace("|", " ")
        body = re.sub(r"-{3,}", "-", body)
        (WORK / str(pid) / "body.txt").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
        log(pid, "report: plain-text body written, no attachments")
    log(pid, "report: %d finding(s) (%d fund)" % (len(rows), len(fund)))
    return len(rows)


def st_poc(pid, ctx):
    pol = policy(pid)
    with db() as c:
        rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1 AND poc_path='' "
            "AND sev IN ('critical','high','medium') ORDER BY fund DESC, score DESC LIMIT 12",
            (pid,))]
    n = 0
    for r in rows:
        if poc_stub(pid, r, pol):
            n += 1
    log(pid, "poc: %d artefact(s) written" % n)
    return n


PREP_STEPS = ["intake", "conditions", "brief", "scope", "onchain", "onchain_stage",
              "value", "surface"]
ACQUIRE_STEPS = ["clone", "toolchain", "deps", "build"]
LEVEL_STEPS = {0: PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS, 1: ["static", "gate", "baseline"],
               2: ["harness", "symbolic"], 3: ["fork"], 4: ["adversarial"],
               5: ["hammer", "triage", "gate", "poc"]}
LEVEL_NAME = {0: "recon", 1: "static", 2: "symbolic", 3: "dynamic", 4: "adversarial", 5: "hammer"}

STEP_FN = {"intake": st_intake, "conditions": st_conditions, "brief": st_brief,
           "gate": st_gate, "scope": st_scopeaddr, "onchain": st_onchain,
           "onchain_stage": st_onchain_stage, "value": st_value, "surface": st_surface,
           "clone": st_clone, "toolchain": st_toolchain, "deps": st_deps, "build": st_build,
           "static": st_static, "baseline": st_baseline, "harness": st_harness,
           "symbolic": st_symbolic, "fork": st_fork, "adversarial": st_adversarial,
           "hammer": st_hammer, "triage": st_triage, "report": st_report, "poc": st_poc}


def run_step(pid, name, ctx):
    fn = STEP_FN[name]
    setp(pid, stage=name)
    try:
        return fn(pid, ctx)
    except Exception as ex:
        kind = classify(str(ex))
        log(pid, "%s failed [%s]: %s" % (name, kind, str(ex)[:300]))
        setp(pid, repairs=int((getp(pid) or {}).get("repairs") or 0) + 1)
        for _ in range(MAX_REPAIRS):
            if not run_repair(pid, kind, str(ex), ctx.get("root")):
                break
            try:
                return fn(pid, ctx)
            except Exception as ex2:
                log(pid, "%s retry failed: %s" % (name, str(ex2)[:200]))
                kind = classify(str(ex2))
        return None


def has_surface(pid):
    root = WORK / str(pid)
    for f in ("repos.txt", "addresses.txt", "web_target.txt"):
        p = root / f
        if p.exists() and p.read_text().strip():
            return True
    return (root / "web_surface").exists()


def _run_once(pid, token, start_level=0):
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root, "depth": 1}
    if start_level == 0:
        for name in PREP_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            if name == "intake":
                if not run_step(pid, name, ctx):
                    setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake")
                    log(pid, "details thin or absent - parked, nothing downloaded")
                    return "needs-details"
            else:
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        if not details_ok(pid):
            setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="prep")
            return "needs-details"
        for name in ACQUIRE_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
    tc = (getp(pid) or {}).get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    pol = policy(pid)
    if tc == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    if not has_surface(pid):
        raise RuntimeError("no_files: no repo, no address, no app target")
    for lvl in range(max(start_level, 1), 6):
        if token.is_set():
            return
        if not tools_for(pid, lvl):
            setp(pid, escalation=lvl + 1)
            continue
        log(pid, "--- L%d %s ---" % (lvl, LEVEL_NAME[lvl]))
        for name in LEVEL_STEPS[lvl]:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        score_findings(pid)
        found, rank = best_score(pid), best_rank(pid)
        if found and rank >= THRESHOLD and lvl >= 3:
            log(pid, "L%d landed %s (rank %d)" % (lvl, found.upper(), rank))
            setp(pid, escalation=lvl)
            return found
        if lvl >= 5:
            if found:
                log(pid, "L%d best %s rank %d" % (lvl, found.upper(), rank))
            setp(pid, escalation=lvl)
            return found
        setp(pid, escalation=lvl + 1)
    return best_score(pid)


def attack_until_finding(pid, token):
    setp(pid, status="running", cycle=0, attempts=0)
    for cycle in range(1, MAX_CYCLES + 1):
        if token.is_set():
            setp(pid, status="stopped")
            return "stopped"
        setp(pid, cycle=cycle)
        log(pid, "===== cycle %d/%d =====" % (cycle, MAX_CYCLES))
        ok = False
        for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
            if token.is_set():
                break
            setp(pid, attempts=attempt)
            try:
                r = _run_once(pid, token, start_level=0 if attempt == 1 else 1)
                ok = r != "needs-details"
                break
            except Exception as ex:
                kind = classify(str(ex))
                log(pid, "cycle %d attempt %d failed [%s]: %s"
                    % (cycle, attempt, kind, str(ex)[:250]))
                run_repair(pid, kind, str(ex), WORK / str(pid) / "repo")
                time.sleep(3 * attempt)
        if ok:
            run_step(pid, "report", {"pid": pid, "root": WORK / str(pid) / "repo"})
            if best_rank(pid) >= THRESHOLD:
                setp(pid, status="done", stage="report")
                return best_score(pid)
        if cycle < MAX_CYCLES:
            for _ in range(int(CYCLE_SLEEP * cycle)):
                if token.is_set():
                    break
                time.sleep(1)
    setp(pid, status="barren", stage="report")
    return "barren"


def attack_plan(pid):
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    tc = p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"
    langs = langs_of(p)
    pol = policy(pid)
    wd = web_disabled(pid)
    levels = []
    for lvl in range(0, 6):
        if lvl == 0:
            levels.append({"level": 0, "name": LEVEL_NAME[0],
                           "count": len(PREP_STEPS) + len(ACQUIRE_STEPS),
                           "tools": PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS, "applicable": True,
                           "note": "details first"})
            continue
        tools = [t["id"] for t in TOOLS.values() if t["lvl"] == lvl and lang_ok(t, langs, tc)]
        note = ""
        if not tools:
            note = "no %s method for %s" % (LEVEL_NAME[lvl], tc)
        elif wd:
            tools = [t for t in tools if not TOOLS[t].get("web")]
            note = "web excluded by program"
        levels.append({"level": lvl, "name": LEVEL_NAME[lvl], "count": len(tools),
                       "tools": tools, "applicable": bool(tools), "note": note})
    return {"toolchain": tc, "label": TYPE_LABEL.get(tc, tc), "levels": levels,
            "scope_model": pol["scope_model"], "poc_required": pol["poc"]["required"],
            "details_ok": bool(p.get("details_ok")), "web_target": web_target(pid),
            "tvl": p.get("tvl") or 0, "threshold": THRESHOLD, "program": pol.get("program")}


def _single_tool(pid, token, tid):
    t = TOOLS.get(tid)
    if not t:
        return
    p = getp(pid) or {}
    if not lang_ok(t, langs_of(p), p.get("toolchain") or "unknown"):
        log(pid, "tool: %s does not apply (skipped)" % tid)
        return
    setp(pid, status="running", stage=tid)
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root, "depth": 1}
    if p.get("toolchain") == "web":
        ctx["root"] = WORK / str(pid)
    if not has_surface(pid):
        for name in PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
    log(pid, "tool: manual %s" % tid)
    try:
        log(pid, "tool: %s -> %d hit(s)" % (tid, t["run"](ctx) or 0))
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "tool: %s failed (%s)" % (tid, str(ex)[:200]))
    score_findings(pid)
    run_step(pid, "gate", ctx)
    run_step(pid, "report", ctx)
    setp(pid, status="done", stage=tid)


def _single_level(pid, token, lvl):
    setp(pid, status="running", stage=LEVEL_NAME.get(lvl, "?"))
    root = WORK / str(pid) / "repo"
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root, "depth": 1}
    if lvl == 0:
        for name in PREP_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            if name == "intake" and not run_step(pid, name, ctx):
                setp(pid, status="needs-details", stage="intake")
                return
            if name != "intake":
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        for name in ACQUIRE_STEPS:
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
    else:
        if not has_surface(pid):
            for name in PREP_STEPS + ACQUIRE_STEPS:
                if token.is_set():
                    return
                run_step(pid, name, ctx)
        for name in LEVEL_STEPS.get(lvl, []):
            if token.is_set():
                return
            run_step(pid, name, ctx)
    score_findings(pid)
    run_step(pid, "gate", ctx)
    run_step(pid, "report", ctx)
    setp(pid, status="done", stage=LEVEL_NAME.get(lvl, "?"))


def pool_worker():
    while True:
        job = JOBQ.get()
        if job is None:
            return
        pid, token, mode, value = job
        try:
            if mode == "tool":
                _single_tool(pid, token, value)
            elif mode == "level":
                _single_level(pid, token, int(value))
            else:
                attack_until_finding(pid, token)
        except Exception:
            log(pid, "FATAL " + traceback.format_exc(limit=4))
            setp(pid, status="failed")
        finally:
            with RUN_LOCK:
                RUNNING.pop(pid, None)
            setp(pid, last_run=time.time())
            JOBQ.task_done()


def start_attack(pid, mode="full", value=None):
    if not getp(pid):
        return False, "no project"
    with RUN_LOCK:
        if pid in RUNNING:
            return False, "already running"
        token = threading.Event()
        RUNNING[pid] = token
    JOBQ.put((pid, token, mode, value))
    return True, "queued"


def stop_attack(pid):
    with RUN_LOCK:
        token = RUNNING.get(pid)
    if not token:
        return False
    token.set()
    return True


def running_pids():
    with RUN_LOCK:
        return sorted(RUNNING.keys())


def start_all():
    STOP.clear()
    claimed = []
    with db() as c:
        free = max(1, WORKERS - len(running_pids()))
        rows = [r["id"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM projects WHERE status IN ('idle','failed','barren','stopped',"
            "'needs-details') AND auto=1 ORDER BY rank LIMIT ?", (free,))]
        for pid in rows:
            if c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='running' WHERE id=? AND status IN "
                         "('idle','failed','barren','stopped','needs-details')",
                         (pid,)).rowcount:
                claimed.append(pid)
    started = 0
    for pid in claimed:
        if start_attack(pid, "full")[0]:
            started += 1
        else:
            setp(pid, status="idle")
    log(0, "start_all: %d queued" % started)


def stop_all():
    for pid in running_pids():
        stop_attack(pid)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='stopped' WHERE status='running'")
    log(0, "stop_all: signalled")


def discover(limit=6):
    """Discovery is pinned: the three programs are ensured, nothing else is added."""
    seed_programs()
    n = 0
    with db() as c:
        n = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects").fetchone()[0]
    return n


# ================================== HTTP =====================================

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _j(self, obj, code=200):
        b = json.dumps(obj, default=str).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)

    def _f(self, path, ctype):
        try:
            b = Path(path).read_bytes()
        except Exception:
            return self._j({"error": "not found"}, 404)
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def do_GET(self):
        u = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        q = urllib.parse.parse_qs(u.query)
        if u.path in ("/", "/index.html"):
            return self._f(UI, "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        if u.path == "/api/state":
            live = set(running_pids())
            with db() as c:
                rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
                    "SELECT id,name,slug,url,prog,toolchain,status,stage,cycle,attempts,"
                    "escalation,max,rank,brief_ok,auto,type_locked,type_conf,type_all,cond_ok,"
                    "readiness,details_ok,targets_n,repairs,tvl,fund_hits FROM projects "
                    "ORDER BY rank, id")]
                tally = {k: 0 for k in SEV_ORDER}
                fund = 0
                for r in rows:
                    r["hits"] = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=?",
                                          (r["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                    r["fund"] = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND fund=1",
                                          (r["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                    fund += r["fund"]
                    r["ready"] = c.execute(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 AND judged=1 "
                        "AND (blockers='[]' OR blockers IS NULL)", (r["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                    r["unjudged"] = c.execute(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND judged=0",
                        (r["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                    r["live"] = r["id"] in live
                    r["web"] = bool(web_target(r["id"]))
                    for sev, n in c.execute(
                            "SELECT sev, COUNT(*) FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND eligible=1 "
                            "GROUP BY sev", (r["id"],)):
                        tally[sev] = tally.get(sev, 0) + n
            return self._j({"projects": rows, "threshold": THRESHOLD, "cycles": MAX_CYCLES,
                            "stopped": STOP.is_set(), "tools": len(TOOLS), "workers": WORKERS,
                            "running": len(live), "fund": fund, "tally": tally,
                            "fund_only": FUND_ONLY, "repair_kinds": REPAIR_KINDS})
        if u.path == "/api/log":
            pid = int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])
            since = int(q.get("since", ["0"])[0])
            with db() as c:
                rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
                    "SELECT id,pid,ts,line FROM log WHERE id>? AND (?=0 OR pid=?) "
                    "ORDER BY id LIMIT 400", (since, pid, pid))]
            return self._j(rows)
        if u.path == "/api/findings":
            pid = int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])
            with db() as c:
                rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? ORDER BY fund DESC, score DESC, id DESC",
                    (pid,))]
            return self._j(rows)
        if u.path == "/api/report":
            pid = int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])
            f = WORK / str(pid) / "report.md"
            b = WORK / str(pid) / "body.txt"
            return self._j({"report": f.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if f.exists() else "",
                            "body": b.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if b.exists() else ""})
        if u.path == "/api/conditions":
            return self._j(policy(int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])))
        if u.path == "/api/readiness":
            return self._j(readiness(int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])))
        if u.path == "/api/plan":
            return self._j(attack_plan(int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])))
        if u.path == "/api/details":
            pid = int(q.get("pid", ["0"])[0])
            f = WORK / str(pid) / "details.json"
            r = WORK / str(pid) / "details_reason.txt"
            return self._j({"details": json.loads(f.read_text()) if f.exists() else {},
                            "reason": r.read_text() if r.exists() else ""})
        if u.path == "/api/programs":
            return self._j([{"key": k, "name": v["name"], "docs": v["docs"],
                             "repo": v["repo"], "contact": v["contact"],
                             "tiers": v["tiers"], "notes": v.get("notes", ""),
                             "groups": v.get("groups", []),
                             "dirs": v.get("scope_dirs", [])}
                            for k, v in PROGRAMS.items()])
        if u.path == "/api/tools":
            return self._j([{"id": t["id"], "name": t["name"], "cls": t["cls"], "sev": t["sev"],
                             "lvl": t["lvl"], "fund": bool(t.get("fund")),
                             "langs": list(t.get("langs") or []), "web": bool(t.get("web"))}
                            for t in TOOLS.values()])
        if u.path == "/api/repairs":
            return self._j(REPAIR_LOG[-200:])
        if u.path == "/api/discover":
            return self._j({"added": discover()})
        return self._j({"error": "bad path"}, 404)

    def do_POST(self):
        u = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        try:
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}") if n else {}
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            return self._j({"error": "bad json"}, 400)
        if u.path == "/api/paste":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            txt = body.get("text") or ""
            p = getp(pid)
            if not p:
                return self._j({"error": "no project"}, 400)
            if len(txt.strip()) < 80:
                return self._j({"error": "text too short"}, 400)
            root = WORK / str(pid)
            root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            res = platforms.manual(pid, txt, p.get("url") or "")
            (root / "scope.txt").write_text(res.markdown[:600000], encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "headers.txt").write_text("via: manual", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "details_reason.txt").unlink(missing_ok=True)
            ctx = {"pid": pid, "root": root}
            st_conditions(pid, ctx)
            st_scopeaddr(pid, ctx)
            st_brief(pid, ctx)
            ok = bool((getp(pid) or {}).get("cond_ok"))
            setp(pid, details_ok=1 if ok else 0, status="idle" if ok else "needs-details")
            log(pid, "paste: %d bytes, %d asset(s), cond_ok=%s"
                % (len(txt), len(res.rec["assets"]), ok))
            return self._j({"ok": ok, "assets": len(res.rec["assets"]),
                            "tiers": len(res.rec["rewards"]), "problems": res.problems})
        if u.path == "/api/purge":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            if pid:
                purge(pid)
                return self._j({"ok": True, "cleared": 1})
            with db() as c:
                ids = [r["id"] for r in c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects")]
            for x in ids:
                purge(x)
            return self._j({"ok": True, "cleared": len(ids)})
        if u.path == "/api/restart":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            ok, msg = restart(pid)
            return self._j({"ok": ok, "msg": msg}, 200 if ok else 409)
        if u.path == "/api/attack":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            mode, value = "full", None
            if body.get("tool"):
                mode, value = "tool", body["tool"]
            elif body.get("level") is not None:
                mode, value = "level", int(body["level"])
            ok, msg = start_attack(pid, mode, value)
            return self._j({"ok": ok, "msg": msg}, 200 if ok else 409)
        if u.path == "/api/stop":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            if pid:
                if stop_attack(pid):
                    setp(pid, status="stopped")
                return self._j({"ok": True})
            stop_all()
            return self._j({"ok": True})
        if u.path == "/api/start_all":
            start_all()
            return self._j({"ok": True})
        if u.path == "/api/auto":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            on = 1 if body.get("on", True) else 0
            if pid:
                setp(pid, auto=on)
            else:
                with db() as c:
                    c.execute("UPDATE projects SET auto=?", (on,))
            return self._j({"ok": True})
        if u.path == "/api/fundonly":
            global FUND_ONLY
            FUND_ONLY = bool(body.get("on", True))
            return self._j({"ok": True, "on": FUND_ONLY})
        if u.path == "/api/type":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            t = (body.get("toolchain") or "").strip()
            if not getp(pid):
                return self._j({"error": "no project"}, 400)
            if t == "auto":
                setp(pid, type_locked=0, type_conf="none")
            elif t in TYPES:
                setp(pid, toolchain=t, type_locked=1, type_conf="manual")
            else:
                return self._j({"error": "bad type"}, 400)
            return self._j({"ok": True})
        if u.path == "/api/tool":
            tid = body.get("id")
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            if tid not in TOOLS or not getp(pid):
                return self._j({"error": "bad tool or project"}, 400)
            ok, msg = start_attack(pid, "tool", tid)
            return self._j({"ok": ok, "msg": msg}, 200 if ok else 409)
        if u.path == "/api/poc":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            return self._j({"written": st_poc(pid, {"pid": pid})})
        if u.path == "/api/repair":
            pid = int(body.get("pid") or 0)
            if not getp(pid):
                return self._j({"error": "no project"}, 400)
            setp(pid, repairs=int((getp(pid) or {}).get("repairs") or 0) + 1)
            return self._j({"ok": run_repair(pid, body.get("kind") or "unknown", "",
                                             WORK / str(pid) / "repo")})
        return self._j({"error": "bad path"}, 404)


def serve():
    for port in PORTS:
        try:
            srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), H)
        except OSError:
            continue
        log(0, "ui: http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port)
        threading.Thread(target=gh_worker, daemon=True).start()
        webbrowser.open("http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port)
        srv.serve_forever()
        return
    log(0, "no free port")


def main():
    init()
    self_check()
    for _ in range(WORKERS):
        threading.Thread(target=pool_worker, daemon=True).start()
    log(0, "BountyHunter 10 - 3 programs pinned, %d methods" % len(TOOLS))
    for key, spec in PROGRAMS.items():
        log(0, "program %s: %s · submit %s · tiers %s"
            % (key, spec["docs"], spec["contact"],
               "/".join("%s<=$%s" % (t["tier"], t["max"]) for t in spec["tiers"])))
    log(0, "gates: web critical-only where set, TVL cap where set, dir scope where set")
    log(0, "network: serial, gap %.1fs" % NET_GAP)
    log(0, "detail tiers: %s" % "/".join(platforms.TIERS))
    if not ETHERSCAN_KEY:
        log(0, "no ETHERSCAN_KEY - onchain scope and impl resolution disabled")
    serve()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
